Dr. Ashwin Sunil Tamhankar is Consultant Surgical Oncologist and Robotic Surgeon at Apollo Hospitals, Navi Mumbai, with more than 9 years of experience. He previously worked at Tata Memorial Hospital in Mumbai.

His practice is uro-oncological. He performs radical prostatectomy, radical cystectomy and bladder cancer surgery, kidney cancer surgery and testicular cancer surgery, and the robotic platform sits in his title rather than as an occasional addition to it.

He holds an MBBS, an MS, an MCh in Urology and a DNB in Urology. Three fellowships followed, each in a different operating technology. He completed the Vattikuti Robotic Uro-oncology Fellowship at Max Institute of Cancer Care, New Delhi, between February 2017 and February 2018. He then took a laser urological robotic fellowship approved by the Royal College of Surgeons of England and the British Association of Urological Surgeons. The third, the Olympus Laparoscopic Endo-Urology Fellowship, was completed at the Asian Institute of Nephrology and Urology in Hyderabad.

His academic record is built on national prizes. He placed second nationally for the Dr. G. M. Phadke Travelling Fellowship in 2016, first nationally for the Dr. Sitharaman Memorial Prize for best essay in 2018 on the future of urology research in India, and first nationally for the Dr. Brij Kishore Patna Prize Paper for the best scientific paper at USICON in 2019.

dr-pakhee-aggarwal.bio:
Dr. Pakhee Aggarwal is a Senior Consultant at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in the Delhi NCR, with more than 20 years of experience. She also works at the Apollo Athenea Women's Cancer Centre.

Her surgical practice is in gynaecological cancer. She performs radical hysterectomy and operates on cervical, ovarian and endometrial cancer, as well as on the less common vulvar and vaginal cancers, and uses sentinel lymph node biopsy for nodal assessment. She also operates on breast cancer.

She qualified MBBS and took an MS, and holds three further postgraduate memberships: MRCOG from the Royal College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists in the United Kingdom, FICOG from the Indian College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists, and MIPHA from the Indian Public Health Association. Her subspecialty training was taken abroad on two fellowships. The first was a UICC Robotic Gynae-Oncology Fellowship at McGill University in Montreal, Canada; the second a Commonwealth Gynae-Oncology Fellowship at Oxford, following the specialised training standard set by the European Society of Gynaecological Oncology.

She collected more than 20 gold, silver and bronze medals during her residency training. Training others is now part of her role. She is a resource faculty trainer for the Royal College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists in London, acting as a clinical examiner for the Part 3 MRCOG examinations, and a resource faculty trainer for the National Institute of Cytology and Preventive Oncology, which sits under ICMR and the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

dr-shruti-bhatia.bio:
Dr. Shruti Bhatia is Director of Gynaecological Surgical Oncology at BLK-Max Super Speciality Hospital in the Delhi NCR, with more than 27 years of experience.

Her practice is confined to the gynaecological cancers and covers them in depth. She performs radical hysterectomy and surgery for cervical, endometrial, vulvar and vaginal cancer, and takes on ovarian cancer including debulking and cytoreductive surgery where disease is extensive. Node management runs from sentinel lymph node biopsy through to full gynecologic cancer lymphadenectomy. Robotic gynecologic oncology surgery is part of her operating repertoire, and she also manages hormonal therapy for gynaecologic cancers, so her care continues past the operation itself.

She qualified MBBS and took an MD in Obstetrics and Gynaecology, followed by a DNB in the same subject. She is also MNAMS.

Her career has been built in Delhi and shows a steady progression through its cancer units. She began as a junior consultant at Sunderlal Jain Hospital, at Rajiv Gandhi Cancer Institute and at Sri Balaji Action Medical Institute. She moved to BLK Super Speciality Hospital as consultant in surgical oncology and gynae oncology, and then to Action Cancer Hospital as principal consultant and head of gynae oncology. She now holds her directorship at BLK-Max Super Speciality Hospital in New Delhi.

dr-sivakumar-mahalingam.bio:
Dr. Sivakumar Mahalingam is a Senior Consultant in surgical oncology at MGM Healthcare, Chennai, with more than 22 years of experience.

His operating practice sits across two areas that are often kept separate. On one side are the urological cancers: kidney, bladder, prostate and testicular cancer surgery. On the other is musculoskeletal oncology, covering bone cancer and bone tumour surgery, soft tissue sarcoma surgery, and limb salvage surgery, where the aim is to clear the tumour while preserving the limb.

He qualified MBBS in 2004 from Vinayaka Mission's Research Foundation, a deemed-to-be university in Salem, Tamil Nadu, and completed his MS in General Surgery at Madurai Medical College in 2009. His super-specialty training was at the Cancer Institute (WIA) in Chennai, where he took his MCh in Surgical Oncology in 2014; the National Board of Examinations awarded him a DNB in Surgical Oncology in the same year. In 2017 he added a Fellowship in Minimal Access Surgery from the Association of Minimal Access Surgeons of India.

He holds membership of six professional bodies: the Indian Medical Association, the Association of Surgeons of India, the Indian Association of Surgical Oncology, the Association of Minimal Access Surgeons of India, the Indian Society of Oncology and the Society of Surgical Oncology.

dr-sumedha-gupta.bio:
Dr. Sumedha Gupta is an Associate Consultant at Medanta – The Medicity, Gurugram, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 15 years of experience. Her work spans gynecologic oncology within surgical oncology and general obstetrics and gynaecology.

Her surgical practice covers the gynaecological cancers. She performs radical hysterectomy and operates on cervical, endometrial, ovarian and vulvar cancer, and uses sentinel lymph node biopsy to assess the regional nodes rather than removing them all as a matter of course.

Her training was completed largely in New Delhi. She qualified MBBS at Vardhman Mahavir Medical College and Safdarjung Hospital and stayed there for her MS in Obstetrics and Gynaecology. She then took a DNB in Obstetrics and Gynaecology, and subspecialised with a DrNB in Gynaecological Oncology from the National Board of Examinations.

Two of her certifications are in minimal access surgery. FMAS and DMAS were both awarded in recognition of advanced skills in operating through small incisions, and they explain why her cancer operations are not limited to open approaches. Her ESGO certification, from the European Society of Gynaecological Oncology, reflects adherence to international standards in gynaecological oncology.

She was a medalist during her medical training, recognised for academic excellence, and she is a published researcher with multiple papers in indexed international journals.

dr-kanika-rana.bio:
Dr. Kanika Rana is a Senior Consultant at Medanta – The Medicity, Gurugram, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 14 years of experience in head and neck surgical oncology.

Her operating practice covers cancers of the upper aerodigestive tract and the glands around it. She performs oral cancer surgery, oropharyngeal cancer surgery and laryngeal cancer surgery, along with laryngeal surgery for non-malignant disease. She also carries out parathyroidectomy, salivary gland tumour removal and other salivary gland surgery.

She came to oncology through ear, nose and throat surgery. After qualifying MBBS she completed her M.S. in ENT at Maulana Azad Medical College in 2012 and holds a D.N.B. in the same subject. Her subspecialty training was a fellowship in head and neck oncology at Medanta, where she now practises.

She has twice observed at major American centres. In 2015 she undertook a clinical observership in head and neck surgery at Johns Hopkins Hospital in Baltimore, supported by an International Visiting Scholarship from the American Academy of Otolaryngology–Head and Neck Surgery. In 2022 she returned for a clinical observership in head and neck oncology at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center.

Her earlier academic record was built at conferences of the AOI: first prize in the quiz at the 38th annual state conference in Delhi in 2015, second prize at the 36th in 2013, and first prize for poster presentation at the 62nd annual national conference in Mumbai in 2010.

dr-manish-jain-1.bio:
Dr. Manish Jain is Director and Unit Head of Gastrointestinal Oncosurgery at BLK-Max Super Speciality Hospital in the Delhi NCR, with more than 20 years of experience. He works across surgical oncology and surgical gastroenterology, and his practice is defined by an organ system rather than by a single tumour type.

His operating list runs the length of the digestive tract: esophageal and gastric cancer surgery, small intestine and colorectal cancer surgery, and the hepatopancreatobiliary group of pancreatic, gallbladder and bile duct cancer surgery, together with liver cancer. Where disease has seeded the peritoneal cavity he performs cytoreductive surgery with hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy, and he is a certified PIPAC surgeon.

He qualified MBBS, took an MS in General Surgery and completed a DrNB in Surgical Gastroenterology. He is a certified robotic surgeon and a proctor for Intuitive on the Da Vinci X and Xi systems, which means he trains other consultants on the platform as well as operating on it.

His career has passed through several of the major surgical and cancer units in Delhi. He has worked at Rajiv Gandhi Cancer Institute and Research Centre, at Max Super Speciality Hospital in Saket, at Action Cancer Hospital and Sri Balaji Action Medical Institute, at Guru Teg Bahadur Hospital with the University College of Medical Sciences, and at GB Pant Hospital, before his present post at BLK-Max in New Delhi.

dr-manjunath-bale.bio:
Dr. Manjunath Bale is Consultant Robotic and Minimally Invasive Thoracic Surgeon and Lung Transplant Surgeon at Yashoda Hospitals, Hi-Tech City, Hyderabad, with more than 17 years of experience. He has also worked at Apollo Health City in Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad.

His surgical practice is confined to the chest. He operates on lung cancer, on chest wall and mediastinal tumours, and on pleural mesothelioma, and his title carries a lung transplant remit alongside the cancer work.

He qualified MBBS from S Nijalingappa Medical College, Bagalkot, between 2004 and 2009, then spent four years at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences in New Delhi for his MS in General Surgery, from 2010 to 2014. His MCh was also taken at AIIMS.

The rest of his training reads as a deliberate accumulation of technique for operating through small incisions. He completed basic laparoscopy training at AIIMS in 2013 and basic VATS training with Ethicon in New Delhi the same year, and holds Advanced Trauma Life Support from JPNATC at AIIMS, certified in 2013. In 2019 he completed an MIS fellowship in minimal access surgery at AIIMS. That same year he travelled twice to China as a clinical observer: to the Uniportal VATS Training Programme at Shanghai Pulmonary Hospital, and to the Uniportal VATS Complex Lung Resections Masterclass at Yunnan Cancer Hospital in Kunming.

dr-mohan-venkatesh-pulle.bio:
Dr. Mohan Venkatesh Pulle is Consultant in Lung Transplant and Chest Surgery at Medanta – The Medicity, Gurugram, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 13 years of experience.

His surgical work is entirely thoracic. He operates on lung cancer and esophageal cancer, on mediastinal and chest wall tumours, and on pleural mesothelioma, and the transplant side of his title sits alongside that cancer practice.

His training was taken through the National Board of Examinations. After qualifying MBBS he completed a DNB in General Surgery and then a DNB in Thoracic Surgery, finishing as a gold medalist in both. The Board awarded him the President's Gold Medal in General Surgery and, separately, the President's Gold Medal in Thoracic Surgery — the same distinction twice, at two different stages of his training. He subsequently completed a clinical observership in thoracic oncology at Tata Memorial Hospital in Mumbai.

The Association of Surgeons of India gave him the Torrent's Young Scholar Award in 2015. He has been a leading contributor to the Minimally Invasive Chest Surgery Programme in India, and is lead author of numerous original articles in reputed national and international journals. He is a member of various national and international thoracic surgical societies.

dr-p-saravanan.bio:
Dr. P. Saravanan is Visiting Consultant and Surgical Oncologist at Rela Hospital, Chennai, with more than 30 years of experience.

His operating practice is divided between the head and neck and the upper gastrointestinal tract. He performs oral cancer surgery, thyroid cancer surgery and head and neck tumour surgery with neck dissection, and also operates on gastric and esophageal cancer.

He qualified MBBS from Madurai Medical College in 1996. His postgraduate path ran through the National Board of Examinations, which awarded him a DNB in General Surgery in 2004, and the Royal College of Surgeons of Edinburgh, which elected him to MRCS in general surgery in 2005. He completed his M.Ch in Surgical Oncology at Govt Kilpauk Medical College, Chennai, in 2010, and placed first in the final examination for that degree.

His clinical career has been spent almost entirely in Chennai. He has worked in the department of surgical oncology at Global Health City, at Govt Royapettah Hospital and Govt Kilpauk Medical College, at Sri Kanchi Kamakoti Hospital in Perumbakkam and at Southern Railway Headquarters Hospital in Perumbur, before his present appointment at Rela Hospital.

His research interest extends into musculoskeletal oncology. An oral paper on pelvic resections in musculoskeletal tumors of the bony pelvis won the Best Paper Award at the Surgical Oncology Conference held at Calcutta in 2009.

dr-saraansh-bansal.bio:
Dr. Saraansh Bansal is Consultant in Thoracic Surgery and Minimally Invasive Thoracic Surgery at BLK-Max Super Speciality Hospital in the Delhi NCR, with more than 10 years of experience.

His operating practice covers lung cancer surgery and esophageal cancer surgery, mediastinal tumour surgery and chest wall tumour surgery, and surgery for pleural mesothelioma. His profile also records interventional bronchoscopy within pulmonology, which places the airway procedures used to diagnose and relieve chest disease inside the same practice as the resections.

He qualified MBBS, took an MS in General Surgery and completed an MCh in Thoracic Surgery. His later training was directed at operating through smaller incisions. He holds robotic thoracic surgery training and uniportal VATS training, and is a Fellow of the Minimal Access Surgeons of India, the qualification recorded against his name as FMAS. He has also held international clinical fellow posts in Singapore, Thailand and Portugal.

His appointments in New Delhi have covered both the respiratory and the oncological sides of chest surgery. He has worked at the National Institute of Tuberculosis and Respiratory Diseases, at the National Cancer Institute and National University Hospital, and at Dr. RML Hospital. He now practises at BLK-Max Super Speciality Hospital in New Delhi.

dr-sivaram-ganesamoni.bio:
Dr. Sivaram Ganesamoni is Senior Surgical Oncologist and Head of Department at MGM Healthcare, Chennai, with more than 24 years of experience.

Breast and gastrointestinal cancer surgery account for most of his work. On the breast he performs mastectomy, breast conserving surgery and oncoplastic breast surgery, so the choice between removing the breast and reshaping it around the tumour is one he can offer either way. In the abdomen he operates on gastric, colorectal and rectal cancer, and on ovarian and endometrial cancer. For disease that has spread across the peritoneal surfaces he performs cytoreductive surgery with HIPEC.

His training took him through five qualifying institutions in eleven years. He qualified MBBS from Madurai Medical College in Tamil Nadu in 2002 and completed his MS in General Surgery at JIPMER, Puducherry, in 2008. The Royal College of Surgeons of Edinburgh admitted him to MRCS in 2009, and the National Board of Examinations in New Delhi awarded him a DNB in General Surgery in 2010. His super-specialty training followed at the Cancer Institute (WIA) in Chennai, where he took his MCh in Surgical Oncology in 2013.

He is a member of five professional bodies: the Indian Medical Association, the Association of Surgeons of India, the Indian Association of Surgical Oncology, the Indian Society of Oncology and the Society of Surgical Oncology.

dr-vivek-venkatramani.bio:
Dr. Vivek Venkatramani is Visiting Consultant Uro-Oncologist and Robotic Surgeon at Apollo Hospitals, Navi Mumbai, with more than 16 years of experience.

He operates on the urological cancers: radical prostatectomy and other prostate cancer surgery, radical cystectomy and bladder cancer surgery, kidney cancer surgery and testicular cancer surgery.

He holds an M.S. in General Surgery and an M.Ch. in Urology, and completed a fellowship in urologic oncology in Miami.

His published work is concentrated on diagnosis and technique. In Urology in 2017 he re-examined prostate-specific antigen density, defining the optimal PSA range and the patients for whom PSA density predicts prostate cancer on extended template biopsy. In the Journal of Urology in 2014 he reported a single centre, parallel arm, randomized controlled trial comparing monopolar with bipolar transurethral resection of bladder tumors. He wrote an editorial comment in the same journal in 2016 on reoperations following robot-assisted radical cystectomy, and contributed Urovision 2020, a piece on the future of urology, in 2015.

His academic record began early. At the final M.B.B.S examination he secured distinctions in Paediatrics and Obstetrics and Gynaecology and ranked first in his college in Paediatrics. In 2004 he won the undergraduate open quiz at the 31st annual conference of the Research Society of B.J. Medical College, and took the Best Poster Award at the same meeting.

dr-deepak-sarin.bio:
Dr. Deepak Sarin is Chairman at Medanta – The Medicity, Gurugram, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 32 years of experience in surgical oncology.

His practice is in the head and neck. He performs oral cancer surgery, laryngeal, hypopharyngeal and oropharyngeal cancer surgery, thyroid cancer surgery including thyroidectomy, and parathyroidectomy. Composite resection is on his list for tumours that cross tissue planes and require more than one structure to be taken together. His approach to the neck is graded rather than uniform: selective neck dissection and sentinel lymph node biopsy where the nodes permit it, wider neck dissection where they do not.

He came to oncology from ear, nose and throat surgery. He qualified M.B.B.S., took an M.S. in Otolaryngology with a gold medal, and holds a D.N.B. in Otorhinolaryngology together with a fellowship in head and neck oncology. He then trained in the United States as a clinical fellow in head and neck ablative surgery at the Sylvester Comprehensive Cancer Center, University of Miami.

Before Medanta he was at Artemis Health Institute and at Sir Ganga Ram Hospital in New Delhi.

His awards include the Chandler Society Award in 2005, the Mukut Saharia Award, and the Kamani Charity Book Prize, which accompanied his gold medal in M.S.

dr-keshavarajan-g.bio:
Dr. Keshavarajan G is a Consultant at Rela Hospital, Chennai, attached to its cancer centre. He has practised for more than 17 years, and his profile records two areas of work: surgical oncology and general surgery.

His education runs from Mysore to Chennai by way of Thiruvananthapuram. He completed pre-university studies at Sri Ramakrishna Vidyashala in Mysore in 2003 and qualified MBBS from JSS Medical College in the same city in 2009. His MS in General Surgery was taken at Madras Medical College, Chennai, in 2013. He then moved to the Regional Cancer Centre, Thiruvananthapuram, for his MCh in Surgical Oncology, completed in 2019, the super-specialty qualification that defines his present practice.

He is a certified PIPAC surgeon. Pressurized intraperitoneal aerosol chemotherapy delivers chemotherapy into the abdominal cavity, and the certification sits on his profile alongside his degrees.

His professional memberships map onto the technical side of his training. He belongs to the Indian Association of Surgical Oncology and the Association of Surgeons of India, and to two bodies concerned with how operations are performed rather than with what they treat: the Association of Minimal Access Surgeons of India and the Clinical Robotic Surgery Association.

Taken together, the record describes a surgeon who trained in general surgery before cancer surgery, holds certification in an intraperitoneal chemotherapy technique, and is affiliated to national bodies for both minimal access and robotic operating.

dr-parveen-yadav.bio:
Dr. Parveen Yadav is Chief and Senior Consultant for Minimal Invasive, Robotic and Thoracic Onco Surgery at Artemis Hospital, Gurugram, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 20 years of experience.

His practice covers both the operating theatre and the endoscopy suite. He performs esophageal cancer surgery, including minimally invasive esophageal cancer resection, and lung cancer surgery by VATS and robotic approaches, with lobectomy among the operations he offers. He operates on chest wall tumours and on mediastinal disease, including mediastinal masses and thymomas. On the diagnostic side he performs bronchoscopy and mediastinoscopy, and his therapeutic bronchoscopy extends to stenting and other interventional procedures. He also carries out invasive pleural procedures: thoracoscopy, pleural biopsy and pleural taps.

He qualified MBBS and took an MS in General Surgery, and holds FAIS and FAIGES. His surgical oncology training was at AIIMS, New Delhi, and he completed the IRCH fellowship in thoracic surgery at Tata Memorial Hospital, Mumbai. He is a Fellow of the American College of Surgeons and a DNB certified cardiothoracic surgeon.

He took the Best Poster Award at the Indian Cancer Congress in 2011. He appears as guest faculty and as chairperson at national and international conferences, and has organised national and regional meetings himself, among them ASVSCOR in 2013 and IAGES in 2017.

dr-phanendra-kumar-gubbala.bio:
Dr. Phanendra Kumar Gubbala is Consultant Gynaecological Oncologist at Apollo Proton Cancer Centre, Chennai, with more than 9 years of experience. He has also practised at Apollo Hospitals in Ahmedabad.

His surgical work covers the gynaecological cancers. He performs radical hysterectomy and operates on cervical, ovarian and endometrial cancer, as well as on the less common vulvar and vaginal cancers. Sentinel lymph node biopsy is used for nodal assessment, so that the nodes most at risk can be examined without clearing the whole basin. For disease that has spread across the peritoneum he performs cytoreductive surgery with HIPEC.

He qualified MBBS and is a Member of the Royal College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists. His subspecialty training was a fellowship in gynaecological oncology at The Christie Cancer Hospital in Manchester, United Kingdom, and he holds the Fellowship of the European Board of Gynaecologists, a qualification held by only a few Indian physicians. Both credentials were earned outside India, and between them they cover the British and the European training standards for the specialty.

One operation stands out on his record by volume: he has performed over 175 Piver-Rutledge radical hysterectomies at Apollo Hospitals, Ahmedabad, a first in the history of that institution.

He has presented research at Irish, British, European, American and World conferences, and has participated in multi-centric international drug trials in Ireland.

dr-s-srivishnu.bio:
Dr. S. Srivishnu is a Consultant in surgical oncology at MGM Healthcare, Chennai, with more than 13 years of experience.

His operating range covers three regions. On the breast he performs mastectomy, breast-conserving surgery and oncoplastic breast surgery, with sentinel lymph node biopsy for nodal staging. In the head and neck he operates on laryngeal, oropharyngeal and hypopharyngeal cancer and on head and neck tumours generally, with neck dissection where the nodes require it. In the abdomen and chest he performs esophageal cancer surgery and ovarian cancer surgery, and cytoreductive surgery with HIPEC for peritoneal disease.

He took his M.S. in General Surgery at Kilpauk Medical College and his M.Ch. in Surgical Oncology at Tata Memorial Hospital, Mumbai. He is a Member of the Royal College of Surgeons, Edinburgh, and holds a DrNB in Surgical Oncology. He then completed a one year fellowship in robotic and minimal access surgical oncology at Fortis Cancer Institute, Bangalore.

Before his present post he was a Consultant at Valentis Robotic and Cyberknife Cancer Hospital in the Delhi NCR. His earlier appointments were the training posts themselves, at Kilpauk Medical College for his M.S. and at Tata Memorial Hospital for his M.Ch., together with the fellowship year at Fortis Cancer Institute in Bangalore.

dr-akshay-tiwari-1.bio:
Dr. Akshay Tiwari is Senior Orthopedic Oncologist at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in the Delhi NCR, with more than 22 years of experience. He also works at the Apollo Athenea Women's Cancer Centre.

His field is musculoskeletal oncology, the cancer surgery of bone and soft tissue. He performs bone cancer surgery and bone tumour surgery, and soft tissue sarcoma surgery. Limb salvage surgery is central to the practice: the tumour is removed and the limb rebuilt rather than amputated. He also treats metastatic bone disease, operates on chest wall tumours, and performs sentinel lymph node biopsy.

He qualified MBBS, winning the gold medal for the highest marks in anatomy in his first professional examinations, and took an MS in Orthopedics. His subspecialty training was a fellowship in musculoskeletal oncology at the Rizzoli Orthopedic Institute in Italy. He also holds a Diploma in Tissue Banking, a qualification that sits close to the reconstructive half of his operating work.

His published work has been recognised twice, with a Best Paper Award at ICC in 2013 and a Best Published Paper Award at RGCON in 2011. Together with the anatomy medal at the start of his training, those are the three formal recognitions recorded against his name.

dr-kanchan-kaur.bio:
Dr. Kanchan Kaur is Senior Director at Medanta – The Medicity in the Delhi NCR, with more than 26 years of experience. Her practice is breast surgery and breast cancer surgical oncology, and she also consults at Medanta Mediclinic Golf Course.

The range of her work covers the whole path a breast patient travels. At the diagnostic end she carries out breast lump evaluation, nipple discharge evaluation and breast biopsy procedures, and manages breast cysts and fibroadenomas. Where surgery is needed for cancer she performs wide local excision and breast-conserving surgery, mastectomy and modified radical mastectomy, and oncoplastic breast surgery when the breast is to be reshaped around the excision. For the axilla she offers sentinel lymph node biopsy and, where the nodes require it, axillary lymph node dissection.

She qualified M.B.B.S. and took an M.S. in General Surgery, and is a Member of the Royal College of Surgeons, Edinburgh.

Her student record was exceptional. She was awarded certificates for topping all four professional MBBS examinations, received the PFIZER Gold Medal as meritorious medical student for 1999, and was named best student of the year by Jammu University in 2000, again with a gold medal. In October 2018 she received the Chicago Sister Cities International Medical Initiative Award.

dr-nikhil-agrawal.bio:
Dr. Nikhil Agrawal is Senior Consultant and GI-HPB Surgical Oncologist at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in the Delhi NCR, with more than 19 years of experience. He also works at the Apollo Athenaa Women's Cancer Centre.

His practice covers the gastrointestinal tract and the hepatopancreatobiliary organs. He performs pancreatic cancer surgery, gallbladder and bile duct cancer surgery, and liver cancer surgery, alongside esophageal, gastric, small intestine and colorectal cancer surgery, so his list runs the length of the digestive tract together with the solid organs that drain into it. For cancer that has spread across the peritoneal surfaces he performs cytoreductive surgery with HIPEC.

His entire medical training was completed at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences in New Delhi: MBBS, then MS in Surgery, then MCh. That is an unusually consistent path through a single institution. He is also a certified robotic surgery proctor, which means he mentors other surgeons through complex robotic GI-HPB oncologic procedures rather than only performing them himself.

He sits on the executive committee of the Indian Association of Surgical Gastroenterology. He has published over 50 PubMed-indexed papers and several book chapters, including in The Lancet Oncology, and appears as invited faculty at major GI-HPB conferences in India and abroad. Against 19 years in practice, that output is the clearest marker of the academic half of his work.

dr-richa-ashok-bansal.bio:
Dr. Richa Ashok Bansal is a Consultant in Surgical Oncology at Apollo Hospitals, Navi Mumbai, with more than 10 years of experience. Her work sits between surgical oncology and obstetrics and gynecology, with a gynecologic oncology focus.

Most of her operating is in the gynaecological cancers. She performs radical hysterectomy and operates on cervical, endometrial, vulvar and vaginal cancer. Ovarian cancer is handled through both debulking and cytoreductive surgery, and she carries out gynecologic cancer lymphadenectomy and sentinel lymph node biopsy for nodal management. She also performs breast cancer surgery, offering both breast-conserving surgery and mastectomy.

She qualified MBBS and took an MS in General Surgery before subspecialising. Her MCh in Gynaecological Oncology was completed at Tata Memorial Hospital, and she also holds a DNB in Surgical Oncology and a fellowship of the European Society of Gynaecological Oncology.

Her academic record reaches beyond India. In 2017 she took first prize at the 6th National Conference of the National Association of Ovarian Cancer, for work on bone and young adult cancers. In 2019 she was selected for the FIGO working group and Asian Collaboration for Research in Uterine and Endometrial Neoplasms in Oncology, organised by Tata Memorial Centre and the National Cancer Grid of India. She co-authored a study on the prevalence of human papilloma virus in specimens of post-menopausal patients with oral and oropharyngeal cancers.

dr-sreekanth-cn.bio:
Dr. Sreekanth CN is a Senior Consultant in surgical oncology at Yashoda Hospitals, Secunderabad, Hyderabad, with more than 20 years of experience.

His operating range is wide. On the breast he performs breast cancer surgery, breast-conserving surgery and oncoplastic breast surgery. In the head and neck he operates on thyroid cancer and on head and neck tumours. In the abdomen he handles gastric, esophageal and liver cancer, and the gynaecological cancers of the ovary, cervix and endometrium. In the chest he performs lung cancer surgery and mediastinal tumour surgery. For peritoneal disease he offers cytoreductive surgery with HIPEC.

He trained in Hyderabad and Mumbai. His MBBS was taken at Osmania Medical College, Hyderabad, from 1996 to 2001, followed by his internship at the same college. He completed his MS in General Surgery at Gandhi Medical College, Secunderabad, between 2004 and 2007, and his MCh in Surgical Oncology at Tata Memorial Hospital, Mumbai, from August 2010 to August 2013.

Since then he has added technique courses rather than further degrees. He took an advanced course in HIPEC and cytoreductive surgery at Hamburg in February 2018, and the International VATS Advanced Course at West China Hospital in Chengdu. He qualified as a console surgeon on the da Vinci Surgical System at Yenepoya Training Centre, Mangalore, in December 2019, and completed an online course in thoracic oncology with the University of Michigan in January 2022.

dr-swathi-prakash.bio:
Dr. Swathi Prakash is a Consultant in breast surgery at the Cancer Centre of Rela Hospital, Chennai, working within surgical oncology, with more than 15 years of experience.

Her practice is devoted to the breast. She performs breast cancer surgery, mastectomy, breast-conserving surgery and oncoplastic breast surgery, and uses sentinel lymph node biopsy for nodal staging. Alongside the cancer surgery she also carries out breast biopsy, fibroadenoma treatment and breast cyst treatment.

She qualified MBBS from Shri Sathya Sai Medical College and Research Institute, Kanchipuram, and took her MS in General Surgery at Govt Kilpauk Medical College and Govt Royapettah Hospital in Chennai. Her MCh is in Breast and Endocrine Surgery, from the All India Institute of Medical Sciences, New Delhi.

Her research compares reconstruction strategies after mastectomy. In a randomized controlled trial she set skin sparing mastectomy with total breast reconstruction using autologous fat grafting against skin sparing mastectomy with silicone implant reconstruction and against breast conservative therapy, measuring quality of life, cosmesis and oncological outcomes in early breast cancer. The results at 34 months of follow-up were presented at the Australasian International Breast Congress in Brisbane.

She has won prizes for three case presentations: a poster on DCIS with lobular cancerization and contralateral axillary metastases at ASOMA in Dehradun in 2022, a collision tumor of the submandibular gland at ASICON in Jaipur in 2017, and a retrosternal goitre at the International College of Surgeons conference on updates of endocrine surgery the same year.

dr-asit-arora.bio:
Dr. Asit Arora is Clinical Lead for GI and HPB Surgical Oncology at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in the Delhi NCR, with more than 22 years of experience. He also works at the Apollo Athenaa Women's Cancer Centre, and his profile records surgical gastroenterology, hepatobiliary and transplant surgery alongside surgical oncology.

His list is named at the level of the operation as well as the diagnosis. He performs the Whipple procedure and distal pancreatectomy for pancreatic disease, liver resection and hepatectomy for liver tumours, and gastrectomy for gastric cancer. The diagnoses behind those operations are pancreatic, gallbladder and bile duct cancer, liver cancer, and gastric, esophageal and colorectal cancer. For peritoneal spread he performs cytoreductive surgery with HIPEC.

He qualified M.B.B.S., took an M.S. in General Surgery, and completed his M.Ch. in Gastrointestinal Surgery, the super-specialty route into the hepatobiliary and pancreatic work that defines his present practice.

Three awards are recorded against his name, and between them they cover both sides of that practice. He is a recipient of the ICMR Young Scientist Award, given for research. In 2022 the ET Healthcare Awards named him Oncosurgeon of the Year for North India, and in 2025 he received the Pride of Indian Healthcare Award at the Indian Express Health Conclave, both of which recognise clinical standing rather than publication.

dr-biswajyoti-hazarika.bio:
Dr. Biswajyoti Hazarika is Chief of Head and Neck Surgery at Artemis Hospital, Gurgaon, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 22 years of experience. His profile records ENT alongside surgical oncology, and that is the route he came by.

His surgical practice is confined to the head and neck. He operates on oral cancer, on laryngeal, hypopharyngeal and oropharyngeal cancer, and on thyroid cancer, and takes on head and neck tumour surgery generally. Neck dissection is part of how he manages the lymph nodes of the neck.

He trained first in Assam. His MBBS was taken at Gauhati Medical College and Hospital in Guwahati, and his MS in ENT at Assam Medical College and Hospital in Dibrugarh. He then moved south for a fellowship in head and neck surgery at Kidwai Memorial Institute of Oncology, Bangalore, the institution that turned an ENT surgeon into a head and neck oncologist and where he subsequently worked.

His career since has run through several large units. He has been at Prince Aly Khan Hospital in Mumbai and at Max Super Specialty Hospital in Saket, New Delhi, before taking his present post as Chief of Head and Neck Surgery at Artemis Hospitals in Gurgaon.

His postgraduate work was recognised with the Blue Star Best Post Graduate Award.

dr-himanshu-gupta.bio:
Dr. Himanshu Gupta is Senior Consultant in Plastic and Onco Reconstructive Surgery at the Cancer Centre of BLK-Max Super Speciality Hospital in the Delhi NCR, with more than 15 years of experience. His profile records both surgical oncology and cosmetic and plastic surgery, and his work sits where the two meet.

The breast is the main site, and his post covers both halves of the operation. He performs breast cancer surgery, mastectomy and breast-conserving surgery, and then the reconstruction: oncoplastic breast surgery and breast reconstruction surgery. That combination is what his title describes, plastic and onco reconstructive surgery carried out inside a cancer centre rather than referred on to a separate unit. He also operates on head and neck tumours and on skin cancer and melanoma.

He qualified MBBS and took an MS in General Surgery before his M.Ch in Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery. His further training was taken abroad. He was a Fellow in Cosmetic Surgery at University Hospital Moncloa in Madrid, Spain, and an observer in lymphatic microsurgery at Istituto Clinico Ligure di Alta Specialità in Rapallo, Italy.

His earlier posts were in cancer units. He was Assistant Professor and Senior Resident in plastic and reconstructive surgery at Tata Memorial Hospital, Mumbai, and then Consultant in plastic and reconstructive surgery at Action Cancer Hospital, New Delhi, before his present appointment at BLK-Max.

dr-shailesh-shrikhande.bio:
Dr. Shailesh Shrikhande is Director and Head of Surgical Oncology at Gleneagles Hospital, Parel, Mumbai, with more than 25 years of experience. His profile records three overlapping areas of work: surgical oncology, surgical gastroenterology, and gastroenterology and hepatobiliary surgery.

His operating practice is hepatobiliary and upper gastrointestinal. He performs pancreatic cancer surgery, gallbladder cancer surgery and bile duct cancer surgery, operates on liver cancer and liver tumours, and takes on gastric cancer surgery and small intestine cancer surgery. Pancreatic surgery sits at the centre of that list, with the biliary tract and the liver on one side of it and the stomach and small bowel on the other.

He holds an MS and an MD. Beyond those, what the record shows is a series of honorary fellowships rather than further examined degrees: FRCS from England and FRCS from Edinburgh, FACS from the American College of Surgeons, and FASA from the American Surgical Association. Those four fellowships, conferred rather than sat for, are an unusual concentration.

Before Gleneagles he was at Tata Memorial Hospital in Mumbai, where he served as Deputy Director and as Chief of GI and HPB Surgical Services. That post covered gastrointestinal and hepatobiliary surgery across the institution, and it accounts for the shape of the practice he brought with him: pancreatic and biliary surgery at the centre, with liver and upper gastrointestinal work around it.

dr-krishnaveni-nayini.bio:
Dr. Krishnaveni Nayini is a Senior Consultant at Yashoda Hospitals, Hi-Tech City, Hyderabad, with more than 26 years of experience in obstetrics and gynaecology and in infertility and IVF.

Her clinical work covers the conditions that bring most women to a gynaecologist. She manages abnormal uterine bleeding and post-menopausal bleeding, uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, endometriosis and chronic pelvic pain, and provides menopause management. In theatre she performs hysterectomy, laparoscopic hysterectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery and endometriosis surgery.

Much of her career was built in the United Kingdom. She qualified MBBS at BLDE Medical College in 2000 and took her DGO at Kurnool Medical College in 2003, became a Member of the Royal College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists in 2006, and completed her CCT in Obstetrics and Gynaecology in 2015. She was elected FRCOG in 2019. Along the way she collected certifications in family planning, pelvic ultrasound and IUI with the BFS, and advanced training modules in labour ward practice, in subfertility and reproductive health, and in benign gynaecology hysteroscopy. She also holds BSCCP certification and a laparoscopic and robotic surgeon fellowship in reproductive medicine. She has worked at Royal Derby Hospital and Wrexham Maelor Hospital, and in Hyderabad at Ankura Hospital and Fernandez Hospital.

She belongs to the RCOG, the British Society of Gynaecology and Endoscopy and the Faculty of Sexual and Reproductive Health. Undergraduate gold medals in biochemistry, anatomy and pathology were followed by the Dr. R P Soonawala Obstetrics Award for best paper at the 32nd AICC RCOG Annual Conference in Delhi.

dr-nutan-agarwal.bio:
Dr. Nutan Agarwal is Head of the Department of Gynaecology at Artemis Hospital, Gurgaon, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 38 years of experience. Her profile spans obstetrics and gynaecology, infertility and IVF, and reproductive endocrinology including PCOS management.

Much of her surgery is done through the hysteroscope and the laparoscope. She performs hysteroscopic myomectomy and hysteroscopic polypectomy, laparoscopic endometriosis surgery and laparoscopic myomectomy, and pelvic floor repair surgery, and her list also includes robotic gynecologic oncology surgery. She manages abnormal uterine bleeding, uterine fibroids and ovarian cysts, performs ovarian cyst surgery, and on the obstetric side offers planned cesarean section and advanced obstetric surgical care.

She qualified MBBS and took her MS in Obstetrics and Gynaecology at King George Medical College, Lucknow, where she also completed a post-graduate programme. She holds a DNB, FICOG, FRCOG, FMAS and FICRS. Her later training was international: a fellowship in reproductive medicine in Sydney, a fetal medicine fellowship at King's College Hospital in London, and a diploma in obstetrics and gynaecology from the Ian Donald Medical School in Croatia.

She is Editor-in-Chief of the Indian Journal of Obstetrics and Gynaecology. She has served as Vice Chairperson of AOGD and chaired its endocrine committee, is Executive Secretary of the Apnee Endoscrine Society of India and Vice President of the Society in PCOS and Metabolic Syndromes, and sits on the executive of the Delhi Society of Prenatal Diagnosis. Her awards include the Times 40 Under 40 in 2019 and recognition for her work developing Asherman Syndrome management.

dr-sarada-vani-n.bio:
Dr. Sarada Vani N is a Senior Consultant at Yashoda Hospitals, Somajiguda, Hyderabad, with more than 23 years of experience in obstetrics and gynaecology and in infertility and IVF.

Her gynaecological practice covers uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding, endometriosis and chronic pelvic pain. She performs ovarian cyst surgery, endometriosis surgery and laparoscopic myomectomy.

Fetal medicine is the strand that distinguishes her training. She qualified MBBS at Kakatiya Medical College, Warangal, in 2000 and took her DNB at Gandhi Medical College, Secunderabad, in 2003. She then worked through the Fetal Medicine Foundation programme in the United Kingdom, gaining the FFM in 2013, fetal ultrasound certification in 2014 and fetal cardiac scanning in 2015, and holds a fellowship in fetal medicine from the FMF in London. Alongside that she completed a fellowship in medical genetics at SGPGI and a fellowship in cosmetic gynaecology in the UAE.

Her posts have been spread across Hyderabad and beyond. She has worked at Ankura Hospital for Women and Children in Banjara Hills, at The Birthplace in Banjara Hills, at KIMS Cuddles Mother and Child Centre in Kondapur, at Genesis Clinics and at Neelima Hospital in Sanath Nagar. Earlier she served as a medical officer at the Military Hospital in Akhnoor and at Saham Health Center in the Sultanate of Oman, where she was named Best Medical Officer in 2009.

She is a member of the Indian Medical Association, the Fetal Medicine Foundation, the International Society of Ultrasound in Obstetrics and Gynecology, and FOGSI.

dr-anitha-kunnaiah.bio:
Dr. Anitha Kunnaiah is a Senior Consultant at Yashoda Hospitals, Hi-Tech City, Hyderabad, with more than 20 years of experience in obstetrics and gynaecology and in infertility and IVF.

Endometriosis is the condition her record returns to most often, in both treatment and surgery. She also manages uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding and chronic pelvic pain, and operates for pelvic organ prolapse. Her surgical list includes hysterectomy and laparoscopic hysterectomy, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, and ovarian cyst surgery.

She qualified MBBS at JSS Medical College, Mysore, in 2003 and took her DGO there in 2007, followed by a DNB at Sagar Hospital, Bangalore, in 2010. She holds the DRM, a fellowship in reproductive medicine awarded in Germany, and completed a further fellowship in reproductive endocrinology and infertility in 2021. In the same year she trained on the da Vinci Surgical System in robotics at Amrita Institute of Medical Sciences, Kochi. Earlier posts were at Citizens Hospital and Continental Hospitals in Hyderabad and at SSMS Medical College, Davangere.

Her academic work has followed those same two themes of robotics and endometriosis. She won best paper at IAGE Kochi in 2023 for robotic surgery in endometriosis, and a top five video presentation award at IAGE Endogyne in Kolkata in 2022 for laparoscopic surgery in a frozen pelvis. She presented on robotic surgery in gynaecological conditions at AICOG Hyderabad in 2024, is organising chairperson of GYN ROBOCON 2025 and founder of the ENDO CONNECT 2026 endometriosis conference, and received a SumanTV Doctor Award in 2025.

dr-kalpaana-gupta.bio:
Dr. Kalpaana Gupta is a Consultant Obstetrician and Gynecologist at Medicover Hospital, Navi Mumbai, with more than 25 years of experience across obstetrics and gynaecology and infertility and IVF.

Her clinical work covers uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding and chronic pelvic pain. In theatre she performs hysterectomy and laparoscopic hysterectomy, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery and oophorectomy, endometriosis surgery, and surgery for pelvic organ prolapse.

She qualified MBBS and holds a DNB, a Diploma in Family Planning and a fellowship in ART from the Indian College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists. She is a Member of the National Academy of Medical Sciences.

What stands out on her record is a continuing programme of short technical training long after qualification. She took the FOGSI training course on ultrasound at Chikitsa Ultrasound Centre in 2014, EART training in 2015, laparoscopic sterilization training with FPA Mumbai in 2016, reproductive endocrinology and infertility training at Aashakiran Hospital and Fertility World in 2017, and endogynecology suturing technique training at CEMAST Mumbai in 2018: one new skill a year for five consecutive years.

She is a member of FOGSI, NMOGS and AOGD as well as the National Academy. She won the Best Paper Award at AICOG in 2008 and a Best Student Award in 2010, and has published research papers in indexed journals.

dr-nisha-kapoor.bio:
Dr. Nisha Kapoor is Program Clinical Director and Head of the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology at Marengo Asia Hospitals, Faridabad, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 22 years of experience.

Her practice covers the full range of benign gynaecology. She manages abnormal uterine bleeding, uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts and chronic pelvic pain, and provides menopause management. Her operating list runs from the least invasive options to the definitive ones: hysteroscopic polypectomy and uterine polyp removal, endometrial ablation, ovarian cyst surgery and endometriosis surgery, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, surgery for pelvic organ prolapse, and hysterectomy by laparoscopic or open approach.

She qualified MBBS and took an MD in Obstetrics and Gynaecology, along with a DGO from PGIMS, Rohtak. She is a Member of the Royal College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists and a Fellow of the Indian College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists.

Much of her career has been spent in professional leadership in Haryana. She was President of the Faridabad Obstetrics and Gynaecology Society from 2012 to 2019, is President of the Haryana Association of Gynae Laparoscopists, and Vice President of the Haryana Association of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists. She has mentored DNB postgraduate trainees for over 15 years, appears as faculty at national and international conferences, and has authored multiple scientific publications.

Her memberships include the Indian Medical Association, FOGSI, the Indian Menopause Society, the Indian Association of Gynaecological Endoscopists, the Indian Society for Assisted Reproduction and the Indian Society for Prenatal Diagnosis and Therapy.

dr-sabhyata-gupta.bio:
Dr. Sabhyata Gupta is Chairperson of the Department of Gynaecology and Gynae-Oncology at Medanta – The Medicity, Gurugram, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 20 years of experience.

Her operating list is defined by the platform as much as by the condition. She performs robotic hysterectomy, robotic myomectomy, robotic endometriosis surgery, robotic pelvic floor surgery and robotic gynecologic oncology surgery, and the same operations laparoscopically where that is the better route: laparoscopic hysterectomy, laparoscopic myomectomy and laparoscopic endometriosis surgery. Pelvic floor repair is also on her list.

Her MD in Gynaecology was in robotic gynaecological surgery, and she holds a diploma in advanced gynaecological endoscopic surgery taken in Germany together with the Fellowship of the International College of Surgeons. Her oncology training came through an observership programme in gynaecological oncology at Tata Memorial Cancer Hospital, Mumbai, and training in cytoreductive surgery for ovarian cancer. She is also American Board certified in aesthetic gynaecology.

She has led two national bodies. She was President of the Fertility Preservation Society of India from 2018 to 2020, and President of AOGIN India for the 2020–22 term. She belongs to the International Gynaecological Cancer Society, the European Society of Gynaecological Oncology and the American Society of Clinical Oncology.

Her recognitions include being named Best Gynaec Robotic Surgeon for North India by World Wide Achievers in 2015, and appearing among the top ten most influential in the health sector in Medgate Magazine in 2018.

dr-vandana-a-gawdi.bio:
Dr. Vandana A. Gawdi is a Senior Consultant in obstetrics and gynaecology at Apollo Hospitals, Navi Mumbai, with more than 30 years of experience.

Her clinical work covers uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding and endometriosis. In theatre she performs hysterectomy and laparoscopic hysterectomy, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery, endometriosis surgery, hysteroscopic polypectomy and uterine polyp removal, and surgery for pelvic organ prolapse.

Most of her qualifications were taken in Mumbai. She holds an MBBS, an MD in Obstetrics and Gynecology and a DGO, all from the University of Mumbai, together with the FCPS of the College of Physicians and Surgeons, Mumbai. She also holds a DNB from the National Board of Examinations in New Delhi and a Diploma in Family Planning. Her subspecialty training was a fellowship in gynecological endoscopy and a further fellowship in infertility.

She is a member of FOGSI, of the Mumbai Obstetric and Gynaecological Society, of the Indian Association of Gynecological Endoscopy and of the Indian Society of Assisted Reproduction.

Her presentations have been recognised repeatedly. She has taken best paper presentation awards at obstetrics and gynecology conferences, has been recognised for academic presentations at the Mumbai Obstetric and Gynaecological Society and at FOGSI conferences, and received an award at the Asia Pacific Association of Gynecological Endoscopy conference.

dr-vimee-bindra-basu.bio:
Dr. Vimee Bindra Basu is a Senior Consultant in obstetrics and gynaecology at Apollo Hospital, Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad, with more than 17 years of experience.

Her practice covers abnormal uterine bleeding, ovarian cysts, chronic pelvic pain and endometriosis. She operates laparoscopically and hysteroscopically as well as by the open route: laparoscopic hysterectomy and hysterectomy, laparoscopic myomectomy and myomectomy, hysteroscopic polypectomy and uterine polyp removal, endometrial ablation, ovarian cyst surgery, endometriosis surgery, and surgery for pelvic organ prolapse.

She qualified MBBS and took an MS in Obstetrics and Gynaecology, and also holds an MHA and the FICOG. Her surgical training came through a fellowship in minimally invasive surgery, a clinical fellowship and diploma in advanced gynaecological surgery, and a fellowship in cosmetic gynaecology.

The rest of her training was taken in short, targeted blocks with named teachers. She trained in colposcopy under Dr. P.S. Basu at the Cancer Institute in Kolkata, and in basic ultrasound in obstetrics and gynaecology under Dr. Kamal Oswal, also in Kolkata. She took advanced laparoscopy and hysteroscopy training at Clermont Ferrand in France, advanced training in infertility and ART under Dr. Sunita Tandulwadkar in Pune, and was a clinical fellow in gynaec endoscopy at BEAMS, Mumbai.

Her recognitions include the Telangana Women Leaders Award in 2022, the Young Clinician Award from the Apollo Group of Hospitals in 2020, the Women Healthcare Leadership Award, the Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Memorial Excellence Award, and being named Best Emerging Gynaecologist of Hyderabad in 2020.

dr-vasundara-cheepurupalli.bio:
Dr. Vasundara Cheepurupalli is a Senior Consultant in obstetrics and gynaecology at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, Hyderabad, with more than 15 years of experience.

Her clinical range covers abnormal uterine bleeding, adenomyosis, uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, endometriosis and chronic pelvic pain, together with menopause management. She performs hysterectomy and laparoscopic hysterectomy, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery and oophorectomy, endometriosis surgery, and surgery for pelvic organ prolapse.

Her qualifications are unusually numerous, and each names a different operating route. She holds an MBBS, an MS, a DNB and a DGO, and is a Fellow in Minimal Access Surgery through AMASI in Mumbai, recorded as FMAS. She is a Fellow in Vaginal Surgery, trained at Indore, and a Fellow in Robotic Surgery, boarded by Da Vinci Intuitive in the United States, with further advanced robotic training in Texas. A fellowship in cosmetic gynaecology in Mumbai and a fellowship in obstetric ultrasound in Hyderabad complete the set.

Menopause is a formal part of her practice rather than an incidental one. She holds the CIMP, certification in menopause practice, and is a Certified Menopause Practitioner of the IMS. She also holds Good Clinical Practice certification.

Before KIMS she worked at Mahavir Hospital and Research Centre in Hyderabad between 2017 and 2018, and at a Community Health Centre in Vizag between 2014 and 2015.

dr-sonamm-tiwari.bio:
Dr. Sonamm Tiwari is a Senior Consultant in obstetrics and gynaecology at Gleneagles Hospital, Parel, Mumbai, with more than 10 years of experience.

Her clinical work covers endometriosis, uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding and chronic pelvic pain. She performs endometriosis surgery, ovarian cyst surgery and laparoscopic myomectomy.

She qualified M.B.B.S. and took her M.S. in Obstetrics and Gynecology. Her further qualifications divide between reproduction and technique: the FRM, a fellowship in reproductive medicine, and a Masters in Cosmetic Gynaecology on one side; the F.M.A.S. and D.M.A.S., a fellowship and a diploma in minimal access surgery, on the other. She also holds the F.I.C.R.S.

Her memberships follow the same split. She belongs to FOGSI and to the Indian Society of Assisted Reproduction, to the PCOS Society, to the World Association of Laparoscopic Surgeons and to the Indian College of Cosmetic Gynaecology.

She has published three papers as a named author. She was first author of an observational study on morbidly adherent placenta, covering its incidence, risk factors and management, in the International Journal of Scientific Research in June 2020. She was first author of a case report on pregnancy-associated hemolytic uremic syndrome in the Global Journal For Research Analysis in September 2018, and second author of a case report in the same journal in November 2019 on primary amenorrhea with a transverse vaginal septum. Her research presentations have won awards at conferences.

dr-seema-manuja.bio:
Dr. Seema Manuja is Director of Gynaecology at Sarvodaya Hospital, Sector 8, Faridabad, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 30 years of experience across obstetrics and gynaecology and infertility and IVF.

Her clinical work covers uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding, endometriosis and chronic pelvic pain, and she provides menopause management. She performs hysterectomy and laparoscopic hysterectomy, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery, endometriosis surgery, and surgery for pelvic organ prolapse.

She qualified MBBS from JN Medical College at Aligarh Muslim University in 1997 and took her MD in Obstetrics and Gynaecology at the same college in 2000. She passed MRCOG Part I with the Royal College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists in the United Kingdom in 2001, and completed a diploma in advanced laparoscopic surgery at Sunrise Institute, Kochi, in 2004.

Her career has been based in Faridabad. She has worked at Fortis Escort Hospital and Research Centre and at Escorts Hospital and Research Centre there, and earlier at GMC under Punjab University in Chandigarh and at MCKR Hospital and Research Centre in New Delhi.

She is Honorary Secretary and a life member of the Faridabad Obstetrics and Gynaecology Society, a life member of the Indian Menopause Society and a member of IAGE. Three gold medals are recorded from her training, in obstetrics and gynaecology, in ENT and in preventive and social medicine, and she took the Red Best Paper Award at Yuva FOGSI in 2004.

dr-renu-raina-sehgal.bio:
Dr. Renu Raina Sehgal is Chairperson of the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology at Artemis Hospital, Gurgaon, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 27 years of experience across obstetrics and gynaecology and infertility and IVF.

Endometriosis surgery runs through her operating list, performed both laparoscopically and robotically. She also carries out laparoscopic fertility surgery and ovarian cyst surgery, manages abnormal uterine bleeding and ovarian cysts, and on the obstetric side provides advanced obstetric surgical care and planned cesarean section.

She qualified MBBS at Baba Raghav Dass Talpan Medical College in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, and took her MD in obstetrics and gynaecology through the post-graduate programme at Sir Ganga Ram Hospital, New Delhi. She also holds a DNB from the National Board of Medical Sciences in New Delhi, the FMAS of the Association of Minimal Access Surgeons of India, and the FNAMS. Her minimal access training was a fellowship in advanced gynaecological laparoscopy at Carlton in Kerala, and she is a certified robotic console surgeon on the da Vinci robotic surgical system.

Her public recognition is broad. She has received the Financial Express Visionary Leadership Award in Healthcare, the CNRS Super Women Award from NDTV, the Priyadarshini Award for contribution to society, and an International Women's Day Partnership Achievement Award from the Carlton Foundation. Further awards include the Brand Icon of the Year Award, an Outstanding Achievement Award in the field of medicine from the Enlightened Foundation, a Special Appreciation Award from Max Healthcare, and the Distinguished Services Award of the Delhi Medical Association.

dr-n-bindu-priya.bio:
Dr. N. Bindu Priya is Consultant Urogynecologist and Gynecologist at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, Hyderabad, with more than 26 years of experience. Her work combines obstetrics and gynaecology with urogynecology.

The pelvic floor is her subspecialty. She performs pelvic organ prolapse surgery and pelvic floor repair, and her general gynaecological list includes hysterectomy and laparoscopic hysterectomy, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, endometriosis surgery and menopause management.

She qualified MBBS at S.V. Medical College, Tirupati, took her MS in obstetrics and gynaecology at Siddhartha Medical College, Vijayawada, in 2011, and a DNB in the same subject in 2012. She then trained in urogynecology at Govt. Kasturba Gandhi Women's Hospital under Dr. MGR University in Chennai.

Her later training was taken abroad in stages. She completed urogynecology training at Mercy Hospital for Women in Melbourne, an observership at Northwestern University Hospital in Chicago, and gynec endoscopy and laparoscopy training at CMUH in Taiwan. In India she took a basic gynec laparoscopy and hysteroscopy course at SCB Medical College, Cuttack, and an advanced laparoscopy course at Eva Hospital for Women in Ahmedabad. She has also worked at Chennai Fertility Centre.

Her academic record is heavily decorated. She won gold medals in physiology and otorhinolaryngology as an undergraduate and distinctions in her first and third years, was university gold medalist in MS with the Dr. NTRUHS Silver Jubilee Award, and received the Alladi Memorial Award as best outgoing student. She held an IUGA observership in 2012 and an ICS Fellowship Award at UCLH Hospital, London, in 2020.

dr-dhivya-sharona.bio:
Dr. Dhivya Sharona is a Consultant at Dr. Rela Institute and Medical Centre, Chennai, working in its Women and Children's Hospital, with more than 12 years of experience. Her profile records obstetrics and gynaecology, women's health, robotic and minimally invasive gynaecologic surgery, and high-risk pregnancy management.

She manages uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding and endometriosis. Her operating list covers hysterectomy by laparoscopic and robotic routes, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery and oophorectomy, endometriosis surgery, and therapeutic dilation and curettage.

She qualified MBBS from Meenakshi Medical College and Research Institute, Kanchipuram, between 2004 and 2010, and took her MS in obstetrics and gynaecology at Government Mohan Kumaramangalam Medical College and Hospital, Salem, between 2017 and 2020. Her DNB followed in December 2020. Since then she has added ART training at Chennai Fertility Centre in January 2022, qualified as a preventive colpologist with Sainiwas Health Care, Pune, in August 2022, and completed her FMAS in minimal access surgery in 2025.

Earlier posts were at Kilpauk Medical College in Chennai, at Erode Medical College in Perundurai, at the Government Hospital in Erode and at Lotus Multispeciality Hospital, Erode.

Her research covers labour analgesia and obstetric outcome in heart disease complicating pregnancy, published in URCOG in March 2020, and the prevalence of gestational diabetes mellitus using the 75mg GCT, published in April 2020. She holds the Dr. Chellammal Gold Medal from the 2020 OG exit examination and a Times of India Service Excellence Award.

dr-alka-gujral.bio:
Dr. Alka Gujral is Principal Director at Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 45 years of experience in obstetrics and gynaecology and in gynaecologic laparoscopy.

Her clinical work covers abnormal uterine bleeding and post-menopausal bleeding, uterine fibroids and adenomyosis, ovarian cysts, endometriosis and chronic pelvic pain, together with menopause management. She performs laparoscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery and oophorectomy, endometriosis surgery, and surgery for pelvic organ prolapse.

Her training was completed at Agra Medical College, where she qualified M.B.B.S. with honours in 1977 and took her M.S. in obstetrics and gynaecology in 1981. She is a Fellow of the Indian College of Maternal and Child Health.

Her career has run through many of the Delhi hospitals. She currently practises at Max Hospital in Saket and at Max Hospital, Panchsheel Park, and has previously worked at Fortis La Femme in Greater Kailash, at Moolchand Hospital, at Sita Ram Bhartiya Institute and at M.C.K.R. Hospital.

Her conference record spans two decades. She took the Best Paper Award at the 3rd National Conference of the Indian Academy of Human Reproduction in 1995, certificates of appreciation at the 19th annual AOGD conference in 1997, at the joint 20th AOGD and NAVSFWI conference in 1998 and at a live workshop on fibroids in 2002, and the Dr. Sheila Mehra Endoscopy Award for the best presentation on endoscopy in obstetrics and gynaecology at the 24th AICC RCOG Conference in New Delhi in 2009.

dr-radhika-reddy-y.bio:
Dr. Radhika Reddy Y. is Senior Consultant Obstetrician and Gynaecologist and a Laparoscopic and Robotic Surgeon at Yashoda Hospitals, Hi-Tech City, Hyderabad, with more than 23 years of experience.

Her practice covers uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding, endometriosis and chronic pelvic pain. She performs hysterectomy and laparoscopic hysterectomy, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery and oophorectomy, endometriosis surgery, and surgery for pelvic organ prolapse. Urinary incontinence is managed here too, including sling surgery, which is not on every gynaecologist's list.

She qualified MBBS at Kasturba Medical College, Manipal, in 1993 and took her DNB at Mahavir Hospital and Research Centre, Hyderabad, in 2001. She is MNAMS in obstetrics and gynaecology through the National Academy of Medical Sciences in New Delhi, a Member of the Royal College of Obstetrics and Gynaecology in London, and a Fellow of the Indian College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists.

Alongside her present post she has worked at Yashoda Hospitals, Somajiguda, at Rainbow Children's Hospital and BirthRight in Banjara Hills and Kondapur, and at Vijay Marie Hospital in Hyderabad.

Her recorded academic interests are advanced gynae laparoscopic and hysteroscopic surgeries, and high-risk obstetrics and critical care. She is a member of FOGSI, of the Indian Society of Perinatology and Reproductive Biology, and of the Society of Endoscopic and Laproscopic Surgeons of India.

dr-anuranjita-pallavi.bio:
Dr. Anuranjita Pallavi is a Consultant Gynecologist and Infertility Specialist at Medicover Hospitals, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai, with more than 17 years of experience across obstetrics and gynaecology and infertility and IVF.

Her clinical work covers uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts and abnormal uterine bleeding. She performs hysterectomy and laparoscopic hysterectomy, laparoscopic myomectomy and hysteroscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery, endometriosis surgery, pelvic floor repair and surgery for pelvic organ prolapse.

She qualified MBBS and took her MS in obstetrics and gynecology as a gold medalist. Her subspecialty qualification is the FRM, a fellowship in reproductive medicine, which is the formal basis for the infertility half of her title.

Before her present post she worked at D.Y. Patil Hospital in Navi Mumbai and at Apollo Fertility, also in Navi Mumbai.

Her published work concerns polycystic ovary syndrome. Her study of metformin effects on PCOS won the Best Paper Award at the KSOGA state conference and was published in an indexed journal, and she presented a poster at the KSOGA state conference in Hubli, Karnataka, in 2013.

She is registered with the Maharashtra Medical Council and is a member of FOGSI, of the Navi Mumbai Obstetrics and Gynaecology Society, of the Bangalore Society of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, and of the Indian Fertility Society.

dr-swaramya-chandrasekaran.bio:
Dr. Swaramya Chandrasekaran is a Senior Consultant at Dr. Rela Institute and Medical Centre, Chennai, in its Women and Children's Hospital, with more than 15 years of experience in obstetrics and gynaecology and women's health.

Her clinical work covers uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding and endometriosis. She performs hysterectomy and laparoscopic hysterectomy, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery and oophorectomy, endometriosis surgery, and hysteroscopic polypectomy with uterine polyp removal.

She qualified MBBS from JSS Medical College under Rajiv Gandhi University in Mysore between 2005 and 2011, and took her MS in obstetrics and gynaecology at JIPMER, Pondicherry, between 2012 and 2015. She completed the FOGSI laparoscopy course at Aakash Hospital and Aaditya Fertility Centre, Chennai, in 2019.

Her earlier posts were at Madras Medical College in Chennai, at JIPMER in Pondicherry, at Sri Venkateshwaraa Medical College and Research Centre in Pondicherry, and at Sova Health between 2021 and 2023.

She has published widely for a clinician at this stage of her career. She contributed a book chapter on thyroid disease in pregnancy and its clinical management to a Springer publication, and has written on metabolic syndrome in women with polycystic ovary syndrome, on transvaginal ultrasound in obstetric anal sphincter injuries, and on the impact of the Sova Health precision nutrition programme on metabolic parameters in type 2 diabetes and dyslipidemia. A retrospective analysis of tubal ectopic pregnancy in a rural tertiary care hospital in India, and case reports on uterine myxoid leiomyosarcoma and on severe congestive dysmenorrhea in an adolescent, complete the list.

dr-swati-allahbadia.bio:
Dr. Swati Allahbadia is a Senior Consultant at Gleneagles Hospital, Parel, Mumbai, with more than 32 years of experience in obstetrics and gynaecology and in infertility and IVF.

Her clinical work covers uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding and endometriosis. Her operating list moves from the office procedure to the major operation: therapeutic dilation and curettage, endometrial ablation, hysteroscopic polypectomy and uterine polyp removal at one end; ovarian cyst surgery, endometriosis surgery, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, and hysterectomy by laparoscopic or open route at the other.

She qualified MBBS and took an MD, together with a DGO in gynaecology and obstetrics. Her endoscopic qualification, the DGE, is a diploma in gynecological endoscopy taken in Germany.

What the record shows most clearly is the breadth of her hospital career, all of it in Mumbai. She has worked at Nowrosjee Wadia Maternity Hospital, at Bombay Hospital Institute of Medical Sciences, at Prince Aly Khan Hospital, at Breach Candy Hospital and at SL Raheja Hospital under Fortis. Her teaching hospital posts were at KEM Hospital with Seth G.S. Medical College and at L.T.M.G.H. with L.T.M.M.C., and she has also worked at Kherwadi Maternity Hospital and at Matoshri Ramabai Ambedkar Maternity Hospital. That is ten institutions in one city, spanning maternity units, teaching hospitals and private tertiary centres.

dr-ruplin-terangpi.bio:
Dr. Ruplin Terangpi is a Consultant in obstetrics and gynaecology at Apollo Hospitals, Navi Mumbai, with more than 15 years of experience.

Her clinical work covers uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding, endometriosis and chronic pelvic pain. She performs hysterectomy and laparoscopic hysterectomy, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery, endometriosis surgery, and therapeutic dilation and curettage.

She qualified MBBS and holds both an MD and a DNB in obstetrics and gynecology, together with a fellowship in reproductive medicine.

What stands out on her record is how much of it is professional office rather than clinical detail. She has been recognised as Best Vice Chancellor by the Indian College of Critical Care Medicine and as Best President of Active Young Obstetricians and Gynecologists International, and holds a Presidential Honor from the Indian Society of Critical Care Medicine. Critical care therefore runs alongside her obstetric practice in the roles she has held.

Her awards include Best Doctor from the Indian Medical Association and a Best Doctor Award from the FOGSI Medical University, a Professional Excellence Award in Healthcare from Galaxy International, a Fellow Award for Excellence at Placenta, and a Young Achiever Award from the Heritage Group of Institutions. Her Best Paper Award was for evidence-based clinical care in obstetric practice.

dr-pranavi-nagendla.bio:
Dr. Pranavi Nagendla is a Senior Consultant at Medicover Hospital on Whitefield Road, Bengaluru, with more than 12 years of experience across obstetrics and gynaecology and infertility and IVF.

Her clinical work covers uterine fibroids and adenomyosis, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding, endometriosis and chronic pelvic pain management. Endometriosis appears twice in her profile, once as surgery and once as treatment, so the condition is managed medically as well as operatively. Her operating list runs to hysterectomy and laparoscopic hysterectomy, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery, endometriosis surgery, therapeutic dilation and curettage, and pelvic organ prolapse surgery.

She qualified MBBS at Government Siddhartha Medical College, Vijayawada, under NTR University of Health Sciences, and took her DNB in obstetrics and gynaecology at Bangalore Baptist Hospital through the National Board of Examinations. She also holds an MS in the same subject. Her fertility qualifications are the F.IVF and a fellowship in fertility and laparoscopy taken in Bangalore. Alongside those she has specialized training in high-risk obstetrics and in minimally invasive gynecology, which is the pairing her present practice reflects.

Her affiliations outside Medicover run to Ovum Hospitals, Cloudnine Hospitals, Columbia Asia Hospitals and RDT Hospital in Andhra Pradesh, a set weighted towards women's and children's units.

She was named best outgoing of the department during her postgraduate training at Bangalore Baptist Hospital, and is separately certified in laparoscopy and fertility. She is a member of FOGSI, the Federation of Obstetric and Gynaecological Societies of India.

dr-vivek-marwah.bio:
Dr. Vivek Marwah is Principal Director of the Division of Minimally Invasive Gynaecology at Max Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 38 years of experience across obstetrics and gynaecology and infertility and IVF.

His operating practice is built around keyhole surgery. He performs laparoscopic hysterectomy and hysterectomy, laparoscopic myomectomy and myomectomy, hysteroscopic polypectomy and uterine polyp removal, ovarian cyst surgery and endometriosis surgery. He manages uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding and chronic pelvic pain, and provides IVF treatment.

He qualified M.B.B.S. and took his M.S. in gynaecology at NSCB Medical College under R.D. University in Jabalpur. His subspecialty training was a fellowship and observership in the Division of Minimally Invasive Gynaecology at Max Super Speciality Hospital, New Delhi, the unit he now heads. He teaches as a faculty member at the Ethicon Institute of Surgical Education in New Delhi and at CEMAST in Mumbai.

Two entries stand out on his record. In 2000 the American Association of Gynecologic Laparoscopists gave him the Kurt Semm Award for Excellence in Pelviscopy at the Global Congress on Gynecologic Endoscopy in Orlando, making him the first Indian to receive it. In 2009 he set a Guinness World Record by removing a 3.9 kg uterus laparoscopically.

He has also worked at Sir Ganga Ram Hospital in New Delhi, at NMC Noida and at Escorts Hospital in Faridabad, and belongs to the International Society of Gynecologic Endoscopists and the Indian Academy of Human Reproduction among other bodies.

dr-shradha-chaudhari.bio:
Dr. Shradha Chaudhari is Associate Director at Medanta – The Medicity, Gurugram, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 25 years of experience. She also consults at Medanta MediClinic in Defence Colony, New Delhi.

Her operating range is unusually wide and covers three distinct areas. In benign gynaecology she performs hysterectomy by laparoscopic, robotic and vaginal routes, myomectomy laparoscopically, robotically and hysteroscopically, hysteroscopic polypectomy, ovarian cyst surgery, oophorectomy and laparoscopic endometriosis surgery. In urogynaecology she carries out pelvic floor repair surgery, vaginal prolapse surgery and sling surgery for urinary incontinence. In gynaecologic oncology she performs radical hysterectomy, ovarian cancer surgery, cervical cancer surgery and robotic gynecologic oncology surgery.

Her qualifications map onto those three areas. She qualified M.B.B.S. and took her M.D. in obstetrics and gynaecology at the College of Physicians and Surgeons. She holds a fellowship of the Indian College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists, a diploma in urogynaecology and pelvic floor reconstruction, a diploma in minimally invasive surgery, and a fellowship in cosmetic gynecology. Her oncology training was an observership at Tata Memorial Hospital.

She served as joint treasurer and executive committee member of FPSI India in 2002, the same year she took the Best Paper Award at AMOGS Akola, and was organising joint secretary of AGOICON in 2016. Her publications have appeared in international and Indian journals.

dr-neena-desai.bio:
Dr. Neena Desai is a Consultant and former Head of Department in obstetrics and gynaecology at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, Hyderabad. Her record shows more than 55 years in practice, which makes her one of the longest-serving gynaecologists on this list.

Her clinical range is general gynaecology at its widest. She manages abnormal uterine bleeding, uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, endometriosis, chronic pelvic pain and post-menopausal bleeding, and provides menopause management. Operatively she performs hysterectomy and laparoscopic hysterectomy, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery, endometriosis surgery, pelvic organ prolapse surgery, and uterine polyp removal by hysteroscopic polypectomy.

Her qualifications span three decades of study.
