She took her MBBS at the University of Calcutta in 1965 and her D.G.O. there in 1970, then her M.D. in obstetrics and gynaecology at Osmania University in November 1972, followed by the D.N.B. Alongside KIMS Hospital, Secunderabad, she has been associated with Mahavir Hospital.

Teaching is a formal part of her role: she trains post-graduate students and is a recognized teacher and guide for the DNB in obstetrics and gynaecology under the National Board. She received the IMA Fellowship Award in 1987 and the Rani Jhansi Award from Samaj Samithi, Hyderabad.

Her work outside the hospital is documented too. She is an active member of the Indian Red Cross Society and has taken part with First Lady Dr. Haripriya Rangarajan in rehabilitation programmes for disabled children, and she has conducted approximately 80 health camps across Nalgonda District and Hyderabad. She has published a paper on DNA disintegration for cervical cancer.

dr-sohani-verma.bio:
Dr. Sohani Verma is a Senior Consultant at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in the Delhi NCR, with more than 35 years of experience across obstetrics and gynaecology and infertility and IVF.

Minimal access surgery carries much of her operating list. She performs laparoscopic hysterectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, hysteroscopic myomectomy and hysteroscopic polypectomy, laparoscopic endometriosis surgery, ovarian cyst surgery, pelvic floor repair surgery and therapeutic dilation and curettage. On the obstetric side she provides advanced obstetric surgical care and planned cesarean section, and she also manages abnormal uterine bleeding, ovarian cysts and chronic pelvic pain.

She holds an MBBS and an MS in obstetrics and gynaecology, and her further training was a fellowship in reproductive medicine and gynaecological surgery. Before her present post at Apollo Hospital in South Delhi she was associated with Sir Ganga Ram Hospital and with Fortis Hospital, both in New Delhi.

Her academic record is substantial. She has co-authored the best paper at the All India Obstetrics and Gynecology Annual Meet on polycystic ovary syndrome and associated conditions in more than one year, and has been recognised at the AICC RCOG. She has published and presented research on cervical cancer prevention, polycystic ovary syndrome and recurrent pregnancy loss at national and international forums.

Her other honours include the Liberal Memorial Award of FOGSI and the Dr. Batra's Positive Health Award. In professional bodies she has served as Vice President of the Delhi Fertility Society and as an executive member of both the Delhi Gynecological Society and the Indian Fertility Society.

dr-pallavi-vasal.bio:
Dr. Pallavi Vasal is Clinical Director at Marengo Asia Hospital, Gurugram, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 20 years of experience in gynaecology.

Her operating list is built around the choice between laparoscopic and robotic routes. She performs hysterectomy and myomectomy by both, and treats endometriosis by both keyhole and robotic surgery, the robotic option recorded in her profile for its precision and faster recovery. Pelvic floor repair surgery covers vaginal prolapse and other pelvic floor disorders, and she also manages abnormal uterine bleeding and ovarian cysts and offers comprehensive evaluation and treatment for chronic pelvic pain. Her obstetric work is advanced obstetric surgical care and planned cesarean section for high-risk pregnancies and deliveries.

Her training moved from India to the United Kingdom and the USA. She qualified MBBS at SSMC and took the DGO at MGM Medical College, Indore, as a gold medalist. She then took the MRCOG in London and the FMAS, a fellowship in laparoscopic surgery for obstetrics and gynaecology. Her robotic qualification is the MINT from Harvard Medical School, and she is separately a certified contraception and family planning provider.

She is a member of the Royal College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists through the MRCOG. Within Indian professional bodies she is a member of FOGSI and of the Gurgaon Association of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, and she has served as Treasurer of the Haryana Association of Obstetrics and Gynaecology and as Clinical Research Secretary of HAGE.

dr-p-usha.bio:
Dr. P. Usha is a Visiting Consultant at Rela Hospital in Chennai, with more than 19 years of experience in obstetrics and gynaecology.

Her list mixes benign gynaecology with a gynaecologic oncology subspecialty. She manages uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding, endometriosis, post-menopausal bleeding and menopause. Operatively she performs hysterectomy by laparoscopic and vaginal routes, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery, endometriosis surgery, endometrial ablation and pelvic organ prolapse surgery.

Her qualifications were taken in Chennai. She read MBBS at Stanley Medical College between 2002 and 2007, then took her MD in obstetrics and gynaecology at the Institute of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Madras Medical College, between 2010 and 2013. Her minimal access qualifications are the D.LAP and the FMAS. She returned to Madras Medical College for a post-doctoral fellowship in gynae oncology between 2018 and 2020, which is the origin of the oncology strand in her practice.

Her shorter training sits behind specific parts of that list: ultrasound at the Selvi School of Sonology, non-descent vaginal hysterectomy in Orissa, hands-on hysteroscopy, and a refresher course in diabetology.

Within Rela she works in the Women and Children's Hospital and in the Onco Fertility Department at the IRM, and she has also been associated with Pankajam Memorial Hospital. Her research follows the same oncology line, covering the concordance between pre-operative and post-operative histopathology in EIN and carcinoma endometrium, and the evaluation and management of suspicious adnexal masses in pregnancy.

dr-kiranjeet-kaur.bio:
Dr. Kiranjeet Kaur is a Principal Consultant at Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 29 years of experience across obstetrics and gynaecology and infertility and IVF.

She manages uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding, endometriosis, chronic pelvic pain, post-menopausal bleeding and menopause. Her operating list runs to hysterectomy and laparoscopic hysterectomy, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, oophorectomy, ovarian cyst surgery, endometriosis surgery, pelvic organ prolapse surgery and uterine polyp removal by hysteroscopic polypectomy.

Her qualifications were taken in Delhi. She read MBBS at Lady Hardinge Medical College in 1997, took the DGO at Maulana Azad Medical College and Lok Nayak Jai Prakash, and the DNB in obstetrics and gynaecology at Deen Dayal Upadhyay Hospital in 2004.

Three later fellowships build directly on that base. She took a fellowship in minimal access surgery at World Laparoscopy Hospital, Gurugram, in 2012, a fellowship in gynaecological 3D endoscopy at the Akola Endoscopy Centre in Akola, Maharashtra, in 2016, and a fellowship in obstetrics and gynaecology from the Indian College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists, Mumbai, in 2019.

Her posts have included work in the United Kingdom as well as India. Alongside Max Healthcare and Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital in Saket, she has been at Cloudnine Hospital in Kailash Colony, at Torbay Hospital under the South Devon Healthcare NHS Trust, and at Pembury Hospital under the Maidstone and Tunbridge Wells NHS Trust. She was credentialed as an IMS menopause practitioner by the Indian Menopause Society at Surat in 2022.

dr-m-madhavi.bio:
Dr. M. Madhavi is a Senior Consultant at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, Hyderabad, with more than 27 years of experience across obstetrics and gynaecology and infertility and IVF.

Her clinical range covers uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding, endometriosis and chronic pelvic pain, together with menopause management. Endometriosis appears in her profile as both surgery and treatment, so the condition is handled medically as well as operatively. Her operating list includes hysterectomy and laparoscopic hysterectomy, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, oophorectomy, ovarian cyst surgery, endometriosis surgery and pelvic organ prolapse surgery.

She holds the M.B.B.S. and the D.G.O., and her three fellowships map onto the three strands of her practice: minimal invasive surgery, reproductive medicine, and robotic surgery on the Da Vinci Xi Surgical System.

Her society work is extensive. She is a life member of FOGSI, IAGE, SOVSI, ISOPARB and IMS, an executive member of the Hyderabad Menopause Society, and a convenor at the Dr. LN Gupta Memorial Health Centre of the Exhibition Society in Nampally, Hyderabad.

Her recognition has come in three forms. She received an Award of Outstanding Excellence in Healthcare in the field of obstetrics and gynaecology at the Drs Excellence Awards 2025, and was recognised at AICOG 2024 in Hyderabad for outstanding contribution to women's health. She has separately received the DHEERA Award for sensitising women against domestic violence, which places public advocacy alongside the surgical and fertility sides of her work.

dr-reshma-krishnan.bio:
Dr. Reshma Krishnan is Consultant in Fetal Medicine and Sonology at Medicover Hospital, Bangalore, in Bengaluru, with more than 27 years of experience in obstetrics and gynaecology.

Imaging defines her role, and her qualifications follow it. She holds an MBBS, the DGO, a PGDHA, and an advanced certification in fetal medicine and gynae USG, the last of which is what her present designation rests on.

Her clinical range on the gynaecology side covers uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, adenomyosis, abnormal uterine bleeding, chronic pelvic pain, post-menopausal bleeding and menopause. Endometriosis appears in her profile as both treatment and surgery, and her operative entries are endometriosis surgery, ovarian cyst surgery and laparoscopic myomectomy.

Her hospital history is spread across Bengaluru. Alongside Medicover Hospital she has been associated with Apollo Cradle Hospitals, with Manipal Hospitals and with Ovum Hospitals, all in the same city.

Her memberships sit squarely with the ultrasound and fetal medicine side of the specialty rather than with general gynaecology. She belongs to the Medical Ultrasound Society of Karnataka, to the Society of Fetal Medicine, and to the International Society of Ultrasound in Obstetrics and Gynecology, the last of these being the international body for the field she practises in.

That focus has been recognised locally. In 2024 the Golden Aim Awards named her the most trusted fetal medicine speciality in Bangalore, citing advanced fetal care, accurate diagnosis and patient-focused treatment.

dr-madhu-roy.bio:
Dr. Madhu Roy is a Senior Consultant at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in the Delhi NCR, with more than 20 years of experience in obstetrics and gynaecology.

Her clinical work covers uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding, chronic pelvic pain and menopause. Her operating list runs to hysterectomy and laparoscopic hysterectomy, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery, endometriosis surgery, pelvic organ prolapse surgery, therapeutic dilation and curettage, and uterine polyp removal by hysteroscopic polypectomy.

She holds an MBBS and the DNB in obstetrics and gynaecology. Her subspecialty qualification is a fellowship in reproductive medicine, and she is a Fellow of the Indian Academy of Clinical Medicine, the FIACM.

Her hospital history runs across several Delhi groups. Alongside Indraprastha Apollo Hospital she has been associated with MERCY Super Speciality Hospital, with Amrita Hospital, with Cloudnine Hospital and with Apollo Spectra Hospitals.

Fertility work is the part of her practice that has drawn recognition. She was named Best in Class for IVF at the IIMG FICCI HEAL awards, and she has separately received the MERCY Award from that institution. Her published research is in the same area, covering IVF, twin pregnancy and other obstetric conditions.

Taken together, the record describes a gynaecologist whose theatre list is largely minimal access and whose second qualification and published output both sit on the reproductive medicine side, in a practice built across the Delhi private hospital network over two decades.

dr-anuradha-panda.bio:
Dr. Anuradha Panda is Consultant in Obstetrics and Gynecology and Robotic Surgery at Apollo Hospital, Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad, with more than 18 years of experience across obstetrics and gynaecology and infertility and IVF.

Robotics is named in her designation, and the operating list reflects it. She performs hysterectomy, myomectomy and endometriosis surgery by both laparoscopic and robotic routes, so the same three operations appear twice in her profile under two different approaches. Hysteroscopy adds hysteroscopic myomectomy and hysteroscopic polypectomy, and the rest of the list is laparoscopic fertility surgery, ovarian cyst surgery, pelvic floor repair surgery and advanced obstetric surgical care.

Her qualifications were taken in India and in the UK. She holds an MBBS and an MD, the DNB, and both the MRCOG and the FRCOG of the Royal College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists. She practises at Apollo Health City in Jubilee Hills.

Maternal health is where her public recognition sits. She was appointed PMSMA Ambassador for Telangana by the PMO and PMSMA National Fellow for All India in the field of maternal health. She was named Best Young Gynecologist by the Times of India and T-Hub in 2019 and received a Best Doctor award for the South in 2020.

Her writing follows the same subject. She has published research on maternal health in peer-reviewed journals, including the Indian Journal of Clinical Practice, and has authored articles for FOGSI Focus publications.

dr-anusha-rao-p.bio:
Dr. Anusha Rao P is a Consultant at Yashoda Hospitals, Secunderabad, Hyderabad, with more than 15 years of experience across obstetrics and gynaecology and infertility and IVF.

She manages uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding, chronic pelvic pain, post-menopausal bleeding and menopause. Her operating list covers hysterectomy and laparoscopic hysterectomy, laparoscopic myomectomy and hysteroscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery, endometriosis surgery and pelvic organ prolapse surgery.

Her qualifications are the MBBS and an MS in obstetrics and gynaecology, followed by the FMAS, a fellowship in minimal access surgery, and the MRCOG of the Royal College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists in the United Kingdom. The two postgraduate additions account for the keyhole weighting of her list.

Her memberships follow the same division. She belongs to FOGSI on the obstetrics and gynaecology side and to AMASI, the Association of Minimal Access Surgeons of India, on the surgical side, and she is registered with the Telangana State Medical Council.

Her academic record is small but specific. She took first prize in obstetric medicine for a poster on a case of postpartum cerebral angiopathy at the International Conference on Pregnancy in High Risk Patients in Hyderabad in July 2015. Her research includes a study for NTRUHS on the cardiotocogram as an admission test to predict fetal outcome in labour in a low risk group, and a paper on the laparoscopic management of a massive recurrent endometrioma with atypical presentation, published in the Journal of Endometriosis and Pelvic Pain Disorders in April 2020.

dr-sahana-k-p.bio:
Dr. Sahana K P is a Consultant Obstetrician and Gynecologist at Apollo Hospitals in Bengaluru, with more than 14 years of experience in obstetrics and gynaecology.

Her operating list is almost entirely minimal access. She performs laparoscopic hysterectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, laparoscopic endometriosis surgery and ovarian cyst surgery, hysteroscopic myomectomy and hysteroscopic polypectomy, and therapeutic dilation and curettage. Her obstetric work is advanced obstetric surgical care and planned cesarean section, and she also manages abnormal uterine bleeding, ovarian cysts and chronic pelvic pain.

She qualified MBBS at the Kempegowda Institute of Medical Sciences in Bangalore and took her MS in obstetrics and gynaecology. Her later qualifications are the FMAS, a fellowship in minimal access surgery that matches the shape of her list, and the FICMCH of the Indian College of Maternal and Child Health.

Her early career was academic. She was a post-senior resident in the Department of OBG at the Kempegowda Institute of Medical Sciences between 2013 and 2014, then Assistant Professor in the Department of OBG at KLE University's BGS Hospital in Kengeri, Bangalore, between 2014 and 2015.

Her hospital history since then has been spread widely across the city. Her current post is at Apollo Hospital in Seshadripuram, and she has also been associated with Manipal Hospital in Sarjapur, Narayana Health in Whitefield, Kangaroo Care Hospital in Indiranagar, KLE University's BGS Hospital in Kengeri, and the Arpita Women's Health Clinic on Siddesh Hankal Road in Dasarahalli.

dr-a-jaishree-gajaraj.bio:
Dr. A Jaishree Gajaraj is Head of Obstetrics and Gynaecology at MGM Healthcare in Chennai. With more than 42 years in practice, she is among the most experienced gynaecologists in the city.

Her clinical range is general gynaecology across the benign spectrum. She manages uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding, endometriosis, chronic pelvic pain and menopause. Operatively she performs hysterectomy and laparoscopic hysterectomy, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery, endometriosis surgery, pelvic organ prolapse surgery, pelvic floor repair, and uterine polyp removal by hysteroscopic polypectomy.

Her qualifications were all taken at the University of Madras in Chennai, Tamil Nadu: the MBBS in 1980, the DGO in 1984, and the MD in obstetrics and gynaecology in 1988. Her UK qualifications followed in the next decade. She became a Member of the Royal College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists in 1992 and a Fellow of the Royal College of Surgeons of Edinburgh in 1993, and she was later elected a Fellow of the Royal College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists.

That connection carries into her society work, where she belongs to the Association of TamilNadu Members of RCOG. Her other memberships are the Indian Menopause Society, which matches the menopause management entry on her clinical list, and the Obstetric and Gynaecological Society of Southern India. Her practice is based at MGM Healthcare.

dr-shashikala-jain.bio:
Dr. Shashikala Jain is Chief Gynecologist and Consultant at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, Hyderabad, with more than 42 years of experience in obstetrics and gynaecology.

Her practice is general gynaecology across the benign range. She manages uterine fibroids, adenomyosis, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding, endometriosis and chronic pelvic pain, and provides menopause management. Endometriosis appears in her profile as both treatment and surgery, so the condition is handled medically as well as in theatre. Her operating list covers hysterectomy and laparoscopic hysterectomy, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery, endometriosis surgery, pelvic organ prolapse surgery, and therapeutic dilation and curettage.

She took her M.B.B.S. at Govt. Stanley Medical College in Chennai in 1986 and her D.G.O. at Govt. Kurnool Medical College in Kurnool between 1990 and 1992. Her one recorded academic distinction predates both: first prize in an essay competition in 1984 on recent trends in the treatment of Hansen's disease.

Her hospital history runs across two cities and four decades. She was at the Institute of Child Health Hospital for Children in Egmore, Chennai, between 1988 and 1989, then in Hyderabad at Vijay Marie Hospital between 1993 and 1994, at Mahavir Hospitals and Research Centre between 1994 and 1995, and at Fernandez Maternity Hospital Pvt. Ltd. between 1998 and 2000. Her present base is the Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences on Minister Road in Secunderabad.

She is a member of the Federation of Obstetricians and Gynecologists of India and a life member of the Indian Medical Association.

dr-sarada-m.bio:
Dr. Sarada M is a Senior Consultant at Yashoda Hospitals, Somajiguda, Hyderabad, with more than 26 years of experience in obstetrics and gynaecology.

Her clinical work covers uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding, endometriosis and chronic pelvic pain, with endometriosis listed as both treatment and surgery. In theatre she performs hysterectomy by laparoscopic and vaginal routes, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery and endometriosis surgery.

Her qualifications were accumulated over more than a decade. She read MBBS at Kurnool Medical College under NTR University of Health Sciences in May 1997, took her DGO at Osmania Medical College in Hyderabad under the same university in December 2000, and the DNB at St Theresa's General Hospital in Hyderabad through the National Board of Examinations in December 2011.

Between those two Indian postgraduate degrees she took the MRCOG of the Royal College of Obstetrics and Gynecology in the UK in May 2008, and she was later elected FRCOG, a Fellow of the Royal College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists. She also holds the MICOG as a member of the Indian College of Obstetrics and Gynaecology.

Her minimal access qualifications were both taken at the University of Kiel in Germany: a fellowship in laparoscopic surgery and a fellowship in gynaecological endoscopy. That training accounts for the keyhole weighting of her operating list.

She won first prize for a paper on adolescent gynecological problems, an observational study, at the FOGSI State Conference in Vizag in June 2011, and was named Rising Star of the Year in obstetrics and gynaecology at the Times Health Achievers Awards in 2017.

dr-rupali-goyal.bio:
Dr. Rupali Goyal is a Senior Consultant at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in the Delhi NCR, with more than 23 years of experience in obstetrics and gynaecology.

Her clinical range covers uterine fibroids, abnormal uterine bleeding and endometriosis, the last listed as both treatment and surgery. Her operating list is hysterectomy and laparoscopic hysterectomy, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, endometriosis surgery, and uterine polyp removal by hysteroscopic polypectomy.

Reproductive medicine is her formal subspecialty. She holds the FNB in reproductive medicine from AIIMS, New Delhi, alongside an MBBS and an MD in obstetrics and gynaecology. Her minimal access qualifications are the FMAS and the DMAS, a fellowship and a diploma in minimal access surgery, which together account for the laparoscopic and hysteroscopic weighting of her list. She has also practised at Apollo Hospitals in Noida.

Her published output is the fullest part of her record. She has written chapters in academic publications on endometriosis in pregnancy, pregnancy complications and ultrasonography, and her papers have appeared in the European Journal of Obstetrics and Gynecology and Reproductive Biology, in the Indian Fertility and Sterility Research Journal, and in the AOGS Bulletin. Her research subjects include pregnancy-related complications, reproductive endocrinology, Fanconi Bickel Syndrome and early pregnancy outcomes.

She has twice won poster presentations at national meetings, at AFRCI in 2018 and at NARCI in 2019. Taken together the record describes a gynaecologist whose theatre work is minimal access and whose academic output sits on the reproductive medicine and early pregnancy side.

dr-prapti-modi.bio:
Dr. Prapti Modi is an Associate Consultant at Sarvodaya Hospital, Faridabad, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 10 years of experience in gynaecology.

Her clinical range is wide for the length of her career. She manages uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding, endometriosis and chronic pelvic pain, and provides menopause management, with endometriosis recorded as both treatment and surgery. Her operating list covers hysterectomy and laparoscopic hysterectomy, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery, endometriosis surgery, pelvic organ prolapse surgery, endometrial ablation, and uterine polyp removal by hysteroscopic polypectomy.

She qualified MBBS at the SS Institute of Medical Sciences and Research Centre in Davangere, Karnataka, under the Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences, and took her MD in obstetrics and gynaecology at King George's Medical College in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. She also holds the DNB. Two further credentials map directly onto her list: the FMAS, a fellowship in minimal access surgery, and the CIMP, which credentials her as an IMS menopause practitioner.

Her recognition comes from her training years and from national meetings. She received the Dr. P.L. Mahajan Gold Medal for most humane resident of the year at King George Medical College, took third prize in a quiz competition on biochemical aneuploidy screening and the genetic sonogram in the Sono Web Series on the second trimester obstetric scan, and third prize for a poster at North Zone Yuva FOGSI 2020.

She is a member of FOGSI, of UPCOG and of the IMS.

dr-deepika-aggarwal.bio:
Dr. Deepika Aggarwal is Chief of Laparoscopic Gynae and Robotic Surgery at Artemis Hospital in the Delhi NCR, with more than 28 years of experience. Her profile records three strands: obstetrics and gynaecology, surgical infertility and IVF, and gynecologic surgical oncology.

Robotic and laparoscopic routes dominate her theatre list. Robotically she performs hysterectomy, myomectomy, endometriosis surgery, gynecologic oncology surgery and pelvic floor surgery; laparoscopically she performs hysterectomy, myomectomy and endometriosis surgery. Hysteroscopy adds hysteroscopic myomectomy and hysteroscopic polypectomy, and she also carries out ovarian cyst surgery, pelvic floor repair surgery and vaginal prolapse surgery. Her obstetric work is advanced obstetric surgical care and planned cesarean section, and she manages uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts and abnormal uterine bleeding.

Her qualifications were taken in Delhi and then in London. She read MBBS at UCMS and GTB Hospital in Delhi between 1992 and 1998 and took the DGO at Maulana Azad Medical College and LNJP Hospital in 2001. In London she took the MRCOG in 2005 and the CCT in obstetrics and gynaecology in 2011, both through the RCOG, and was elected FRCOG in 2018.

Three further accreditations sit behind specific parts of her practice: advanced labour ward accreditation from the RCOG in 2009, advanced laparoscopy accreditation from the RCOG in 2011, and BSSCP certification from the British Society for Colposcopy and Cervical Pathology in 2009. She is certified on the Da Vinci Surgical System and practises at Artemis Hospitals in Gurugram.

dr-deepa-maheshwari.bio:
Dr. Deepa Maheshwari is Unit Head of the Department of Maternity, Obstetrics and Gynaecology at Artemis Hospital in the Delhi NCR, with more than 20 years of experience across obstetrics and gynaecology and infertility and IVF.

Her theatre work is almost entirely minimal access. She performs laparoscopic hysterectomy as advanced minimally invasive management of uterine conditions, laparoscopic myomectomy for fibroids, hysteroscopic myomectomy for submucosal fibroids, hysteroscopic polypectomy for uterine polyps, laparoscopic endometriosis surgery and ovarian cyst surgery. Therapeutic dilation and curettage covers her diagnostic work. Medically she manages uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts and abnormal uterine bleeding, and on the obstetric side her profile records pregnancy care with both normal and cesarean delivery services.

She holds an MBBS and took her MS in obstetrics and gynaecology at Srirama Chandra Hospital and GME in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. She is a Fellow of the Academy of Medical Sciences, the FAMS.

Her hospital history runs from London to Gurugram. She has worked at Morsley Hospital in London and at Max Hospital in Gurugram, and her current post is as Unit Head at Artemis Hospital in Gurugram, Haryana.

Her recognition spans her student years and her present role. She won gold and silver medals in MBBS, and a best paper award at an international oncology conference. She now acts as guide and co-guide to DNB students in the Department of OB-GYN at Artemis Hospital, and has presented posters and papers at gynecological conferences.

dr-sonia-naik.bio:
Dr. Sonia Naik is Principal Director of Obstetrics and Gynaecology at Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 20 years of experience across obstetrics and gynaecology and infertility and IVF.

She manages uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding, chronic pelvic pain, post-menopausal bleeding and menopause. Her operating list covers hysterectomy and laparoscopic hysterectomy, laparoscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery, pelvic organ prolapse surgery, and uterine polyp removal by hysteroscopic polypectomy.

Her qualifications were taken across three states. She read MBBS at Bhopal University in Madhya Pradesh, took her MD in obstetrics and gynaecology at Pandit Jawahar Lal Nehru Medical College in Raipur, and her PGT in the same subject at RML Hospital in Delhi.

Two periods of further training sit behind the two halves of her practice. Her laparoscopy and hysteroscopy training was taken at Bradford Royal Infirmary in the United Kingdom, and her infertility training at Reliance Life Sciences in Mumbai.

Alongside Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital in Saket she has practised at the Max Multi Speciality Centre in Panchsheel Park and at the Sitaram Bhartiya Institute of Science and Research, all in Delhi.

Foetal medicine is where her recorded society work sits. She has served as Organizing Secretary for a Foetal Medicine Society CME and as Editor of the Bulletin of the Foetal Medicine Society, an editorial role that places her academic contribution in that field rather than in the surgical one.

dr-rohini-khera-bhatt.bio:
Dr. Rohini Khera Bhatt is Consultant in Obstetrics, Gynecology and Robotic Surgery at Apollo Hospitals, Navi Mumbai, with more than 15 years of experience.

Her operating list runs in parallel across two approaches. Robotically she performs hysterectomy for complex gynecological conditions, myomectomy with fertility preservation, endometriosis surgery and gynecologic oncology surgery for gynaecological cancers; laparoscopically she performs hysterectomy, myomectomy and advanced endometriosis surgery. Radical hysterectomy for gynaecological cancer and ovarian cyst surgery complete the theatre work, and she also manages uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts and abnormal uterine bleeding. On the obstetric side her profile records expert management of high-risk pregnancies and complex obstetric cases.

She qualified MBBS at King George's Medical University and took the DNB in obstetrics and gynaecology. She holds the MRCOG of the Royal College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists in London and the MNAMS of the National Academy of Medical Sciences in India, and she is a board-certified robotic surgeon.

High-risk obstetrics is where her recognition sits. Around late 2014 she pioneered and took part in rare cases of higher-order pregnancy in Navi Mumbai with neonatal outcomes that drew media and public attention. She received the Dr. Duru P. Matura Gold Medal for best outgoing resident in 2015, won best paper on high-risk pregnancy at the AICOG national conference in 2016, and took best paper at the ISOPARB national conference on maternal and perinatal medicine in the same year.

dr-kaavya-m.bio:
Dr. Kaavya M is a Visiting Consultant at Rela Hospital in Chennai, with more than 10 years of experience across obstetrics and gynaecology and infertility and IVF. At Rela she runs the obstetrics and gynaecology evening clinic.

Her clinical work covers uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding and endometriosis, the last recorded as both treatment and surgery. In theatre she performs hysterectomy and laparoscopic hysterectomy, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery, oophorectomy and endometriosis surgery.

Her training was taken in Chennai and then in the north. She qualified MBBS in 2010 at SRM Medical College and Hospital and Research Center in Chennai, and took her MS in obstetrics and gynaecology in 2017 at Sree Balaji Medical College and Hospital, also in Chennai.

Two fellowships followed in 2019, both at World Laparoscopy Hospital. The FMAS, a fellowship in minimal access surgery, was taken at its Gurgaon centre, and the FART, a fellowship in assisted reproductive technology, at its NCR Delhi centre. Those two qualifications account for the two specializations recorded against her name, the surgical one and the fertility one. She also holds the MRCOG of the Royal College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists.

Taken together the record describes a gynaecologist early in her consultant career whose postgraduate work was deliberately split between keyhole surgery and assisted reproduction, and who now brings both to a visiting clinic at a Chennai transplant and multi-speciality hospital.

dr-dharmesh-s-kapoor.bio:
Dr. Dharmesh S. Kapoor is Consultant Urogynaecologist at Gleneagles Hospital in Parel, Mumbai, with more than 31 years of experience. His profile places him across two specialties, obstetrics and gynaecology and the urogynaecology subspecialty of urology.

The pelvic floor is the whole of his practice. He performs pelvic organ prolapse surgery and pelvic floor repair, hysterectomy and laparoscopic hysterectomy, and manages chronic pelvic pain. His record states that he has performed over 1,000 pelvic floor and incontinence surgeries, which is an unusually specific figure for a subspecialty of that size.

He holds an MBBS and is a British-trained subspecialist in urogynaecology. His profile also records him as the only qualified doctor in Mumbai able to perform endo-anal ultrasound for bowel-related problems, a diagnostic capability that sits directly alongside the prolapse and incontinence work.

His one recorded distinction outside the operating theatre is the NHS Innovation Accelerator Fellowship in the UK, which his profile lists both as part of his training and among his awards.

His academic output is substantial for a surgical subspecialist. He has published over 25 papers in peer-reviewed journals and has contributed textbook chapters to the Textbook of Urogynaecology, to the Practical Guide to Female Pelvic Medicine and to other publications in the field.

Taken together the record describes a urogynaecologist whose surgical volume, diagnostic range and written contribution all sit within pelvic floor and continence medicine rather than general gynaecology.

dr-swati-mittal.bio:
Dr. Swati Mittal is Additional Director at the Fortis Memorial Research Institute in the Delhi NCR, with more than 23 years of experience in obstetrics and gynaecology.

Her theatre work is built on three minimal access routes. Laparoscopically she performs hysterectomy, myomectomy, endometriosis surgery and ovarian cyst surgery; hysteroscopically she performs myomectomy and polypectomy; and she also performs robotic hysterectomy. Therapeutic dilation and curettage covers her diagnostic procedures. On the obstetric side she provides advanced obstetric surgical care and planned cesarean section, and she manages abnormal uterine bleeding, ovarian cysts and chronic pelvic pain.

She holds an MBBS and the DNB in obstetrics and gynaecology.

Her hospital history is the fullest part of her record, and it runs almost entirely through the Delhi teaching hospitals. She has been at Maulana Azad Medical College and at LNJP Hospital, at Lady Hardinge Medical College, at Safdarjung Hospital and at DDU Hospital in New Delhi. From that public-sector base she moved into the private sector in Gurgaon, first at Artemis Hospital and now at the Fortis Memorial Research Institute, where she holds her current post.

That progression is what the record describes: a gynaecologist trained and formed across the major government hospitals of Delhi, whose present practice is concentrated on laparoscopic, hysteroscopic and robotic surgery for fibroids, endometriosis and ovarian cysts, alongside high-end obstetric care at a tertiary Gurgaon institute.

dr-geetanjli-behl.bio:
Dr. Geetanjli Behl is a Senior Consultant at Medanta - The Medicity in the Delhi NCR, with more than 22 years of experience in obstetrics and gynaecology.

She manages uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding, chronic pelvic pain and endometriosis. Her operating list covers hysterectomy and laparoscopic hysterectomy, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery, endometriosis surgery, therapeutic dilation and curettage, and uterine polyp removal by hysteroscopic polypectomy.

Her qualifications were taken in Udaipur, Jaipur and Delhi. She read M.B.B.S. at RNT Medical College in Udaipur and took her D.G.O. at SMS Medical College in Jaipur, then the D.N.B. at St. Stephen's Hospital in Delhi.

Her subspecialty training was taken elsewhere again: a fellowship in fetal medicine at Mediscan Systems in Chennai. That qualification sits alongside, rather than inside, the benign gynaecology list above, and it is the one part of her training that points to prenatal imaging rather than to theatre.

Her hospital history follows the same geography as her degrees. She has worked at SMS Hospital in Jaipur and at St. Stephen's Hospital in Delhi, the two institutions where she trained, and afterwards at Fernandez Hospital in Hyderabad and at Manipal Hospital in Delhi. Her current post is at Medanta — The Medicity in Gurugram.

Taken together the record describes a gynaecologist with a conventional benign operating list, a fetal medicine fellowship behind her, and a career that has moved between Jaipur, Delhi, Chennai, Hyderabad and Gurugram.

dr-nymphaea-walecha.bio:
Dr. Nymphaea Walecha is Director and Unit Head of Obstetrics and Gynaecology at Fortis Hospital, Shalimar Bagh, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 21 years of experience across obstetrics and gynaecology and infertility and IVF.

She manages uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding and endometriosis, the last recorded as both treatment and surgery. Her operating list covers hysterectomy performed by open, laparoscopic and robotic routes, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery and endometriosis surgery. She holds an MBBS and an MS in obstetrics and gynaecology.

Fertility is where the rest of her record sits, and it sits there consistently. She won the second best clinical paper award at the World Congress of the International Federation of Fertility Societies in 2016, and has received the Abdul Kalam Azad Award for excellence in fertility care.

Her positions in professional bodies follow the same line. She is Vice President of the Delhi Gynaecologists Forum, Web Editor of the Indian Fertility Society, and Joint Secretary of the Fertility Preservation Society of India, so two of her three offices are held in fertility organisations rather than in general gynaecology ones.

Her written output is recorded as multiple national and international research publications together with book chapters.

Taken together the record describes a unit head whose theatre work spans the full range of uterine surgery, from open to robotic, and whose academic standing and society roles are concentrated in fertility and fertility preservation.

dr-raina-chawla.bio:
Dr. Raina Chawla is Associate Director at Sarvodaya Hospital, Faridabad, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 21 years of experience in gynaecology.

Her clinical range covers uterine fibroids, adenomyosis, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding, chronic pelvic pain and endometriosis, the last listed as both treatment and surgery. Her operating list runs to hysterectomy and laparoscopic hysterectomy, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery, endometriosis surgery, pelvic organ prolapse surgery, endometrial ablation, and therapeutic dilation and curettage.

She holds an MBBS and an MS in obstetrics and gynaecology, a master of surgery in the subject. Her two further qualifications are both by examination and election rather than by course: she is a Fellow of the Indian College of Obstetrics and Gynecology, the FICOG, and she has cleared Parts 1 and 2 of the MRCOG examinations of the Royal College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists.

Her society work is concentrated close to where she practises. She is a life member of the Faridabad Obstetrics and Gynaecology Society and sits on its editorial board, which places her in a publishing role within her local professional body. At national level she is a member of the Practical Obstetric Committee of FOGSI, the Federation of Obstetric and Gynaecological Societies of India.

Taken together the record describes a gynaecologist with a broad benign operating list, both Indian and UK postgraduate examinations behind her, and an editorial and committee role in the professional societies of her own district and of the country.

dr-kashika-kathuria.bio:
Dr. Kashika Kathuria is a Consultant at Fortis Hospital, Shalimar Bagh, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 15 years of experience across obstetrics and gynaecology and infertility and IVF.

She manages uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding and endometriosis, the last recorded as both treatment and surgery. Her operating list covers hysterectomy and laparoscopic hysterectomy, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery, endometriosis surgery, and uterine polyp removal by hysteroscopic polypectomy.

Her qualifications are unusually numerous and each one accounts for a different part of that practice. She holds an MBBS and took her MS in obstetrics and gynaecology at Safdarjung Hospital in New Delhi, followed by the DNB in the same subject. Her fertility qualification is the FNB in reproductive medicine from Maulana Azad Medical College in Delhi, which is what the infertility and IVF line in her profile rests on.

Two further credentials cover the surgical side. The FMAS is a fellowship in minimal access surgery, and the DGE is an international gynecological endoscopy certification taken in Germany, so her endoscopic training was formalised both in India and abroad. She is also a Member of the National Academy of Medical Sciences, the MNAMS.

Alongside Fortis Hospital in Shalimar Bagh she has been associated with the ESIC Medical College and Base Hospital, which her record also names as the Army College of Medical Sciences.

dr-g-nikila-reddy.bio:
Dr. G. Nikila Reddy is a Consultant Gynaecologist and Obstetrician at Yashoda Hospitals, Secunderabad, Hyderabad, with more than 11 years of experience across obstetrics and gynaecology and infertility and IVF.

She manages uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts and abnormal uterine bleeding. Her operating list covers hysterectomy and laparoscopic hysterectomy, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery, oophorectomy, endometriosis surgery, uterine polyp removal and pelvic floor repair.

Her degrees were taken in two states. She qualified MBBS at Kakatiya Medical College in Warangal, Telangana, in 2006, and took her MS in obstetrics and gynaecology at Jawaharlal Nehru Medical College in Belgaum, Karnataka, in 2015.

Three separate fellowships follow, and each points to a different part of her practice. Her infertility fellowship was taken at OASIS in Hyderabad, which is the basis of the IVF side of her profile. Her urogynaecology fellowship was taken through Kiel University at Nagpur, which is the basis of the pelvic floor repair on her list. Her fellowship in cosmetic gynaecology was taken in Dubai, the only part of her training undertaken outside India.

Her memberships line up with the same divisions: a urogynaecology membership, an endoscopy membership, and membership of FOGSI, the Federation of Obstetric and Gynaecological Societies of India. The record therefore describes a gynaecologist who has deliberately added three distinct subspecialty qualifications to a general obstetrics and gynaecology base.

dr-karuna-ratwani.bio:
Dr. Karuna Ratwani is a Specialist at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in the Delhi NCR, with more than 11 years of experience across obstetrics and gynaecology and infertility and IVF.

Her clinical range covers uterine fibroids, adenomyosis, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding, chronic pelvic pain and endometriosis, the last recorded as both treatment and surgery. Her operating list runs to hysterectomy and laparoscopic hysterectomy, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery, endometriosis surgery, pelvic organ prolapse surgery, and therapeutic dilation and curettage.

She holds an MBBS and an MS in obstetrics and gynaecology. Her postgraduate additions are unusually wide and largely taken abroad. The FMAS covers minimal access surgery and the FICRS sits alongside her election as a Fellow of the International College of Robotic Surgeons, so both the keyhole and the robotic approaches are formally credentialled.

Her German training came in two parts: a diploma in reproductive medicine at Kiel and a masters in cosmetic gynaecology at Greifswald. Her imaging qualification is a masterclass in obstetrics and gynaecology ultrasound taken with ISUOG in the United Kingdom.

That combination is what distinguishes the record. Within eleven years she has assembled separate qualifications in minimal access surgery, robotic surgery, reproductive medicine, cosmetic gynaecology and ultrasound, three of them taken abroad, and now brings them to a general gynaecology and fertility practice at Apollo Hospitals Indraprastha in Delhi.

dr-manju-khemani.bio:
Dr. Manju Khemani is Principal Director of Obstetrics and Gynaecology and Head of Unit at Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in the Delhi NCR. Her record shows more than 45 years in practice across three areas: obstetrics and gynaecology, gynaecological laparoscopy, and high-risk pregnancy management.

Her clinical work covers uterine fibroids, adenomyosis, ovarian cysts, post-menopausal bleeding and menopause management. Her operating list is laparoscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery and endometriosis surgery.

Her degrees were both taken at Gandhi Medical College in Bhopal: the MBBS and then the MD in obstetrics and gynaecology. Her later qualification is a fellowship in endoscopy at BEAMS in Mumbai, which is the formal basis of the laparoscopy strand in her profile.

The most substantial part of her record is her hospital history, which runs almost entirely through the major Delhi teaching and institutional hospitals. She spent four years at AIIMS in New Delhi and ten years at Lady Hardinge Medical College, then eight years at Sitaram Bhartia Hospital. From 2013 she has been at Saket City Hospital, and her current post is at Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital in Saket.

Those figures account for the length of her career directly: more than two decades of it are documented in named posts, first in the public teaching sector and then across two private Saket hospitals, with laparoscopy and high-risk obstetrics as the constants throughout.

dr-anuradha-kapur-1.bio:
Dr. Anuradha Kapur is Principal Director and Head of Unit in Obstetrics and Gynaecology at Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 36 years of experience across obstetrics and gynaecology and infertility and IVF.

Her clinical range is wide. She manages uterine fibroids, adenomyosis, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding, chronic pelvic pain, post-menopausal bleeding and menopause, with endometriosis recorded as both treatment and surgery. Her operating list covers hysterectomy and laparoscopic hysterectomy, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, oophorectomy, ovarian cyst surgery, endometriosis surgery, endometrial ablation, and uterine polyp removal by hysteroscopic polypectomy.

Her degrees were both taken in Delhi: the MBBS at Maulana Azad Medical College and the MD at Maulana Azad Medical College and LNJP Hospital.

Her later training accounts for the two halves of her present practice, and both parts were taken abroad. Her diploma in advanced endoscopy was taken in Germany, and she holds a second diploma in advanced endoscopy for gynaecological laparoscopy through WALS. Her assisted reproductive techniques training was taken in Singapore, and she is separately recorded as trained in infertility and IVF.

Alongside her post in Saket she practises at the Max Multi Speciality Centre in Panchsheel Park. She has received a Physician Appreciation Award from Max Healthcare, Saket.

The record therefore describes a long-serving unit head whose endoscopic and fertility credentials were both obtained overseas and whose list spans the full benign gynaecology range.

dr-sunita-varma.bio:
Dr. Sunita Varma is Senior Director and Head of Department at Fortis Hospital, Shalimar Bagh, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 32 years of experience. Her profile records two areas, obstetrics and gynaecology and robotic surgery.

Her operating list covers all three surgical routes. She performs hysterectomy abdominally, laparoscopically and robotically, so the choice of approach is documented rather than assumed. Laparoscopically she also performs myomectomy and endometriosis surgery; hysteroscopically she performs myomectomy and polypectomy. The rest of the list is ovarian cyst surgery, oophorectomy and salpingo-oophorectomy, and she manages ovarian cysts and abnormal uterine bleeding. On the obstetric side she provides advanced obstetric surgical care.

She holds an MBBS and an MD in obstetrics and gynaecology.

Her recognition spans more than a quarter of a century and comes from several directions. She received the Pfizer Postgraduate Award in 1990, near the start of her career, and the Chairman's Award of Max Healthcare in 2004. Her academic recognition is the best paper award of IAGE in 2013, which places her contribution with the gynaecological endoscopy body rather than with a general obstetrics one.

Two later honours are broader. She received the APJ Abdul Kalam Award for Excellence from the Delhi Gynecologist Forum, and in 2018 ET Healthworld named her among the most inspiring gynecologists of North India.

dr-sujata-dalvi.bio:
Dr. Sujata Dalvi is a Consultant in obstetrics and gynaecology at Gleneagles Hospital in Parel, Mumbai, with more than 29 years of experience.

Her practice is general gynaecology across the benign range. She manages uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding, chronic pelvic pain and endometriosis, and provides menopause management. Endometriosis is recorded twice in her profile, once as treatment and once as surgery, so the condition is handled medically as well as in theatre.

Her operating list follows the same conditions through to surgery. She performs hysterectomy by both open and laparoscopic routes and myomectomy by both, along with ovarian cyst surgery, oophorectomy and endometriosis surgery. The pairing of an open and a keyhole version of the same two operations is what her list records, rather than a single fixed approach.

Her qualifications are four in number. She holds an MBBS and an MD in obstetrics and gynaecology, together with the DGO and the FCPS.

Her hospital history runs entirely within Mumbai and largely within its public hospitals. She has worked at K.E.M. Hospital, at R.N. Cooper Hospital and at Rajawadi Hospital, three of the city's municipal institutions, before her present post at Gleneagles Hospital in Parel.

Taken together the record describes a gynaecologist of nearly three decades whose training and early career were built in the Mumbai public hospital system and whose current work is a broad benign gynaecology list in the private sector in the same city.

dr-harsha-jain.bio:
Dr. Harsha Jain is a Senior Consultant in Obstetrics and Gynaecology at Fortis Hospital, Shalimar Bagh, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 22 years of experience.

She manages uterine fibroids, adenomyosis, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding, chronic pelvic pain and endometriosis, the last recorded as both treatment and surgery. Her operating list covers hysterectomy and laparoscopic hysterectomy, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery, endometriosis surgery and pelvic organ prolapse surgery.

Both of her degrees were taken at the same institution. She read M.B.B.S. at RNT Medical College in Udaipur, Rajasthan, and returned there for her M.S. in obstetrics and gynecology.

Her later training was taken in three separate places and each part maps onto a different element of her practice. Her infertility training was the FOGSI Fellowship at Shri Gangaram Hospital in Delhi, which her record lists both as a qualification and as an award. Her laparoscopic work rests on intensive training in laparoscopic surgeries and minimal access surgery at Sunrise Hospital in Kochi, taken under Dr. Hafiz Rehman. She has also completed advanced USG training, which covers the imaging side.

Her record notes that she is a regular attendee and participant at international and national meetings in obstetrics and gynecology, so continuing academic involvement sits alongside the clinical work. Her practice is based at Fortis Hospital in Shalimar Bagh, Delhi.

dr-nidhi-sharma.bio:
Dr. Nidhi Sharma is a Consultant at Sarvodaya Hospital, Faridabad, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 15 years of experience across obstetrics and gynaecology and infertility and IVF.

Her clinical work covers uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, abnormal uterine bleeding, chronic pelvic pain and endometriosis, together with menopause management. Endometriosis appears in her profile as both treatment and surgery. Her operating list runs to hysterectomy and laparoscopic hysterectomy, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery, endometriosis surgery, and therapeutic dilation and curettage.

She holds an MBBS and an MD in obstetrics and gynaecology, and has cleared Part 1 of the MRCOG of the Royal College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists.

Her career has moved across three cities. She has worked at GIMS in Gulbarga, then in Pune at RHC and at Aditya Birla Hospital, before her present work in the Delhi NCR. Alongside the hospital in Faridabad she also practises at the Sarvodaya Health Clinic in Sector 87, Greater Faridabad, so her work is split between the main hospital and a clinic in the newer part of the same city.

She is a member of FOGSI, the Federation of Obstetric and Gynecological Societies of India.

The record describes a gynaecologist whose list is weighted towards the medical and minimal access management of fibroids, cysts, bleeding and endometriosis, and whose posts have taken her from Gulbarga through Pune to the Delhi NCR.

dr-shweta-gangal.bio:
Dr. Shweta Gangal is a Senior Consultant at the Fortis Memorial Research Institute in the Delhi NCR, with more than 13 years of experience in obstetrics and gynaecology.

Her clinical work covers uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts and abnormal uterine bleeding. Her operating list runs to hysterectomy and laparoscopic hysterectomy, myomectomy and laparoscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery, endometriosis surgery, endometrial ablation, therapeutic dilation and curettage, and uterine polyp removal by hysteroscopic polypectomy.

Both of her degrees were taken at Sawai Mansingh Medical College in Jaipur. She qualified MBBS there as a gold medalist and returned for her MS in obstetrics and gynaecology, so her entire primary and postgraduate training took place at a single institution.

Four further qualifications sit on top of that base, and they divide neatly in two. On the surgical side she holds the F.MAS, a fellowship in minimal access surgery, and the D.MAS, a diploma in minimal access surgery awarded through WALS at World Laparoscopy Hospital, which together account for the laparoscopic and hysteroscopic weighting of her list. On the other side she holds the FICMCH of the Indian College of Maternal and Child Health and the FRM, a fellowship in reproductive medicine.

Her practice is based at the Fortis Memorial Research Institute in Gurugram. The record therefore describes a gynaecologist who trained wholly in Jaipur and then built a doubly credentialled minimal access practice alongside maternal health and reproductive medicine qualifications.

dr-navaneetha-elati.bio:
Dr. Navaneetha Elati is a Consultant Obstetric and Gynaecologic Laparoscopic Surgeon at Yashoda Hospitals, Somajiguda, Hyderabad, with more than 9 years of experience in obstetrics and gynaecology.

Laparoscopy is named in her designation, and the operating list follows it. She performs laparoscopic myomectomy, ovarian cyst surgery, endometriosis surgery and endometrial ablation. On the medical side she manages uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts and abnormal uterine bleeding, and provides menopause management, so the same conditions are covered both in clinic and in theatre.

Her training was taken at two institutions. She qualified MBBS at the Kamineni Institute of Medical Sciences, then moved to Bangalore Baptist Hospital for her DNB.

Her posts since then have brought her back. She has worked at Bangalore Baptist Hospital, where she trained, and at the ESIC Medical College, and within the Yashoda group she has been at both the Secunderabad hospital and her present base at Somajiguda in Hyderabad.

She belongs to two professional bodies, one national and one local: FOGSI, the Federation of Obstetrics and Gynaecological Society of India, and the Obstetrics and Gynaecological Society of Hyderabad, the OGSH.

Taken together the record describes a gynaecologist early in her consultant career whose practice is defined by the keyhole approach named in her title, applied to fibroids, cysts, endometriosis and abnormal bleeding at a large Hyderabad hospital.

dr-pankaj-vinod-jariwala.bio:
Dr. Pankaj Vinod Jariwala is a Consultant Interventional Cardiologist at Yashoda Hospitals, Somajiguda, Hyderabad, with more than 28 years of experience. His profile records two areas, cardiology and structural or interventional paediatric cardiac work.

His cath lab list covers coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty and stenting, diagnostic cardiac catheterization and TAVI or TAVR, and he manages coronary artery disease, valvular heart disease and heart failure.

His training has an unusual shape. He qualified MBBS at Government Medical College in Aurangabad between 1993 and 1998, then took an MD in paediatrics at SRTR Government Medical College in Ambajogai between 1998 and 2001, both in Maharashtra. His DNB in paediatrics followed, and his DNB in cardiology was taken between 2002 and 2006, so his route into cardiology ran through paediatrics. His interventional fellowship was taken at ICPS in Paris, and he has worked at the Institut Cardiovasculaire Paris Sud in Massy.

In Hyderabad he has been at Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences, at Apollo Hospitals in Hyderguda, at Kamineni Hospitals in King Koti, at Indo-US Hospitals in Ameerpet and at Maxcure-Mediciti Hospitals, as well as Medwin Hospitals.

His case presentations have been recognised repeatedly abroad. He took first prize in the Call for Clinical Case at EuroPCR 2009 and returned as guest faculty in 2010, and held IABP scholarships for case presentations at TCT 2009 in San Francisco and TCT 2010 in Washington, DC, as guest faculty at both.

dr-ajay-j-swamy.bio:
Dr. Ajay J Swamy is a Senior Consultant Interventional Cardiologist at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, Hyderabad, with more than 31 years of experience.

His work spans both the interventional and the rhythm sides of cardiology. He performs coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty and stenting, diagnostic cardiac catheterization and TAVI or TAVR, implants pacemakers and ICDs, and carries out AF ablation. He manages coronary artery disease, valvular heart disease, cardiomyopathy, atrial fibrillation and heart failure.

His degrees were taken in the armed forces medical system and then at PGIMER. He read M.B.B.S and took his MD at AFMC in Pune, and his DM in cardiology at PGIMER in Chandigarh. He is a Fellow of the American College of Cardiology and a Fellow of the Society for Cardiac Interventions, and he held an International Senior Scientist Fellowship from ICMR in 2016. He has been proctored and trained in TAVR, rotational atherectomy, intravascular imaging, CRT device implantation and bifurcation angioplasty, and is a recognised DM and DNB cardiology examiner and an inspector for accreditation.

His earlier posts were military: Army Hospital (R and R) in New Delhi, MH CTC at AFMC in Pune, and Command Hospital Air Force in Bangalore, alongside PGIMER.

His awards began in training and continued in service. He won the Brig JC Chatergy award as best post-graduate student in 1996, the Ranjana Vij medal and the Brig IP Bhalla Gold Medal in 1999, and the VK Saini gold medal for DM research in 2006, presented by Dr. APJ Kalam.

dr-arvind-dambalkar.bio:
Dr. Arvind Dambalkar is Senior Consultant and Head of Unit II in Interventional Cardiology at Sarvodaya Hospital, Faridabad, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 17 years of experience. His profile records cardiology alongside endovascular vascular procedures.

His range is unusually wide for one operator. Coronary work covers angiography and angioplasty with stenting; structural work covers TAVI or TAVR and the MitraClip procedure; device work covers pacemaker and ICD implantation; and electrophysiology covers VT, AF and SVT ablation. He also manages cardiomyopathy and valvular heart disease.

He took his MD in internal medicine at PGI in Chandigarh and his DM in cardiology at AIIMS in Delhi, and holds a coronary imaging fellowship along with endovascular intervention experience. Before his present post he was at Safdarjung Hospital in New Delhi, at Batra Hospital and Medical Research Centre, at Asian Hospital in Faridabad and at ESIC Faridabad. He belongs to the Cardiological Society of India and the Lipid Association of India.

His academic output is the fullest part of his record. His DM thesis examined the safety and efficacy of aspirin in rheumatic mitral stenosis with normal sinus rhythm, and his MD thesis correlated clinical, biochemical and serological markers with endoscopic and histological features in celiac disease. He has published on optical coherence tomography in acute coronary syndrome in the Korean Circulation Journal, and on oligonucleotides against undruggable cardiovascular disorders and a review of the ORBITA trial, both in J Pract Cardiovasc Sci.

dr-gopi-krishna-rayidi.bio:
Dr. Gopi Krishna Rayidi is Senior Interventional Cardiologist and Clinical Director at Yashoda Hospitals, Hitec City, Hyderabad, with more than 16 years of experience. His profile records cardiology together with vascular surgery.

His cath lab work covers coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty and stenting, diagnostic cardiac catheterization and TAVI or TAVR, and he implants pacemakers and ICDs. Medically he manages coronary artery disease, valvular heart disease and heart failure.

His training was taken entirely in and around Hyderabad. He read MBBS at Osmania Medical College between 1998 and 2004, took his MD through NTRUHS between 2005 and 2008, and his DM in cardiology at Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences between 2010 and 2013. He has since worked at NIMS, at Apollo Hospital, at Mamatha Hospital, at Hope Superspeciality Hospital and at the Somajiguda branch of Yashoda Hospitals before his current post at Hitec City.

He is a Fellow of the American College of Cardiology and a member of the Cardiology Society of India, the National Medical Council and the Association of Physicians of India.

His research runs alongside the clinical work. He published a case of early development of a gigantic aneurysm after placement of a drug eluting stent in the Journal of Interventional Medicine and Applied Science in 2017, and a study correlating non-invasive pulse wave indices with coronary artery disease severity in the Indian Journal of Pharmacology in 2014. He presented a poster on the origin of different SVTs at CSI India in 2011, and holds a CSI travel award for that presentation.

dr-p-rajendra-kumar-jain.bio:
Dr. P. Rajendra Kumar Jain is Director, Head of Department and Consultant Cardiologist at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, Hyderabad, with more than 42 years of experience.

His list runs from diagnosis to structural intervention. He performs coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty and stenting, diagnostic cardiac catheterization, echocardiography, pacemaker implantation, TAVI or TAVR and the MitraClip procedure, and he manages coronary artery disease, valvular and rheumatic heart disease, cardiomyopathy, atrial fibrillation and heart failure.

His degrees were taken at Kurnool Medical College, the M.B.B.S. between 1981 and 1986 and the M.D. in internal medicine between 1987 and 1991, followed by the D.M. in cardiology at Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences in Hyderabad between 1993 and 1995. His overseas training came in three parts: an observership in echocardiography at Lenox Hill Hospital in New York in late 1996, an observership in the catheterization laboratory at Mount Sinai Hospital in New York into early 1997, and an interventional cardiology fellowship at the University of Pierre et Marie Curie in Paris between 1998 and 1999. He was elected FACC in 2009 and was Consultant Cardiologist at the Mahavir Cardiovascular Centre between 1999 and 2004.

Clinical trials work brought two awards for the CREATE study, presented by Dr. Salim Yusuf at meetings in Goa in 2003 and Bangkok in 2004. He received both the Best Reviewers Award and the Readers Choice Award of the Indian Heart Journal in 2016, and was best outgoing medical resident at Kurnool Medical College in 1991.

dr-anand-gnanaraj.bio:
Dr. Anand Gnanaraj is a Senior Consultant Interventional Cardiologist at MGM Healthcare in Chennai, with more than 20 years of experience.

His list covers coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty and stenting, diagnostic cardiac catheterization, echocardiography and TAVI or TAVR, alongside the management of coronary artery disease, valvular heart disease, atrial fibrillation and heart failure.

His training moved through four institutions. He read MBBS at Christian Medical College in Vellore, took his MD in general medicine at Madurai Medical College and his DM in cardiology at Stanley Medical College, then the FNB in interventional cardiology at the Madras Medical Mission. He is a Fellow of the European Society of Cardiology and a Fellow of the Society for Cardiovascular Angiography and Interventions, and a life member of the Cardiological Society of India.

CTO work is the distinguishing strand of his record. He is Founder Director of India CTO and of a CTO Centre of Excellence, and he organises international CTO workshops that bring in experts from Japan, Korea and Europe. He also acts as a proctor for complex PCI procedures across India, so part of his work is training other operators rather than treating patients directly.

Alongside MGM Healthcare he has been associated with Apollo Speciality Hospitals in Vanagaram, with Apollo Hospitals and with the Madras Medical Mission. His record notes multiple international and national publications in cardiology.

dr-b-v-a-ranga-reddy.bio:
Dr. B V A Ranga Reddy is a Senior Consultant Cardiologist at Apollo Hospital, Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad, with more than 18 years of experience. His profile records three areas: cardiology, adult and paediatric cardiology in both its invasive and non-invasive forms, and structural heart disease.

That paediatric strand shows directly in his list. Alongside coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty, 2D echocardiography and pacemaker implantation, he performs paediatric echocardiography and manages congenital heart disease. His other clinical areas are valvular and rheumatic heart disease, cardiomyopathy, arrhythmia, heart failure and preventive cardiology care.

He holds an MBBS, an MD in general medicine and a DM in cardiology, and has a fellowship from the American Heart Institute in the UK. He practises at Apollo Health City in Jubilee Hills.

Teaching is a formal part of his role and is recorded with dates. He has trained post-doctoral students in internal medicine since 2012 and DNB cardiology students at Apollo Jubilee since 2017. Earlier he served as a reviewer for university and college examinations, in anatomy, physiology and biochemistry in 1992 and in dermatology, pharmacology and community medicine in 1994. He won a gold medal in surgery as an undergraduate and a best thesis award at a national conference in 2008.

His published work includes a case of congenital kinking of the aorta in BMJ Case Reports in July 2017 and an in-house multivariate analysis of myocardial bridging with no fixed obstruction in the same year.

dr-a-b-gopalamurugan.bio:
Dr. A B Gopalamurugan is a Senior Consultant in cardiology at MGM Healthcare in Chennai, with more than 20 years of experience.

His list is weighted towards structural and rhythm work. He performs TAVI or TAVR, coronary angioplasty and stenting, coronary angiography, diagnostic cardiac catheterization, cardiac ablation for arrhythmia and echocardiography, and he manages valvular heart disease, atrial fibrillation and heart failure. He holds an MBBS and an MD.

His registrations and society memberships are spread across four countries, which is unusual even in this field. He is registered with the General Medical Council in the UK, the Indian Medical Council and the Maharashtra Medical Council in Mumbai, and he belongs to the British Cardiovascular Interventional Society, the European Heart Rhythm Association and the Heart Rhythm Society in the USA.

The rest of his record is a list of firsts. He has performed 14 heart treatments recorded as first-in-India and four recorded as first-in-the-world. Among them are the first TAVR in India with the Medtronic Evolut R System, the first TAVI in India for aortic regurgitation, the first transcatheter mitral valve replacement in India, the first transcatheter tricuspid valve replacement in India, and the first transcatheter aortic valve implantation for aortic stenosis in South India.

He also established the first dedicated TAVR programme in India, which his record notes as holding a Guinness World Record in that field.

dr-rajiv-agarwal.bio:
Dr. Rajiv Agarwal is Vice Chairman and Unit Head at Max Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in the Delhi NCR, where he also heads academics and research in cardiac sciences. He has more than 36 years of experience across cardiology, cardiac sciences and interventional cardiology.

His list runs from routine diagnosis to structural intervention: coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty and stenting, diagnostic cardiac catheterization, echocardiography, pacemaker and ICD implantation, TAVI or TAVR and the MitraClip procedure, with coronary artery disease, valvular heart disease, atrial fibrillation and heart failure on the medical side.

All three of his degrees were taken at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences in New Delhi: the MBBS in 1985, the MD in internal medicine in 1988 and the DM in cardiology in 1990. His interventional fellowship was taken at the University of Alabama at Birmingham in 1993, and he was elected FACC in 2011.

His career divides into three long postings. He was at AIIMS from 1986 to 1998, at Batra Hospital and Medical Research Centre from 1998 to 2017, and at Max Super Speciality Hospital in Saket since 2017, with concurrent work at Mata Chanan Devi Hospital and at Pushpanjali Crosslay Hospital in Ghaziabad.

He was awarded the Institute Medal as best MBBS graduate at AIIMS in 1984, a Commonwealth Scholarship and the Dr. P. N. Berry Scholarship in 1992, the Col. K. L. Chopra Award for original research in ischaemic heart disease in 1995, and the Pandit L. C. Richarya Memorial Oration in 2009.

dr-ashok-seth.bio:
Dr. Ashok Seth is Chairman of Cardiac Sciences at the Fortis Escorts Heart Institute in Okhla, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 40 years of experience in cardiology.

His practice is concentrated on the most demanding end of coronary intervention. Alongside diagnostic angiography and cardiac catheterization, his list names complex angioplasty, CTO angioplasty for chronic total occlusions, left main angioplasty, primary angioplasty, and angioplasty guided by IVUS and by OCT. His structural work covers TAVI or TAVR, the MitraClip procedure and heart valve repair surgery.

His qualifications are almost entirely by fellowship and election rather than by degree. He holds the FRCP of London, Edinburgh and Ireland, is a Fellow of the American College of Cardiology and of the European Society of Cardiology, and holds the FAPSIC, the FIMSA and the FCSI. The Society for Cardiovascular Angiography and Interventions in the USA named him a Master Interventionalist, the MSCAI.

His honorary doctorates are unusually numerous. He has received DSc degrees from BHU, AMU, Amity University, TMU and Shiv Nadar University, and a D.Litt from Jamia Millia University. He also holds the National Honour of the Republic of Spain, the Crus Officer with the Insignia of the Order of Isabella the Catholic, and is Adjunct Professor of Cardiology at JN Medical College, Aligarh Muslim University.

His record notes that he performed heart valve repair without open heart surgery for the first time in India at FEHI.

dr-b-hygriv-rao.bio:
Dr. B. Hygriv Rao is Senior Consultant Cardiologist and Electrophysiologist at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, Hyderabad, with more than 30 years of experience across cardiology and cardiac electrophysiology.

Rhythm work dominates his list. He performs cardiac ablation for arrhythmia including AF, SVT and VT ablation, treats WPW syndrome, and implants pacemakers and ICDs. Alongside that he performs TAVI or TAVR, the MitraClip procedure and echocardiography, and manages atrial fibrillation, cardiomyopathy, rheumatic heart disease and heart failure.

His training moved north in stages. He read MBBS at Osmania Medical College in Hyderabad, took his MD in general medicine at Gandhi Hospital in Secunderabad, and his DM in cardiology at GB Pant Hospital in New Delhi. His subspecialty fellowship in electrophysiology was taken at the Electrophysiology Research Foundation in New Jersey.

His editorial work keeps him in the same field. He edits the electrophysiology section of the Indian Heart Journal and is a section editor of the Indian Pacing and Electrophysiology Journal.

His speaking record is the most heavily documented part of his profile. He was an invited participant at the AP CSI annual meeting every year from 2006 to 2013 and at the national CSI annual meeting every year from 2009 to 2012, and at the ISECON annual scientific sessions every year from 2007 to 2012. He also appeared at the Kerala Heart Rhythm Society in 2011, at APHRS 2013 in Hong Kong and at CARDIOSTIM in Nice in 2014, and gave the Uma Rani Benerjee Oration in 2012. He received the DP Basu Award of the CSI in 2005.

dr-p-a-jiwani.bio:
Dr. P. A. Jiwani is Senior Consultant and Interventional Cardiologist at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, Hyderabad. His record shows more than 51 years in practice, the longest span in this specialty on the platform.

His list covers coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty and stenting, diagnostic cardiac catheterization, echocardiography, pacemaker implantation, TAVI or TAVR and the MitraClip procedure, with coronary artery disease, valvular and rheumatic heart disease, cardiomyopathy, atrial fibrillation and heart failure on the medical side.

His qualifications were taken over fifteen years and on two continents. He read M.B.B.S. at Govt. Medical College in Nagpur in 1977 and took his M.D. in medicine there in 1981. His D.Card. came from the University of London at the Royal Postgraduate Medical School, Hammersmith Hospital, in 1989, and his DNB in cardiology from Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences in Hyderabad in 1992. His interventional training was taken both at Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences and at the Charles De Nicole Hospital of the University of Ruien in France. He practises at the KIMS Superspeciality Hospital in Begumpet.

He was President of the Andhra Pradesh Cardiology Society of India between 2007 and 2008, sits on the advisory board of the Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences, and is a life member of the Cardiology Society of India, the Academy of Medical Sciences and the Indian Medical Association.

He has been an investigator in international randomized trials including MICHELANGELO OASIS-6, PLATO, OASIS-7, the XIENCE V Registry and LIFENOX, and has operated live cases at CSI Hyderabad in 2007.

dr-praveen-chandra.bio:
Dr. Praveen Chandra is Chairman of Interventional Cardiology at Medanta - The Medicity in the Delhi NCR, with more than 25 years of experience.

His list is built almost entirely around the catheter. Alongside diagnostic coronary angiography he performs complex angioplasty, CTO angioplasty, left main angioplasty and primary angioplasty, with imaging and physiology guidance recorded separately as IVUS guided angioplasty, OCT guided angioplasty and FFR or iFR assessment. His structural work covers TAVI or TAVR and the MitraClip procedure. He holds an M.B.B.S, an M.D. in general medicine and a D.M. in cardiology, and practises at Medanta Medicity in Gurugram and at the Medanta Mediclinic on Golf Course.

His record is largely a list of national firsts. He performed the first percutaneous aortic valve implantation without surgery in India and the first percutaneous mitral valve repair in India, was the first to use FFR and bioabsorbable stents in India and the first to use the Angio Jet thrombectomy device, and started the percutaneous myocardial laser vascularization programme in Asia.

He was awarded the Padma Shri by the President of India in 2016 for distinguished contributions to medicine, and had earlier received a recognition award for success and achievement in the field of angioplasty in India in 1998.

He is a Fellow of the Endovascular Intervention Society of India and of the Asia Pacific Society of Interventional Cardiology, has authored over 100 articles, and reviews for leading medical journals.

dr-sagar-shah.bio:
Dr. Sagar Shah is a Consultant cardiologist at Apollo Hospitals in Bengaluru, with more than 9 years of experience.

His clinical list is weighted towards medical cardiology rather than the cath lab. He provides preventive cardiology care and manages pulmonary hypertension, valvular heart disease, arrhythmia, atrial fibrillation and cardiomyopathy.

His qualifications are all taken by examination through the National Board. He holds the DNB in cardiology and the FNB in interventional cardiology, and is a Fellow of the Society for Cardiovascular Angiography and Interventions. His subspecialty training is a fellowship in structural heart interventions at the Sapporo Cardiovascular Clinic in Japan, and he trained in interventional cardiology at the Eternal Heart Institute and Research Center.

His earlier posts trace a route north from Gujarat. He studied at B.J.
