Medical College in Surat, was a resident physician at Government Medical College in the same city, and then a resident cardiologist at Krishna Institute in Karad and Hubli. He now practises at Apollo Hospitals in Seshadripuram, Bangalore.

His record is unusually full of academic recognition for the length of his career. He received the Dr. Hemlata Cothiwala Prize for first position in cardiology, was felicitated for an oral presentation at a national CME session held by the Salem Heart Foundation, and represented India in a live case presentation at the International Cardiovascular Seminar Conference. His research on Takotsubo cardiomyopathy was validated nationally for the measurement of RV function, and he was commended for work on 3D echocardiography and NT-ProBNP in predicting postoperative atrial fibrillation after cardiac surgery.

dr-vaishali.bio:
Dr. Vaishali is a Consultant at Sarvodaya Hospital, Faridabad, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 15 years of experience. Her profile places her in non-invasive, preventive and palliative cardiology rather than in interventional work.

Her list reflects that. She performs echocardiography, coronary angiography and diagnostic cardiac catheterization, and manages coronary artery disease, heart failure, cardiomyopathy, valvular and rheumatic heart disease and atrial fibrillation.

She holds an MBBS and an MD, taking a gold medal in each, and a DM in cardiology.

Her academic record is documented year by year and begins before medical school. In 2004 she received a CBSE certificate of merit for being among the top 0.1% of candidates in science and technology. In 2010 she won a gold medal for academic excellence in otorhinolaryngology and the North America Alumni Association award for best graduate in ENT in her third MBBS year. In 2011 she took first prize in the university round of the Indian Academy of Pediatrics quiz and second in the Delhi round, and in 2016 she was first runner-up in the regional round of the All India Dr. S. D. Deodhar intercollegiate postgraduate rheumatology quiz. In 2017 she received the Shri P.L. Ghai Award for standing first in the MD examination in general medicine.

Her publications include a paper questioning whether COVID-19 associated viral myocarditis exists, in Monaldi Arch Chest Dis in 2020, a report on total anomalous pulmonary venous connection in J Assoc Physicians India in 2019, and a review of peripartum cardiomyopathy in 2016.

dr-vijayan-ganesan.bio:
Dr. Vijayan Ganesan is a Senior Consultant at Rela Hospital in Chennai, with more than 15 years of experience in cardiology.

His work covers both coronary and peripheral territory. He performs coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty and stenting, diagnostic cardiac catheterization, peripheral angioplasty and stenting, TAVI or TAVR and the MitraClip procedure, and implants pacemakers and ICDs. He manages coronary artery disease, valvular heart disease and heart failure.

His training moved across the country. He read MBBS at Govt Kilpauk Medical College in Chennai between 2005 and 2011, took his MD in general medicine at R.G Kar Medical College in Kolkata between 2013 and 2016, and his DM in cardiology at the Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology in Trivandrum. He holds the MRCP with General Medical Council registration and a licence to practise, the FSCAI in the USA, and the CCEBDM.

Much of his career has been spent in Kerala. He has worked at Aster MIMS Hospital in Kannur, at Govt Medical College in Kannur, at NIMS Hospital in Malappuram and at Meitra Hospital in Calicut, before his present post at the Rela Institute and Medical Centre in Chennai.

His case presentations have been recognised repeatedly. He won first prize at the Indian Coronary Conquest 2026, ranked first out of 600 presentations, a gold medal for a challenging case at the 16th Asia Pacific Vascular Intervention Course in 2024, and a best case award at the AICC Complication Course in 2025. He also took first prize in the Heart Failure Association of India best dissertation award in 2020.

dr-arvind-sethi.bio:
Dr. Arvind Sethi is Additional Director in the Department of Cardiology at Fortis Hospital, Shalimar Bagh, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 22 years of experience. His profile records cardiology alongside peripheral vascular disease.

His list spans three kinds of work. Coronary intervention covers angiography, angioplasty, complex angioplasty and CTO angioplasty; device work covers pacemaker implantation and CRT or CRT-D implantation; and the rest is 2D echocardiography, diagnostic cardiac catheterization, preventive cardiology care and the management of coronary artery disease, peripheral artery disease and heart failure.

His training was taken entirely in Delhi. He read MBBS at Maulana Azad Medical College, took his MD in medicine at Lady Hardinge Medical College and Dr. RML Hospital, and his DNB in cardiology at the Escorts Heart Institute, where he also held a prior affiliation before moving to Fortis.

He holds three fellowships by election: of the European Society of Cardiology, of the Cardiological Society of India, and of the International Medical Sciences Academy.

His teaching and speaking work is recorded as faculty positions at ECHO Delhi, at Endovascular Live and at the India Act Conference, and as invited faculty at national cardiology conferences. His publications appear in international and national books and journals, including the Indian Heart Journal and the proceedings of the International Conference on Clinical PET and Molecular Nuclear Medicine in 2011, the last of which places part of his academic interest in cardiac imaging.

dr-sunil-kumar-agarwal.bio:
Dr. Sunil Kumar Agarwal is Director of Interventional Cardiology at Max Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 30 years of experience. His profile records cardiology, interventional cardiology and peripheral vascular interventions.

That third area shows clearly in his list. Alongside coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty and stenting, diagnostic cardiac catheterization, TAVI or TAVR and pacemaker and ICD implantation, he performs endovascular aneurysm repair and treats peripheral artery disease. Medically he manages coronary artery disease, valvular heart disease, atrial fibrillation and heart failure.

All three of his degrees were taken at G.S.V.M. Medical College under Kanpur University: the M.B.B.S., the M.D. in internal medicine and the D.M. in cardiology. His interventional fellowship was taken at the Escorts Heart Institute and Research Centre on Okhla Road in New Delhi, and his peripheral vascular fellowship at the Polyclinique Louis Pasteur in Nancy, France, which is the formal basis of the vascular half of his practice.

He is a Fellow of the Asia Pacific Society of Interventional Cardiology, of the European Society of Cardiology and of the Society of Angiography and Interventions. He practises at the East Block of Max Super Speciality Hospital in Saket and at the Max Heart and Vascular Institute there.

His academic role covers several forms. He has published at national and international level, contributed articles to medical books, taken part in research trials as both Principal Investigator and Co-Investigator, and served as thesis and research projects guide for DNB cardiology students.

dr-ashok-kumar.bio:
Dr. Ashok Kumar is Group Director and Head of the Department of Cardiology at Rela Hospital in Chennai, with more than 11 years of experience. His profile records adult cardiology alongside paediatric device closures for ASD, VSD and PDA.

His list covers coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty and stenting, diagnostic cardiac catheterization and echocardiography, pacemaker and ICD implantation, and the management of coronary artery disease and valvular heart disease.

His training was taken entirely in Hyderabad. He read M.B.B.S. at Osmania Medical College in 2004 and returned there for his M.D. in general medicine in 2011, then took his D.M. in cardiology at the Nizam Institute of Medical Sciences in 2014. He was afterwards a Consultant in cardiology at Medicover Hospital in Hyderabad before moving to Chennai, where he is now Group Director for cardiology services at the Dr. Rela Institute and Medical Centre.

His society memberships are split between India and abroad. He belongs to the Indian Medical Association and the Cardiological Society of India, and to the European Society of Cardiology and the American College of Cardiology.

His recognition came early and in three forms. He won a gold medal as best young investigator from Telangana CSI in 2015, the year after completing his DM, then the Vaidya Ratna Award in 2018 and a Times Excellence Award in 2020. The record therefore describes a cardiologist who reached a group director post relatively early, with a practice that spans adult coronary intervention and paediatric device closure.

dr-charan-lanjewar.bio:
Dr. Charan Lanjewar is a Senior Consultant cardiologist at Gleneagles Hospital in Mumbai, with more than 28 years of experience.

His list covers coronary angioplasty and stenting, diagnostic cardiac catheterization and echocardiography, together with the management of coronary artery disease, valvular heart disease, rheumatic heart disease, cardiomyopathy, atrial fibrillation and heart failure. The combination of rheumatic heart disease and valvular work alongside coronary intervention is what distinguishes the clinical half of his record.

He holds an MBBS, an MD and a DM in cardiology. His interventional fellowship was taken at McMaster University in Canada, the only part of his training recorded outside India. He has been elected a Fellow of the American College of Cardiology in the USA and a Fellow of the European Society of Cardiology in Europe. He practises at Gleneagles BGS Hospital on Parel Road in Mumbai.

His academic work is mainly in review and teaching rather than in a single research programme. He reviews for the Indian Heart Journal and for the Indian Journal of Critical Care Medicine, and appears as invited faculty and speaker at national and international cardiology conferences. His record also notes multiple research papers published in national and international publications.

Taken together the profile describes a cardiologist of nearly three decades whose clinical range covers the coronary, valvular and rheumatic disease seen in an Indian tertiary practice, and whose academic contribution is concentrated in peer review and conference teaching.

dr-ujjawal-kumar.bio:
Dr. Ujjawal Kumar is a Senior Consultant at Sarvodaya Hospital, Faridabad, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 18 years of experience in cardiology.

His list covers coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty and stenting, diagnostic cardiac catheterization and echocardiography, pacemaker and ICD implantation, and the management of coronary artery disease, valvular heart disease and heart failure.

He holds an MBBS, an MD in internal medicine and a DM in cardiology. His post-doctoral fellowship was in pacing and electrophysiology studies, which is the formal basis of the device half of his list.

His published output is the fullest part of his record and is weighted towards unusual cases. He has reported post-COVID tachycardiomyopathy in a young boy with a tricuspid valve posteromedial papillary muscle, and a postinfarct LV aneurysm compressing the left coronary artery, both in the Journal of the American College of Cardiology. In Circulation he assessed the response of a phosphodiesterase-5 inhibitor in pulmonary artery hypertension by flow mediated dilation of the brachial artery. He has also written on hypocalcemia causing acute coronary syndrome in Indian Heart Journal Cardiovascular Case Reports, on acute methemoglobinemia due to nitrobenzene poisoning, and on whether every diabetic and hypertensive patient should receive a statin in CSI Cardiology.

His registry work follows the pacing side of his training. He is a co-investigator in an international multicentre registry collecting real world evidence on left bundle branch area pacing, and in an Indian multicentre registry on remote monitoring with cardiac implantable devices.

dr-amit-kumar-2.bio:
Dr. Amit Kumar is Associate Director and Head of Unit I in Interventional Cardiology at Sarvodaya Hospital, Faridabad, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 28 years of experience. His profile records cardiology alongside peripheral interventions.

His list covers coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty and stenting, diagnostic cardiac catheterization, TAVI or TAVR, pacemaker and ICD implantation and AF ablation, so structural, device and rhythm work all sit alongside the coronary core. He also manages coronary artery disease and heart failure.

His degrees were taken in Lucknow. He read M.B.B.S. at KGMC in 1999 and took his MD in medicine at King George's Medical University in 2003. His cardiology training was in Delhi: the DNB at the Fortis Escorts Heart Institute through the National Board of Examinations in 2011.

His hospital history stays close to that institute. He has worked at Fortis Escorts Hospital in Okhla and at Fortis Escorts in Faridabad, as well as at Sir Ganga Ram Hospital in New Delhi, before his present post at Sarvodaya Hospital in Sector 8, Faridabad.

He is a Fellow of the European Society of Cardiology and a Fellow of the Society for Cardiovascular Angiography and Interventions, and a member of the American College of Cardiology, so all three of his society affiliations are held outside India.

Taken together the record describes an interventional cardiologist whose training ran from Lucknow through the Escorts system in Delhi, and whose present unit covers coronary, structural, device and peripheral work.

dr-r-venkatakrishnan.bio:
Dr. R. Venkatakrishnan is a Consultant Cardiologist at Rela Hospital in Chennai, with more than 15 years of experience across cardiology and interventional cardiology.

His list covers coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty and stenting, diagnostic cardiac catheterization and echocardiography, with coronary artery disease, valvular and rheumatic heart disease, cardiomyopathy, atrial fibrillation and heart failure on the medical side.

His training moved from Chennai to Delhi. He read MBBS at SRM Medical College and Research Institute in Potheri in 2011, took his MD in general medicine at Madras Medical College in 2016, and his DM in cardiology at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences in New Delhi in 2020. He has since worked at BLK MAX Hospital in New Delhi, and earlier at the Institute of Cardiovascular Diseases at the Madras Medical Mission and at Sri Satya Sai Medical College and Research Institute, both in Chennai.

His published work is unusually varied for a cardiologist at this stage. He was part of the LIVE-Yoga study on the effect of yoga on clinical outcomes and quality of life in vasovagal syncope, published in JACC Clinical Electrophysiology in 2021. He has also published a systematic review and meta-analysis of coronary stent infections in Cardiovascular Revascularization Medicine, a paper in Circulation arguing for the reclassification of infarctions, and a study of long-term oral anticoagulation for atrial fibrillation in low and middle income countries in the Indian Heart Journal.

dr-ripen-gupta.bio:
Dr. Ripen Gupta is Vice Chairman and Unit Head of Cardiology at Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 28 years of experience. His profile records four areas: cardiology, cardiac sciences, interventional cardiology, and cardiac electrophysiology and pacing.

That last area gives his list its shape. He performs AF, SVT and VT ablation and cardiac ablation for arrhythmia, and implants pacemakers and ICDs. On the interventional side he performs coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty and stenting, TAVI or TAVR and the MitraClip procedure, with echocardiography, coronary artery disease and heart failure completing the list. Few cardiologists on the platform combine a full ablation range with structural intervention in this way.

His M.B.B.S. and MD in internal medicine were both taken at Government Medical College under Punjabi University, and his DM in cardiology at King George's Medical College under Lucknow University. His fellowship in interventional cardiology was awarded through the National Board of Examination.

His hospital history is long and runs through several of the major Indian cardiology centres. He has been at Government Medical College in Patiala, at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences in New Delhi, at King George's Medical College in Lucknow, at the Escorts Heart Institute and Research Centre, at Christian Medical College in Ludhiana, at Batra Hospital and Medical Research Centre, and at Fortis Flt. Lt. Rajan Dhall Hospital, before his current post in Saket.

dr-sameer-mehrotra.bio:
Dr. Sameer Mehrotra is Unit Chief of Interventional Cardiology and Electrophysiology at Artemis Hospital in the Delhi NCR, with more than 18 years of experience.

His title describes a combination that is uncommon in one operator, and his list bears it out. On the interventional side he performs coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty, complex angioplasty and primary angioplasty. On the rhythm side he carries out electrophysiology studies, radiofrequency ablation, VT ablation and AF ablation, and manages arrhythmia.

He holds an MBBS, an MD in general medicine and a DM in cardiology. His device credential is separate and specific: he is an IBHRE-certified cardiac device specialist, which is the formal basis of the pacing and defibrillator side of his work.

His four fellowships are all held by election in international bodies, and they divide along the same two lines as his practice. The Society for Cardiovascular Angiography and Intervention and the American College of Cardiology cover the interventional half, the Heart Rhythm Society covers the electrophysiology half, and the European Society of Cardiology covers both.

In India he belongs to the Cardiological Society of India and the Indian Heart Rhythm Society, again one body for each half of the practice. Alongside Artemis Hospitals in Gurugram he has been at BLK Super Speciality Hospital in New Delhi.

The record therefore describes a cardiologist who has credentialled both halves of his unit's work separately rather than treating electrophysiology as an extension of coronary practice.

dr-abraham-oomman.bio:
Dr. Abraham Oomman is a Senior Consultant in interventional cardiology at Apollo Hospitals on Greams Road in Chennai, with more than 20 years of experience.

His recorded clinical work is largely diagnostic and medical rather than operative. He performs diagnostic cardiac catheterization and manages coronary artery disease, hypertension, pulmonary hypertension, cardiomyopathy, valvular heart disease and heart failure. The presence of both systemic hypertension and pulmonary hypertension on that list is notable, since the two are managed quite differently.

All three of his degrees were taken at the same institution. He read MBBS at Madras Medical College in Chennai and returned there for his MD in general medicine and his DM in cardiology, so his entire training took place in one city.

His fellowships are unusually numerous and span four countries' professional bodies. He is a Fellow of the Cardiological Society of India, of the Indian Society of Electrocardiology, of the Society for Cardiovascular Angiography and Interventions, of the American College of Cardiology and of the European Society of Cardiology.

His memberships repeat two of those and add others: MAHA, the Medical Association of Heart and Arteries, together with the Indian Medical Association, the Cardiological Society of India and the Indian Society of Electrocardiology.

His record notes that he has presented a scientific paper at the scientific sessions of both the American Heart Association and the European Society of Cardiology, which places his academic work on an international footing alongside the fellowships.

dr-b-c-kalmath.bio:
Dr. B C Kalmath is Director and Head of the Department of Cardiac Sciences at KIMS Hospitals in Thane, Mumbai, with more than 27 years of experience.

His list covers the interventional, device and rhythm sides of the specialty. He performs coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty and stenting, diagnostic cardiac catheterization and echocardiography, implants pacemakers and ICDs, and carries out cardiac ablation for arrhythmia. Medically he manages coronary artery disease, valvular heart disease, cardiomyopathy, atrial fibrillation and heart failure.

He holds an MD in internal medicine, a DM in cardiology and the DNB, and is a Fellow of the American College of Cardiology and a Member of the National Academy of Medical Sciences.

His earliest recorded distinction is also his most specific. He won the Ivan Pinto Gold Medal in the DM cardiology boards of Mumbai University in 1998, which places the start of his consultant career precisely. He later received the Johnson and Johnson Award for excellence in cardiology and the Jaycee International Award for young achievers.

His teaching work is recorded as faculty positions at many international and national interventional cardiology conferences, both in India and abroad, and he is the author of numerous national and international publications.

Taken together the record describes a department head whose clinical range spans coronary intervention, device implantation and ablation in a single practice, and whose academic standing was established early and has since been carried into conference teaching rather than into a single research field.

dr-jagadesh-madireddi.bio:
Dr. Jagadesh Madireddi is a Consultant Interventional Cardiologist at Yashoda Hospitals, Somajiguda, Hyderabad, with more than 10 years of experience.

His list covers coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty and stenting, TAVI or TAVR, and pacemaker and ICD implantation, alongside the management of coronary artery disease, valvular heart disease and heart failure.

His training is documented year by year. He qualified MBBS at Rangaraya Medical College in Andhra Pradesh in 2011, was a junior resident at Apollo Hospital in Kakinada in 2013, took his MD in internal medicine at Manipal University in Karnataka in 2016, and his DM in cardiology at the Sri Jayadeva Institute, also in Karnataka, in 2019.

Two further certifications sit on top of that base and both are procedure-specific rather than general. He is a certified TAVI operator, which is what the structural entry on his list rests on, and he is certified in orbital atherectomy for heavily calcified coronary arteries, a technique used when a vessel cannot be treated by balloon and stent alone.

He is a member of the Cardiology Society of India and of the Indian College of Cardiology.

His recognition has come in two forms since he completed training. He received the Vidya Shiromani Award in 2021, two years after his DM, and was named Emerging Interventional Cardiologist of the Year in 2025. The record therefore describes an operator early in his career whose credentials are concentrated in structural and calcified coronary work.

dr-mahesh-ghogare.bio:
Dr. Mahesh Ghogare is a Consultant cardiologist at Apollo Hospitals in Navi Mumbai, with more than 15 years of experience.

His list runs from first assessment through to intervention. He evaluates chest pain and performs 2D echocardiography, coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty and complex angioplasty, and implants pacemakers. Medically he manages coronary artery disease, hypertension, arrhythmia, valvular heart disease and heart failure, and provides preventive cardiology care.

All three of his degrees were taken at Grant Medical College and the Sir J.J. Group of Hospitals in Mumbai: the MBBS, the MD in medicine and the DM in cardiology. His whole training therefore took place at one institution in the city where he still practises.

His published work sits in interventional cardiology. He has written on coronary interventions and cardiovascular therapeutics in peer-reviewed journals including the Journal of the Association of Physicians of India and the journal of the Indian College of Cardiology, and has presented findings at the AHA and ACC cardiovascular conference. His stated research interests are interventional cardiology outcomes, complex coronary interventions and cardiac device therapy, which match the complex angioplasty and pacing entries on his clinical list.

His recognition is largely from the Cardiology Society of India. He received an award at a CSI conference and a prize at the Dr. Nagindas Khandwala Memorial Oration at CSI Mumbai in 2019, and was recognised at the Jivandas World Heart Day celebrations in the same year.

dr-v-narendra-kumar.bio:
Dr. V. Narendra Kumar is a Senior Consultant at Rela Hospital in Chennai, with more than 15 years of experience. His profile records cardiology together with heart transplant care on the cardiac surgery side.

His list covers coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty and stenting, diagnostic cardiac catheterization and echocardiography, and pacemaker and ICD implantation. Medically he manages coronary artery disease, cardiomyopathy, pulmonary hypertension and heart failure, a combination that fits the transplant work recorded against his name, since those are the conditions that lead to it.

His training has an unusual route. He read M.B.B.S. at Chengalpattu Medical College, then took an M.D. in paediatrics at Thanjavur Medical College before moving to adult cardiology with a D.M. at Madras Medical College. He also holds the FESC.

That paediatric background shows in his research. One of his three recorded studies is a pulmonary function test in children with congenital heart disease, while the other two are adult and interventional: a clinical profile of bifurcation lesions in a tertiary care centre, and a report of acute myocardial infarction presenting as an acute abdomen.

Alongside the Dr. Rela Institute and Medical Centre he has worked at Gleneagles Global Health City in Chennai, at Madras Medical College and at Chettinad Medical College in Kelambakkam, so his career has combined tertiary private practice with teaching hospital posts.

dr-amit-kumar-chaurasia.bio:
Dr. Amit Kumar Chaurasia is Chief of the Cath Lab and TAVI Unit I at Artemis Hospital in the Delhi NCR, with more than 25 years of experience across cardiology and interventional cardiology.

His list is one of the widest in this specialty. Coronary work covers angiography, angioplasty, complex angioplasty, CTO angioplasty and left main angioplasty. Structural work covers TAVI or TAVR and the MitraClip procedure. Congenital work covers ASD, VSD and PDA device closure together with the management of congenital heart disease. The rest is pacemaker and ICD implantation, 2D echocardiography, diagnostic cardiac catheterization and hypertension management.

He holds an MBBS, an MD in internal medicine and a DM in cardiology. His subspecialty training matches the two halves of his cath lab role: a fellowship in complex coronary and structural heart disease taken at GOKI in Budapest.

His career has moved across several states and one border. He has worked at RGSH in Delhi, at BLK Superspeciality Hospital in Delhi, at EHCC in Jaipur, at the Bankers Heart Institute in Surat, and at CMS in Bharatpur, Nepal, before his current post at Artemis Hospitals in Gurugram.

Taken together the record describes an operator whose single list spans adult coronary intervention, transcatheter valve work and congenital device closure, with the structural fellowship behind it taken in Hungary rather than in India.

dr-balbir-singh.bio:
Dr. Balbir Singh is Group Chairman of Cardiac Sciences, Interventional Cardiology and EPS at Max Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 40 years of experience across cardiology, interventional cardiology and cardiac electrophysiology and pacing.

His list divides evenly between the two halves of that title. Interventionally he performs coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty and complex angioplasty, and manages coronary artery disease. On the rhythm side he carries out electrophysiology studies, radiofrequency ablation and AF ablation, implants pacemakers, ICDs and CRT or CRT-D devices, and manages atrial fibrillation and arrhythmia.

His training is documented with dates. He read MBBS at Maulana Azad Medical College in Delhi in 1983 and took his MD in internal medicine there in 1987, then his DM in cardiology at Govind Ballabh Pant Hospital in New Delhi in 1992. He was elected a Fellow of the American College of Cardiology in 2005.

He was awarded the Padma Shri in 2007. His later recognition has come from operator and research competition rather than from state honours: best operator at India Live in 2016, the Golden Hand Award at AICT in Singapore in 2012, and best late breaking trial at APHRS in Taiwan in 2018.

He holds outpatient clinics at Max Super Speciality Hospital in Saket from Monday to Saturday, and at Max Super Speciality Hospital in Patparganj on the fourth Saturday of each month.

dr-charan-reddy.bio:
Dr. Charan Reddy is a Consultant Cardiologist at Apollo Hospitals in Navi Mumbai, with more than 10 years of experience across cardiology and interventional cardiology.

His list covers the coronary range at several levels of difficulty: angiography, angioplasty, complex angioplasty, CTO angioplasty for chronic occlusions and primary angioplasty for acute presentations. Alongside that he implants pacemakers and ICDs, performs 2D echocardiography, and manages coronary artery disease, hypertension and heart failure, with preventive cardiology care completing the list.

He holds an MBBS, an MD in internal medicine and a DM in cardiology as his super-specialty training. He is a Fellow of the European Society of Cardiology, holds a fellowship in interventional cardiology, and has taken additional advanced training in electrophysiology and device implantation, which is the basis of the pacing side of his practice.

His academic recognition began in training. He won the best outgoing internal medicine gold medal for academic excellence during his MD, and later took a best international presentation award at a conference of the Indian Society of Electrocardiology.

His published work is recorded in interventional cardiology and covers complex coronary interventions, pacemaker outcomes and cardiovascular disease management, appearing in journals including the Indian Heart Journal and Cardiology Research.

Taken together the record describes a cardiologist about ten years into practice whose coronary list already extends to chronic total occlusions, and who has credentialled the device side of his work separately from his interventional fellowship.

dr-g-ravikanth.bio:
Dr. G. Ravikanth is a Consultant Cardiologist at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, Hyderabad, with more than 37 years of experience.

His list is broad and includes structural work alongside the coronary core. He performs coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty and stenting, diagnostic cardiac catheterization, echocardiography, pacemaker implantation, TAVI or TAVR and the MitraClip procedure. Medically he manages coronary artery disease, valvular and rheumatic heart disease, cardiomyopathy, atrial fibrillation and heart failure.

His training was taken entirely in Hyderabad and spans a decade. He read MBBS at Gandhi Medical College under Osmania University between 1975 and 1980, took his MD at Osmania Medical College between 1982 and 1985, and his DM in cardiology at Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences.

His posts trace a route from district service into the private sector. He has worked at the Government Community Hospital in Mancherial and at Osmania Medical College and Hospital in Hyderabad, then at Mahavir Hospital, before his present post at KIMS Hospitals in Secunderabad.

He is a life member of three professional bodies: the Cardiological Society of India, the Indian Medical Association and the Association of Physicians of India.

Taken together the record describes one of the longer careers in this specialty on the platform, beginning in government service in the late 1970s and now covering a modern structural and interventional list at a large Secunderabad hospital.

dr-kala-jeethender-jain.bio:
Dr. Kala Jeethender Jain is a Consultant Interventional Cardiologist at Yashoda Hospitals, Hitec City, Hyderabad, with more than 13 years of experience. His profile records three areas: cardiology, structural and congenital heart disease interventions, and endovascular interventions.

His list covers coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty and stenting, diagnostic cardiac catheterization and TAVI or TAVR, pacemaker and ICD implantation, and on the rhythm side VT ablation, SVT ablation and cardiac ablation for arrhythmia. He also manages valvular heart disease.

His training is recorded with dates throughout. He read MBBS at Kakatiya Medical College in Warangal between 1999 and 2004 and interned at MGM Hospital in the same city in 2005 and 2006. His MD in general medicine was taken at KIMS in Narketpally between 2008 and 2011, and his DM in cardiology at Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences in Hyderabad between 2012 and 2015.

His later training is all procedural and can be dated precisely. He took hands-on training in imaging covering OCT, IVUS and physiology in 2018, attended a CTO observation programme in Tokyo in March 2019, and held the FSCAI fellowship of the Society for Cardiovascular Angiography and Interventions across 2020 and 2021.

He is a member of the Cardiology Society of India and of SCAI. The record describes an operator who has added intracoronary imaging, chronic occlusion and structural technique to a standard Indian cardiology training in a documented sequence.

dr-karthick-anjaneyan-j.bio:
Dr. Karthick Anjaneyan J is a Senior Consultant and Interventional Cardiologist at Gleneagles Global Health City in Perumbakkam, Chennai, with more than 16 years of experience across cardiology and interventional cardiology.

His list covers coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty and stenting, diagnostic cardiac catheterization and echocardiography, together with pacemaker and ICD implantation. Medically he manages coronary artery disease, valvular heart disease, cardiomyopathy, atrial fibrillation and heart failure.

He holds an M.B.B.S. and an M.D. in general medicine, and took his D.M. in cardiology at SRM Medical College Hospitals between September 2012 and September 2015. His record also notes formal training in both basic life support and advanced cardiac life support, which are certifications rather than degrees and are listed separately from his qualifications.

His career has been spent entirely in Chennai and across five institutions in the city. He has worked at Frontier Lifeline Hospitals in Mogappair, at Vijaya Hospitals in Vadapalani, at SRM Hospitals and at SRM Medical College Hospitals, where he also trained, before his present post at Gleneagles Global Health City.

Taken together the record describes an interventional cardiologist whose practice combines diagnostic imaging, coronary intervention and device implantation in one list, whose super-specialty training is precisely dated, and whose whole working life has been based in a single city rather than spread across states or countries.

dr-samir-bahl.bio:
Dr. Samir Bahl is Senior Consultant in Non-Invasive Cardiology at Marengo Asia Hospitals, Faridabad, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 21 years of experience.

His profile places him squarely on the non-invasive side of the specialty, and that has been consistent throughout his career. His list covers echocardiography, coronary angiography and diagnostic cardiac catheterization on the diagnostic side, and the management of coronary artery disease, valvular and rheumatic heart disease, cardiomyopathy, atrial fibrillation and heart failure on the medical side.

Both of his Indian degrees were taken at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences in New Delhi: the MBBS and the MD in medicine. His cardiology fellowship was taken abroad, at the Hôpitaux Universitaires de Genève in Geneva.

His posts have all carried the same non-interventional designation. He was Senior Consultant in non-interventional cardiology at Max Hospital in Shalimar Bagh and at the Alchemist Institute of Medical Sciences, and Consultant in non-interventional cardiology at Fortis Escorts Hospital in Faridabad, before his current role.

His memberships confirm where the centre of that practice lies. He belongs to the Indian Academy of Echocardiography and to the American Society of Echocardiography, two bodies devoted to cardiac imaging, alongside the Association of Physicians of India.

The record therefore describes a cardiologist who has deliberately built a career in imaging and medical management rather than in the cath lab, with training at AIIMS and in Geneva behind it.

dr-v-k-sanjeev.bio:
Dr. V K Sanjeev is an Associate Consultant in cardiology at Gleneagles Hospital in Perumbakkam, Chennai, with more than 8 years of experience.

His list covers coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty and stenting, diagnostic cardiac catheterization and echocardiography, alongside the management of coronary artery disease, valvular and rheumatic heart disease, cardiomyopathy, atrial fibrillation and heart failure.

His training is documented in three dated stages. He read MBBS at Rajah Muthiah Medical College in Chidambaram between 2006 and 2012, took his MD in internal medicine at PSG Medical College in Coimbatore between 2012 and 2015, and his DNB in cardiology at the Southern Railway Head Quarters Hospital in Chennai between 2018 and 2021.

His hospital history is unusually broad for the length of his career and is concentrated in Chennai. He has worked at Muthu Hospital in Pulianthope, at Chennai Meenakshi Multi-Speciality Hospital and at St. Isabel Hospital, both in Mylapore, and with HeartTeam India, as well as at Muthukumaran Medical College in Mangadu and at Kasturba Medical College in Manipal.

Taken together the record describes a cardiologist in the early part of his consultant career whose qualifications were completed in 2021 and who has since built a general cardiology list combining coronary intervention with the medical management of valve, rheumatic and rhythm disease at a large tertiary hospital in the city where he trained.

dr-v-dayasagar-rao.bio:
Dr. V. Dayasagar Rao is a Consultant cardiologist at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, Hyderabad. His record shows more than 61 years in practice, the longest career on the platform in this specialty.

His list is nonetheless a modern one. Alongside coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty and stenting, diagnostic cardiac catheterization, echocardiography and pacemaker implantation, it includes TAVI or TAVR and the MitraClip procedure. Medically he manages coronary artery disease, valvular and rheumatic heart disease, cardiomyopathy, atrial fibrillation and heart failure.

His qualifications were taken over eleven years and on two continents. He read MBBS at Osmania Medical College in Hyderabad in 1964, was elected FRCP of the Royal College of Edinburgh in 1969 and FRCP of the Royal College of Canada in 1971, and took his DM in cardiology at CMC, Vellore, in 1975.

His posts are recorded with their spans. He was at Christian Medical College from 1971 to 1978, at Osmania Medical College in Hyderabad from 1978 to 1983, and at Durgabai Deshmukh Hospital in Hyderabad from 1983 to 2008, before his present post at the Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences.

Two further commitments have run alongside the clinical work since 1994: he has been a recognised teacher for DNB cardiology under the National Board, and an active participant in clinical trials, both for more than three decades.

dr-venkatesh-t-k.bio:
Dr. Venkatesh T K is a Senior Consultant cardiologist at Apollo Hospitals on Bannerghatta Road in Bengaluru, with more than 15 years of experience.

His list runs from first presentation through to intervention. He evaluates and manages stable angina, hypertension, cardiomyopathy and heart failure, provides preventive cardiology care, and performs 2D echocardiography. In the cath lab he performs coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty, complex angioplasty and primary angioplasty, and he implants pacemakers.

He holds an MBBS and an MD in medicine, and his cardiology qualification is the DNB, which his record specifies as covering interventional cardiology. That specification matches the weighting of his list, where three of the four angioplasty entries describe more demanding categories of case rather than routine stenting.

His entrance examination results are recorded and are unusually strong. He secured an all India rank with 99.1 in the TN National Entrance in 2004 and all India rank 43 in the All India PGIMS Entrance in 2005.

His speaking and observing work is also documented. He was invited as guest faculty and speaker at the 9th Postgraduate Conference on Medical Sciences at Mookambika and Malpe Hospital, and attended the Medical Enterprises Society MEP Convention at the MERT Institute of Speech and Hearing in Chennai as an observing visitor. His published work includes studies on the efficacy of therapy in coronary conditions and post-fellowship research involving medical interventions.

dr-vivudh-pratap-singh.bio:
Dr. Vivudh Pratap Singh is a Senior Consultant at the Fortis Escorts Heart Institute in the Delhi NCR, with more than 15 years of experience. His profile records cardiology, interventional cardiology and cardiac sciences.

His list is concentrated on coronary work. He performs coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty, complex angioplasty and primary angioplasty, manages coronary artery disease, and implants pacemakers. The distinction between complex and primary angioplasty is recorded separately, the first describing technically demanding elective cases and the second the emergency treatment of an evolving infarct.

He read MBBS at King George Medical College and took his MD in medicine there as a gold medalist, followed by the DM in cardiology. He was also awarded the Professor N.N. Gupta Gold Medal during his training at the same college, so his record carries two separate medals from one institution.

His two fellowships are held by election in international bodies. He is a Fellow of the Society for Cardiovascular Angiography and Interventions and a Fellow of the European Society of Cardiology, and his profile lists both as recognitions in their own right as well as qualifications.

He practises at Fortis Hospital in Okhla, New Delhi.

Taken together the record describes an interventional cardiologist whose academic standing was established with two gold medals in training, and whose present practice is focused on the coronary arteries rather than spread across structural or rhythm work.

dr-alka-adlakha.bio:
Dr. Alka Adlakha is a Consultant at Medanta - The Medicity in the Delhi NCR, with more than 23 years of experience. Her profile places her in clinical, preventive and non-invasive cardiology rather than in interventional work.

Her list follows that description exactly. She performs echocardiography and manages coronary artery disease, valvular and rheumatic heart disease, cardiomyopathy, pulmonary hypertension, atrial fibrillation and heart failure. There are no catheter procedures on the list, which is consistent with a practice built around imaging, prevention and medical management.

Her route into medicine began with a B.Sc. with honours in zoology at Delhi University. She then took her M.D. as a physician at the I.I. Mechnikov St. Petersburg State Medical Academy in Russia in 2003.

Her cardiology qualifications were all added afterwards and in sequence. She took a postgraduate diploma in clinical cardiology through IGNOU and Metro Heart Hospital in December 2008, a fellowship in non-invasive cardiology at Medanta Hospital under Dr. R.R. Kasliwal in 2011, and a certificate course in evidence-based diabetes management run by PHFI at Medanta between December 2011 and December 2012. That last qualification is what connects the preventive side of her profile to a specific metabolic risk factor.

Alongside Medanta Hospital in Gurugram she holds clinics at the Defence Colony Mediclinic in Delhi, at the Cybercity Mediclinic and at the Subhash Chowk Mediclinic in Gurugram.

dr-amit-mittal.bio:
Dr. Amit Mittal is a Senior Consultant at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in the Delhi NCR, with more than 22 years of experience across cardiology and interventional cardiology.

His list spans two distinct fields. Coronary work covers angiography, angioplasty, complex angioplasty, CTO angioplasty and primary angioplasty. Device and rhythm work covers electrophysiology studies, radiofrequency ablation, and the implantation of pacemakers, ICDs and CRT or CRT-D devices. He also manages coronary artery disease, cardiomyopathy and heart failure.

His degrees were all taken in Delhi. He read MBBS and took his MD in internal medicine at Maulana Azad Medical College under the University of Delhi, then his DM in cardiology at GB Pant Hospital under the same university.

Both of his fellowships were taken in Australia, and they account for the two halves of his practice separately. His interventional cardiology fellowship was at St. Vincent's Hospital in Sydney and his electrophysiology and pacing fellowship at the Royal Melbourne Hospital. He also holds the FSCAI.

His academic record begins in training with a college gold medal as best graduate and a university gold medal for outstanding academic achievement. He later received the Dr. J.C. Pattani Award of the Cardiological Society of India for excellence in cardiac care related to obstetrics and gynecology, an area of the specialty that rarely appears on a cardiologist's record.

He practises at Apollo Hospitals in Sarita Vihar on Mathura Road.

dr-ankesh-kumar-agarwal.bio:
Dr. Ankesh Kumar Agarwal is a Senior Consultant at Fortis Hospital, Shalimar Bagh, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 12 years of experience across cardiac sciences and interventional cardiology.

His list is wide for the length of his career. Coronary work covers angiography, angioplasty, complex angioplasty and CTO angioplasty, with imaging guidance recorded separately as IVUS guided and OCT guided angioplasty. On the valve and congenital side he performs TAVI or TAVR and ASD and VSD device closure, and his device work covers pacemaker, ICD and CRT-D implantation.

He took his M.D. in general medicine at Sarojini Naidu Medical College in Agra, Uttar Pradesh, and his D.M. in cardiology at VMMC and Safdarjung Hospital in New Delhi.

His posts have been in Delhi throughout. He has worked at Lady Hardinge Medical College, at Janakpuri Super Speciality Hospital and at Max Super Speciality Hospital, before his present senior consultant post in cardiology at Fortis Hospital in Shalimar Bagh.

His recognition covers both training and research. He won a gold medal in MBBS, received an award at Cardiovascular Research Convergence, and holds a B.C. Roy Award.

Taken together the record describes an operator who, twelve years into practice, already performs image-guided complex coronary work, transcatheter valve implantation and congenital device closure, a combination usually assembled over a considerably longer career.

dr-anoop-agrawal.bio:
Dr. Anoop Agrawal is a Senior Consultant cardiologist at Yashoda Hospitals, Secunderabad, Hyderabad, with more than 18 years of experience.

His list is weighted towards structural intervention. Alongside coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty and stenting and diagnostic cardiac catheterization, he performs TAVI or TAVR and the MitraClip procedure, and manages valvular heart disease, coronary artery disease, cardiomyopathy and heart failure.

His training was almost entirely taken in the USA and is recorded year by year. He qualified MBBS at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences in New Delhi in 2008, then completed a residency in internal medicine at the Loyola University Medical Center in Chicago in 2012 and a fellowship in cardiovascular diseases at the same centre in 2015. His interventional fellowship followed at St. Vincent Hospital in Indianapolis in 2016.

That sequence is unusual among the cardiologists on this platform, most of whom take an Indian MD and DM before any overseas training. In his case the entire postgraduate pathway, from internal medicine residency through general cardiology to interventional subspecialty, was completed in the USA.

His affiliations record both sides of that career. He remains associated with St. Vincent Hospital in Indianapolis and the Loyola University Medical Center in Chicago, and in Hyderabad he has worked at CARE Hospital in Banjara Hills and at KIMS Hospital before his present post at Yashoda Hospitals in Secunderabad.

dr-milind-phadke.bio:
Dr. Milind Phadke is a Senior Consultant at Gleneagles BGS Hospital in Parel, Mumbai, with more than 14 years of experience. His profile records cardiology alongside interventional paediatric cardiac work.

His list covers coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty and stenting, diagnostic cardiac catheterization, echocardiography and TAVI or TAVR, and he manages valvular heart disease, cardiomyopathy, pulmonary hypertension and heart failure.

He holds an MBBS, an MD and a DM in cardiology, and his record notes that he was university topper and gold medalist at all three of those qualifying examinations. To come top of the university at every stage of a medical career is rare, and it is the single most distinctive fact in his profile.

His academic output has continued on the same scale. He has published over 40 articles in peer-reviewed national and international journals and has authored more than 10 book chapters, a volume of writing well above what the length of his career would suggest.

His teaching work is formally recognised. He is a recognised teacher for the DM cardiology course at the Maharashtra University of Health Sciences, and serves as an examiner for DM cardiology and DNB cardiology practical examinations at various institutes, so he both trains and assesses cardiologists in addition to his clinical practice.

The record therefore describes a cardiologist whose academic standing, teaching role and published output are as prominent as his interventional and structural list.

dr-nagendra-singh-chouhan.bio:
Dr. Nagendra Singh Chouhan is Senior Director at Medanta - The Medicity in the Delhi NCR, with more than 15 years of experience in interventional cardiology and electrophysiology.

His list covers both fields in detail. Coronary work includes angiography, angioplasty, complex angioplasty and primary angioplasty, with three separate guidance techniques recorded alongside them: IVUS guided angioplasty, OCT guided angioplasty and FFR or iFR assessment. Structural work is TAVI or TAVR. Device work covers pacemaker, ICD and CRT-D implantation.

He holds an M.B.B.S., an M.D. in general medicine and a D.N.B. in cardiology, followed by a fellowship and a postdoctoral National Board fellowship, both in interventional cardiology and electrophysiology.

His advanced training was taken in four countries and divides along the same two lines as his practice. Complex coronary intervention, structural heart disease intervention and percutaneous aortic valve implantation were trained at the Mayo Clinic and Cedars-Sinai Hospital in the USA. ICD and CRT-D implantation were trained in China and Singapore.

He received a best case award from the National Interventional Council in 2016.

Taken together the record describes an operator who has credentialled physiology and intracoronary imaging as separate skills rather than as adjuncts to stenting, and whose device training was obtained independently of his coronary and structural work.

dr-nikhil-kumar.bio:
Dr. Nikhil Kumar is Senior Director at the Fortis Memorial Research Institute in the Delhi NCR, with more than 39 years of experience across cardiology and interventional cardiology.

His list covers three distinct kinds of catheter work. Coronary intervention includes angiography, angioplasty, complex angioplasty and CTO angioplasty. Device work covers pacemaker, ICD and CRT or CRT-D implantation. Congenital and structural work covers ASD, VSD and PDA device closure together with TAVI or TAVR. He also manages coronary artery disease and valvular heart disease, and provides preventive cardiology care.

He holds an MBBS, an MD in general medicine and a DM in cardiology.

His career began in the army and is unusual in that respect. He was Professor and Head of the Department of Cardiology at Army Hospital Research and Referral in New Delhi, and from that post received two service commendations: the General Officer Commanding in Chief's Commendation for meritorious service in 2001 and the Chief of Army Staff's Commendation in 2006.

He afterwards moved into the private sector as Director of Cardiology for the Metro Group of Hospitals in New Delhi, then Director of Cardiology at the Fortis Memorial Research Institute in Gurgaon, and now holds his senior director post at Fortis Hospital in the same city.

Taken together the record describes a cardiologist whose academic and clinical standing was built in military service before moving to lead cardiology departments across three private hospital groups.

dr-sumeet-sethi.bio:
Dr. Sumeet Sethi is Director of Interventional Cardiology at Max Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 24 years of experience.

His list covers coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty and stenting, diagnostic cardiac catheterization, echocardiography and pacemaker implantation, together with the management of coronary artery disease, valvular heart disease, cardiomyopathy, atrial fibrillation and heart failure.

His training was taken almost entirely within the armed forces medical system. He read MBBS at the Armed Forces Medical College in Pune, Maharashtra, then took his DNB in internal medicine at Army Hospital Research and Referral in Delhi. His super-specialty training was in the civilian sector: the DM in cardiology at the Institute of Cardiology at GSVM Medical College in Kanpur.

His society memberships are split between India and the United States. He belongs to the Cardiological Society of India at both Delhi and national level, to the Association of Physicians of India, and to SCAI, the Society of Catheterization and Angiographic Interventions in the USA.

His recognition is in case presentation rather than in a research programme. He has received a best challenging case award at international cardiology conferences, which places his reputation with the difficult individual case rather than with a trial or a series.

He practises within Max Healthcare. The record therefore describes an interventional cardiologist trained in military medicine, credentialled in the United States as well as India, and now heading an interventional unit in Delhi.

dr-ankit-jain.bio:
Dr. Ankit Jain is Additional Director of Cardiology and In-charge of Electrophysiology and Pacing at the Fortis Memorial Research Institute in the Delhi NCR, with more than 15 years of experience.

Rhythm work is the larger half of his list. He performs electrophysiology studies, radiofrequency ablation, AF ablation, SVT ablation and VT ablation, treats WPW syndrome, and manages arrhythmia and atrial fibrillation. His device work covers pacemaker, ICD and CRT or CRT-D implantation. Alongside that he performs coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty and complex angioplasty, and on the congenital side ASD, VSD and PDA device closure with congenital heart disease management.

He holds an MBBS and an MD in internal medicine, and took his DM in cardiology at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences in Delhi.

His subspecialty training is the most distinctive part of the record. His fellowship in cardiac electrophysiology and pacing was taken at Taipei Veterans General Hospital in Taiwan, and he was selected for it by the Asia Pacific Heart Rhythm Society rather than applying independently. He is also a Fellow of the Society for Cardiovascular Angiography and Interventions in the USA, so both halves of his practice carry an international credential.

Before his present post he was faculty in the Department of Cardiology at Safdarjung Hospital in New Delhi, and he now works at Fortis Hospital in Gurgaon.

dr-gajinder-kumar-goyal.bio:
Dr. Gajinder Kumar Goyal is Clinical Director of Cardiology at Marengo Asia Hospitals, Faridabad, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 18 years of experience across cardiology and interventional cardiology.

His list covers coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty and stenting, and diagnostic cardiac catheterization on the interventional side, pacemaker and ICD implantation on the device side, and echocardiography on the imaging side. Medically he manages coronary artery disease, valvular heart disease, atrial fibrillation and heart failure.

He holds an MBBS, an MD and a DM in cardiology, and is a Fellow of the American College of Cardiology.

His career has been built almost entirely in Faridabad and the surrounding NCR, and he has held a departmental leadership title at most of his posts. He was Director of Cardiology at SSB Multi Specialty Hospital in Faridabad and Senior Consultant in cardiology at Sarvodaya Super Specialty Hospital in the same city, and Consultant in cardiology at Max Hospital in Saket, before becoming Clinical Director of cardiology at Marengo Asia Hospitals in Faridabad.

That progression is the shape of the record: four posts in the same region, three of them carrying a director or senior consultant title, with a clinical range that combines routine coronary intervention, device implantation and the medical management of valve, rhythm and failure disease rather than a narrow subspecialty focus.

dr-hardeep-kaur-grewal.bio:
Dr. Hardeep Kaur Grewal is a Senior Consultant at Medanta - The Medicity in the Delhi NCR, with more than 10 years of experience. Her profile places her in clinical and preventive cardiology and cardiac care rather than in interventional work.

Her list is diagnostic and medical. She performs echocardiography, coronary angiography and diagnostic cardiac catheterization, and manages coronary artery disease, valvular and rheumatic heart disease, cardiomyopathy, pulmonary hypertension, atrial fibrillation and heart failure.

She holds an MBBS and the MRCP of the United Kingdom. Her two further qualifications match the two halves of her profile: a fellowship in non-invasive cardiology covering basic and advanced imaging, and a postgraduate diploma in clinical and preventive cardiology.

Echocardiography is where her recorded academic work sits, and all three of her distinctions come from case competitions in that field. At the 2nd World Summit of Echocardiography in New Delhi in October 2013 she was a finalist twice: once in the clinical case award competition for an unusual association of submitral aneurysm with thoracic and abdominal aortic aneurysms, and once in the rapid fire case presentation session for an extremely unusual combination of a rare variant of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy with rheumatic mitral stenosis. At Echo-Delhi in February 2016 she won first prize in the clinical case award competition for an LAD mycotic aneurysm.

She practises at Medanta – The Medicity Hospital in Gurugram.

dr-kuldeep-arora.bio:
Dr. Kuldeep Arora is Senior Consultant Cardiologist, Unit Head and Chief of the Cath Lab for Unit II at Artemis Hospital in the Delhi NCR, with more than 16 years of experience across cardiology and interventional cardiology.

His list runs across three kinds of catheter work. Coronary intervention covers angiography, angioplasty, complex angioplasty and primary angioplasty for acute presentations. Device work covers pacemaker, ICD and CRT or CRT-D implantation. Congenital work covers ASD device closure together with the management of congenital heart disease. He also performs diagnostic cardiac catheterization, manages valvular heart disease and provides preventive cardiology care.

He holds an MBBS, an MD in general medicine and a DM in cardiology.

His career has moved across four cities before Gurugram. He has worked at the Sri Jayadeva Institute of Cardiovascular Sciences and Research in Bangalore, at Wockhardt Hospitals in Nagpur, at Seven Hills Hospital in Mumbai and at Paras Hospital in Gurgaon, before his present post at Artemis Hospitals.

That spread is what distinguishes the record. Rather than building a career within one hospital group or one region, he has held posts in the south, the centre and the west of the country before taking charge of a cath lab unit in the Delhi NCR, with a clinical range that covers adult coronary intervention, device implantation and congenital device closure in a single list.

dr-rajendra-kumar-agarwal.bio:
Dr. Rajendra Kumar Agarwal is a Senior Consultant at Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 24 years of experience. His profile records cardiology, interventional cardiology and cardiac electrophysiology.

His list spans all three. Interventional work covers coronary angiography and coronary angioplasty with stenting, structural work covers TAVI or TAVR and the MitraClip procedure, and rhythm work covers cardiac ablation for arrhythmia with pacemaker and ICD implantation. He also performs echocardiography and manages coronary artery disease and valvular heart disease.

His qualifications were accumulated in an unusually long sequence, each one adding a layer to that practice. He took his MD in internal medicine at SN Medical College in Jodhpur under the University of Rajasthan. His DNB in cardiology and a fellowship in noninvasive cardiology were both taken at the Escort Heart Institute and Research Centre in New Delhi. He then took the FNB in interventional cardiology, a post-super-speciality qualification of the National Board of Examinations, at Max Hospital in Saket, followed by a post-super-speciality fellowship in cardiac pacing and electrophysiology at the same hospital.

His final training was taken abroad: advanced cardiac electrophysiology at the Liverpool Heart and Chest Hospital in the United Kingdom. He also holds the MNAMS.

Alongside the hospital in Saket he practises at the Max Multi Speciality Centre in Panchsheel Park.

dr-sanjeev-chaudhary.bio:
Dr. Sanjeev Chaudhary is Chairman of Cardiology at Marengo Asia Hospitals, Gurugram, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 22 years of experience across cardiology and interventional cardiology.

His list is notable for how much of it is non-invasive assessment. Alongside coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty, primary angioplasty, complex angioplasty, diagnostic cardiac catheterization and pacemaker implantation, it records chest pain evaluation, TMT or stress testing, 2D echocardiography and Holter monitoring. Those four entries describe the workup that precedes intervention rather than the intervention itself, and few cardiologists on this platform list them separately. He also manages coronary artery disease and heart failure.

He holds an MBBS, an MD in general medicine and the DNB in cardiology.

His career has been spent in the Gurugram hospitals. He has worked at Escorts Hospital, at Paras Hospital and at FMRI in Gurugram, was Director of Cardiology at Fortis Hospital in the same city, and now holds the chairmanship of cardiology at Marengo Asia Hospitals.

Taken together the record describes a cardiologist who has led departments at two hospitals in one city, and whose clinical list deliberately covers the full path a patient with chest pain follows, from stress test and Holter through echocardiography and angiography to angioplasty, rather than only the catheter work at the end of it.

dr-suman-bhandari.bio:
Dr. Suman Bhandari is a Consultant at the Fortis Escorts Heart Institute in Okhla, New Delhi, with more than 38 years of experience in cardiology.

His practice is concentrated almost entirely on the coronary arteries, and his list separates that work into distinct categories rather than grouping it. Alongside coronary angiography and standard coronary angioplasty, it records complex angioplasty, CTO angioplasty, left main angioplasty and primary angioplasty. Each of those describes a different order of difficulty: the chronically occluded vessel, the left main stem, and the emergency case treated during an evolving infarct. IVUS guided angioplasty is listed separately again, which records intravascular imaging as part of how those cases are done rather than as an occasional adjunct.

The medical side of his list follows the same territory. He manages coronary artery disease, treats stable angina and unstable angina as separate entries, provides preventive cardiology care and performs 2D echocardiography. The presence of both angina categories alongside preventive care describes a practice that covers the disease before, during and after intervention.

He holds an MBBS, an MD and a DM, and four fellowships held by election: the FACC, the FESC, the FSCAI and the FIMSA.

Taken together the record describes a cardiologist of nearly four decades whose work has stayed within coronary intervention, and whose credentials in that field are recognised by four separate professional bodies.

dr-t-n-c-padmanabhan.bio:
Dr. T.N.C. Padmanabhan is a Consultant Interventional Cardiologist at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, Hyderabad, with more than 41 years of experience.

His list covers coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty and stenting, diagnostic cardiac catheterization, echocardiography and pacemaker implantation, together with the structural procedures TAVI or TAVR and the MitraClip. Medically he manages coronary artery disease, valvular and rheumatic heart disease, cardiomyopathy, atrial fibrillation and heart failure.

His qualifications are dated throughout. He read M.B.B.S. at S.V. University in 1984 and took his M.D. there in 1988, then his D.M. in cardiology at Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences between January 1990 and December 1992.

His posts follow directly from that training. He was at Apollo Hospitals in Chennai from September 1988, then at Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences in Hyderabad, and at Mahavir Hospital in the same city from September 1996 to December 2003, before his present post at the Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences in Secunderabad.

He is a life member of the Cardiological Society of India.

Taken together the record describes a cardiologist who trained in the late 1980s and early 1990s, spent the middle of his career in the Hyderabad teaching and private hospitals, and whose present list has kept pace with the field to include transcatheter valve implantation and mitral repair alongside the coronary work he began with.

dr-venkat-rayudu-nekkanti.bio:
Dr. Venkat Rayudu Nekkanti is a Senior Consultant Cardiologist at Apollo Health City, Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad, with more than 40 years of experience.

His list is built around assessment and medical management rather than around the cath lab alone. He performs coronary angiography, coronary angioplasty and 2D echocardiography, evaluates chest pain, and provides preoperative cardiac clearance and preventive cardiology care. Medically he manages coronary artery disease, hypertension, valvular and rheumatic heart disease, cardiomyopathy and heart failure.

He holds an MBBS, an MD in general medicine and a DM in cardiology.

The most striking entry in his record concerns the start of his career. He received a Best Service Award from the Government of Andhra Pradesh in October 1985 for successfully conducting the first-ever angioplasty in India, and the same distinction is recorded a second time in his profile as a best service award for the first coronary angioplasty in the country.

His later recognition is academic and sits with echocardiography. He received a best paper award from the Indian Academy of Echocardiography, and in 2011 a best paper presentation award from the Indian Society of Echocardiography for work on complex aortic plaques in cryptogenic stroke, a subject that connects cardiac imaging to the investigation of stroke of unknown cause.

The record therefore describes a career that began at the point angioplasty was introduced in India and has since settled into imaging, prevention and the medical side of cardiology.

dr-mrinal-prakash.bio:
Dr. Mrinal Prakash is a Consultant Orthopaedic Surgeon at KIMS Hospital, Thane, Mumbai, with more than 11 years of experience.

His list divides into three. Arthroplasty covers total knee and total hip replacement, partial knee replacement, robotic knee replacement, revision knee and revision hip replacement, and shoulder replacement. Arthroscopy and sports surgery cover ACL and PCL reconstruction, meniscus repair, rotator cuff repair and shoulder instability. Trauma covers fracture fixation, non-union repair and tendon repair.

His qualifications map onto those divisions. He holds an MBBS, an MS and the DNB in orthopaedics, with separate fellowships in robotic joint replacement, revision joint replacement, and arthroscopy and sports medicine, plus a Depuy arthroplasty fellowship. He is certified in Mako Stryker robotic arthroplasty, holds the MRCS A of England and AO Trauma certification from Switzerland, took trauma training at the Technische Universität München, and holds the FIFA diploma in football medicine.

His published work is in knee arthroplasty and is recent. He has compared the safety profile of bilateral simultaneous against staggered total knee arthroplasty in the Journal of Arthroplasty, compared patient-reported outcomes of robotic against manual total knee arthroplasty in staged bilateral cases in the Journal of Orthopaedics, and compared partial against total knee arthroplasty for isolated antero-medial osteoarthritis in the SICOT Journal.

He belongs to the Indian Orthopaedic Association, the Indian Society of Hip and Knee Surgeons, the Asia Pacific Arthroplasty Society and the Bombay Orthopaedic Society, and has served on faculty and organising committees for the ISHKS and SOAR conferences in Hyderabad.

dr-ram-chidambaram.bio:
Dr. Ram Chidambaram is Clinical Director and Consultant Orthopaedic Surgeon at MGM Healthcare in Chennai, with more than 34 years of experience.

The shoulder and elbow are the centre of his practice. He performs rotator cuff repair and shoulder replacement, treats shoulder instability and frozen shoulder, and manages tennis elbow and golfer's elbow. His hand work covers carpal tunnel release and tendon repair, and he also performs ACL and PCL reconstruction and fracture fixation.

His qualifications were taken over fifteen years across three countries' systems. He read MBBS at Thanjavur Medical College in 1992, took a Diploma in Orthopaedics in 1996 and an MS in orthopaedics in 1997 at Trivandrum Medical College, and the DNB in orthopaedics through the National Board in 1998. In the UK he was elected FRCS in general surgery by the Royal College of Surgeons of Glasgow in 2001 and FRCS in trauma and orthopaedics by the Intercollegiate Specialty Board in 2007.

His memberships are unusually international and cluster around his subspecialty. He belongs to the British Elbow and Shoulder Society, the Shoulder and Elbow Society of India, the American Association of Orthopaedic Surgeons, the British Indian Orthopaedic Society, the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Glasgow, the AO Trauma Group and the General Medical Council, alongside Indian and Tamil Nadu arthroscopy and orthopaedic associations.

He was elected President of the Shoulder and Elbow Society of India in 2017, received the TNOA Achiever Award in 2018, and in 2019 both the Presidential Gold Medal of the British Elbow and Shoulder Society and an associate editorship of its journal.

dr-raju-vaishya.bio:
Dr. Raju Vaishya is Senior Consultant in Orthopedics and Joint Replacement Surgery at Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in the Delhi NCR, with more than 43 years of experience.

His list is built around the replaced joint. He performs total knee and total hip replacement, revision knee and revision hip replacement, robotic knee replacement and shoulder replacement. Alongside that he carries out arthroscopic knee and shoulder surgery, ACL reconstruction, rotator cuff repair, meniscus repair and fracture fixation, so reconstructive and sports work sit beside the arthroplasty core.

He holds an MBBS, an MS in orthopedics, an MCh in orthopedics with a fellowship in joint replacement, and the FRCS of the Royal College of Surgeons, together with further fellowships and advanced training in joint replacement and arthroscopic surgery.

His society memberships are among the most extensive in this specialty on the platform. He belongs to the Indian Orthopaedic Association, the Delhi Orthopaedic Association, the Indian Arthroscopy Society, the Indian Medical Association and the Association of Surgeons of India, and internationally to the British Orthopaedic Association, SICOT, the AO Foundation and ISKOT, the International Society for Knowledge in Orthopaedics and Traumatology.

His record notes multiple national and international awards for excellence in orthopedic surgery and research, recognition from orthopedic associations and medical institutions for both clinical and academic work, and a large number of peer-reviewed publications, which his profile describes as a prolific contribution to the orthopedic literature.

dr-raghuveer-reddy.bio:
Dr. Raghuveer Reddy is a Consultant Arthroscopic Surgeon at the Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences in Secunderabad, Hyderabad, with more than 35 years of experience across orthopedics, sports medicine and arthroscopic surgery.

His list covers the sports knee, the shoulder and the elbow. He performs ACL and PCL reconstruction, meniscus repair, rotator cuff repair and arthroscopic surgery, treats shoulder instability and frozen shoulder, and manages tennis elbow, golfer's elbow and trigger finger. His arthroplasty work is total knee, partial knee and shoulder replacement, and his trauma work is fracture fixation, non-union repair and tendon repair.

His training is documented across four countries. He read M.B.B.S. at the University of Mysore between 1986 and 1991, took his M.S. in orthopaedics at Kasturba Medical College in Manipal between 1992 and 1995, and the D.N.B. in orthopaedics in December 1996. His arthroscopy and knee surgery fellowship followed at Manipal between 1997 and 1998, sports medicine at the Technical University of Munich in 1998, and shoulder surgery twice: at the Western Shoulder Clinic in Perth in 2005 and at the Carell Clinic in Dallas in 2010.

He is an executive member and national faculty member of the Indian Arthroscopy Society, sits on the medical advisory board of the Sports Authority of Andhra Pradesh, and has lectured at IAS, ISAKOS and OASIS meetings. His unit is recognised as a learning centre for training orthopaedic surgeons in arthroscopic surgery.

dr-b-sai-phani-chandra.bio:
Dr. B. Sai Phani Chandra is a Senior Consultant Orthopaedic Surgeon at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, Hyderabad, with more than 31 years of experience.

His list spans arthroplasty, arthroscopy and trauma. He performs total knee and total hip replacement, partial knee replacement, robotic knee replacement, hip resurfacing, and revision knee and revision hip replacement. His arthroscopic work covers ACL and PCL reconstruction, meniscus repair and rotator cuff repair, and his trauma work covers fracture fixation, non-union repair and tendon repair.

His training began in India and was later extended abroad in four separate placements. He read MBBS at Kakatiya Medical College in Warangal, then took his DNB in orthopaedics and sports medicine at Kamineni Hospitals in Hyderabad along with fellowships there in joint replacement and knee arthroscopy, and a further joint replacement fellowship at SRM Hospitals in Chennai. His overseas training was cadaveric revision arthroplasty at Chulalongkorn University in Thailand, an observership in advanced shoulder and knee arthroscopy at the Asan Medical Center in South Korea, and a scrubbed observership in advanced shoulder arthroscopy at Clinica Ars Medica and Mendrisio Regional Hospital in Switzerland. He also has advanced training in unicondylar Oxford knee replacement at Ganga Hospital.

He won a gold medal for a paper on the role of zoledronic acid in musculoskeletal diseases, and has been co-investigator in two multicentric studies on knee osteoarthritis. His publications cover arthroscopic ACL reconstruction techniques, the ZIMMERSPLINT technique for intra-articular phalangeal fractures, and single bundle against double bundle ACL reconstruction.

dr-sandeep-kumar-deep.bio:
Dr. Sandeep Kumar Deep is Consultant in Robotic Joint Replacement and Orthopaedic Surgery at Sarvodaya Hospital, Faridabad, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 12 years of experience.

His list is wide. Arthroplasty covers total knee and total hip replacement, partial and robotic knee replacement, and revision knee and hip replacement. Sports and arthroscopic work covers ACL and PCL reconstruction, meniscus repair and rotator cuff repair. He also treats tennis elbow, golfer's elbow, trigger finger, frozen shoulder and advanced knee osteoarthritis, and performs fracture fixation, non-union repair and joint injection.

He read MBBS at Darbhanga Medical College in Bihar and took his MS in orthopaedics at Agartala Govt. Medical College in Tripura. Four fellowships followed, in three countries: arthroscopy and arthroplasty at Blackburn Teaching Hospital and Burnley General Hospital in the UK, joint replacement in Adelaide, arthroscopy and sports medicine at Fortis Hospital in Mohali, and robotic primary, complex and revision hip and knee replacement at Max Super Speciality Hospital in Patparganj.

His published work is recent and largely on functional outcomes after fixation. He has reported on distal femoral fractures treated with a locking compression plate, on arthroscopic ACL reconstruction using a peroneus longus tendon autograft, on plate osteosynthesis in distal humerus and midclavicular fractures, and on blood loss, pain score and outcome in bilateral total knee arthroplasty with and without a tourniquet.

He won gold and silver medals for paper presentations at NEOSCON 2019 in Gangtok and the East Zone round of the Torrent Young Scholar Awards in 2018.

dr-k-krishnaiah.bio:
Dr. K. Krishnaiah is a Senior Consultant orthopaedic surgeon at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, Hyderabad, with more than 40 years of experience.

His list is one of the widest in the specialty on this platform. Arthroplasty covers total knee and total hip replacement, partial knee replacement, hip resurfacing, ankle replacement, and revision knee and hip replacement. Reconstructive work covers ACL and PCL reconstruction, meniscus repair, rotator cuff repair, Achilles repair and tendon repair. He also manages advanced hip and knee osteoarthritis, limb length discrepancy and limb lengthening surgery, and performs fracture fixation and non-union repair.

His qualifications were taken in India and the UK. He read M.B.B.S. at S.V.
