Medical College in Tirupathi in May 1982, was elected F.R.C.S. by the Royal College of Surgeons of Edinburgh in October 1989, and took his M.Ch in orthopaedics at the University of Liverpool in December 1992 alongside a fellowship at Broadgreen Hospital and Liverpool University that year. He later added two legal qualifications: an LLb at Osmania University in 2003 and a postgraduate diploma in law at NALSAR University in 2005.

His posts have included Medway Maritime Hospital in Kent and Broadgreen Hospital in Liverpool, and in India Medwin Hospital, Mediciti Hospital and the Mediciti Institute of Medical Sciences, and M.J. Naidu Hospital in Vijayawada.

He teaches on AO basic and advanced courses across India, convened the Basic Arthroplasty Course of the Royal College of Surgeons of Edinburgh in Hyderabad in 2003, and tutored its MRCS, MS and DNB courses in 2004.

dr-dasaradha-rama-reddy-tetali.bio:
Dr. Dasaradha Rama Reddy Tetali is a Senior Consultant Orthopaedic Surgeon at Yashoda Hospitals, Somajiguda, Hyderabad, with more than 34 years of experience. His profile records orthopedics together with spine surgery.

His list runs from the joint to the foot. Arthroplasty covers total knee and total hip replacement, partial knee replacement and revision knee replacement. Arthroscopic and sports work covers ACL reconstruction, meniscus repair and rotator cuff repair. Trauma covers fracture fixation, non-union repair and tendon repair. His foot and ankle work is bunion surgery for hallux valgus and the treatment of plantar fasciitis, two conditions that appear on few other orthopaedic lists here.

He holds an MBBS, an MS in orthopaedics and a D. Ortho, together with an MCh, the FICS of the International College of Surgeons, and an AO fellowship.

Before his present post he worked at Gandhi Hospital and at Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences, both in Hyderabad, so his career has combined teaching hospital practice with the private sector in a single city.

His society work is extensive: the Indian Orthopaedic Association, TCOS, OASIS, ICS, APAS, SIASA and TOSA, and he serves on AO faculty.

His two recorded honours are national rather than professional. He was named an Outstanding Citizen of the Country by the President, Shri Pranab Mukherjee, and the Most Inspiring Orthopedic Surgeon of the Country by TIMES.

dr-pankaj-walecha.bio:
Dr. Pankaj Walecha is Director and Head of Robotic Knee and Minimally Invasive Hip Replacement at Sarvodaya Hospital, Faridabad, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 27 years of experience.

His list is centred on the hip and knee. He performs total knee and total hip replacement, partial and robotic knee replacement, and revision knee and hip replacement, and manages advanced hip and knee osteoarthritis. His reconstructive work covers ACL and PCL reconstruction and meniscus repair, and he also treats frozen shoulder, shoulder instability, tennis elbow, golfer's elbow, trigger finger and osteomyelitis, and performs fracture fixation and joint injection.

He holds an MBBS and an MS in orthopaedics. His five fellowships were taken in five places and account for the specific techniques in his title. Hip arthroscopy with hip and knee replacement and reconstruction was taken at Wrightington Hospital in the UK, a Johnson and Johnson joint replacement fellowship at Puettlingen in Germany, minimally invasive and computer-assisted joint replacement in Seoul, joint reconstruction in Mumbai, and he was an International AO Fellow at Homburg.

He is a founder member of the Society of Knee Surgeons of India, and also belongs to the Indian Society of Hip and Knee Surgeons, the Indian Orthopaedic Association, the Indian Arthroscopy Society and the Indian Cartilage Society. He reviews for the Journal of Clinical Orthopaedics and Trauma.

Alongside Sarvodaya Hospital he has practised at Apollo Spectra Hospitals, Nova Specialty Hospital and Primus Hospital in Chanakyapuri, all in New Delhi.

dr-vikram-byre.bio:
Dr. Vikram Byre is Consultant Orthopedic Surgeon and Robotic Joint Replacement Specialist at Yashoda Hospitals, Secunderabad, Hyderabad, with more than 20 years of experience.

His practice is concentrated on the hip and knee rather than spread across the specialty. He performs total knee and total hip replacement, partial knee replacement, robotic knee replacement, and revision knee and hip replacement, and manages advanced knee and hip osteoarthritis. The remainder of his list is rotator cuff repair, fracture fixation and joint injection.

His training is recorded by year and each step adds to that focus. He qualified MBBS in 2006, took the D Ortho at Manipal Hospitals in 2013 and the DNB Ortho at Apollo Hospitals in 2015. His fellowship in navigation hip and knee arthroplasty followed in 2017 and a fellowship in complex hip and knee arthroplasty in Italy in 2018. In 2022 he added a fellowship in musculoskeletal pain management, which is the one qualification that points outside the operating theatre and towards the non-surgical management that joint injection represents on his list.

He belongs to the Indian Society of Hip and Knee Surgeons, the Indian Arthroplasty Association, the Indian Orthopedic Association, the Telangana Orthopedic Surgeon Association and the Indian Medical Association, and is registered with the Telangana State Medical Council and the Medical Council of India.

He was named Best Emerging Robotic Joint Replacement Surgeon at the Times Network Health Summit 2025. Alongside Yashoda Hospitals he has worked at Apollo Hospitals and Poulomi Hospital.

dr-apoorv-dua.bio:
Dr. Apoorv Dua is a Senior Consultant at the Indian Spinal Injuries Centre in the Delhi NCR, with more than 15 years of experience in orthopedics.

His list covers arthroplasty, sports surgery and trauma. He performs total knee and total hip replacement, robotic knee replacement, revision knee replacement and shoulder replacement, together with ACL reconstruction, rotator cuff repair, meniscus repair, arthroscopic surgery and fracture fixation.

He holds an MBBS and an MS in orthopaedics. His further qualifications were taken in four places and point in three directions: the FJRR in joint replacement and reconstruction in Germany, the FIMAS in Mumbai, the FIFA diploma in football medicine in Switzerland, and the IFICS international fellowship in paediatric fractures. That last credential is unusual on an adult reconstructive list and sits alongside the sports medicine qualification rather than with the arthroplasty work.

His hospital history is broad. He has worked at Dr. Baba Saheb Ambedkar Medical College and Hospital, at Holy Family Hospital in Okhla, at Fortis Flt Lt Rajan Dhall Hospital in Vasant Kunj, at Fortis La Femme in GK II, at Apollo Spectra in Nehru Place, at Max Hospital in Shalimar Bagh and BLK-Max on Pusa Road, and at C K Birla Hospital in Punjabi Bagh.

His recognition includes the Big Impact Award 2025 from BIG FM for excellence in sports injuries and orthopaedics in the South Delhi region, a Young Achiever's Award from IMA SDB, an appreciation award from the Regional Director of Health Services, and a Corona Warrior award for service during the COVID period.

dr-rohit-thakkar.bio:
Dr. Rohit Thakkar is a Consultant at Marengo Asia Hospitals, Faridabad, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 10 years of experience. His profile records orthopedics together with paediatric orthopedics.

His list covers total knee and total hip replacement, revision knee and hip replacement, shoulder replacement, ACL reconstruction, meniscus repair, rotator cuff repair, fracture fixation and non-union repair, so joint replacement and trauma carry roughly equal weight.

His training was taken across four states. He read MBBS at Dr. Vaishampayan Memorial G.M.C in Solapur and took his MS in orthopaedics at Dr. Shankarrao Chavan Government Medical College in Nanded. Three fellowships followed in sequence. He was a SICOT Fellow in joint replacement at Dr. L.H. Hiranandani Hospital in Powai, Mumbai, under Dr. Sanjeev Jain and Dr. Pradeep Kumar Singh, between October 2017 and March 2018; an IAOS Fellow in trauma at S.K.R. Hospital in Pathankot between April 2018 and February 2019; and took the FICR in joint replacement at SHALBY Hospitals in Ahmedabad between July 2021 and January 2022.

That sequence is reflected in his affiliations, which include each of those training hospitals alongside the Metro Heart Institute and Asian Hospital in Faridabad.

He is an active member of SICOT, of the Indian Arthroplasty Association, of the Indian Society of Hip and Knee Surgeons, and of the Indian and Delhi Orthopaedic Associations, and has multiple publications in national and international indexed journals.

dr-harshavardhan-hegde-2.bio:
Dr. Harshavardhan Hegde is Senior Director at Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 43 years of experience. His profile records orthopedics together with spine surgery.

His list is built around the replaced joint. He performs total knee and total hip replacement, partial knee replacement, robotic knee replacement, hip resurfacing, ankle replacement, and revision knee and hip replacement, and manages advanced hip and knee osteoarthritis. Alongside that he performs ACL and PCL reconstruction, rotator cuff repair, tendon repair, fracture fixation and joint injection.

He qualified MBBS in 1983 and took his MS in orthopaedics at Baroda Medical College in 1987. His fellowships were taken at the Nuffield Orthopaedic Centre in Oxford and at Klinikum Karlsbaad in Germany, and his record notes further specialist training in the US, Australia, Brussels and Budapest. He is ATLS certified faculty.

His registrations span three Indian state and national councils and the GMC in the UK, and he belongs to the Girdlestone Orthopaedic Society, a body named after the Oxford chair where his own fellowship was taken.

His posts before Max Healthcare were at Alembic Hospital in Vadodara, Apollo Hospital in Gandhinagar, Nova Bone and Joint Hospital, Fortis Vasant Kunj and Artemis Hospital in Gurgaon, so his career has moved from Vadodara and Gandhinagar into the Delhi NCR private hospital sector while keeping a UK registration throughout.

dr-ashok-s-gavaskar.bio:
Dr. Ashok S. Gavaskar is Clinical Lead in Orthopaedics and Head of Joint Replacement Services at Rela Hospital in Chennai, with more than 23 years of experience across orthopedics and arthroplasty.

His list covers total knee and total hip replacement, partial and robotic knee replacement, hip resurfacing, shoulder replacement, ankle replacement, and revision knee and hip replacement. His reconstructive and trauma work is ACL and PCL reconstruction, fracture fixation and non-union repair.

He read MBBS at Madras Medical College in 2003 and took his MS in orthopaedics at Madurai Medical College in 2007, and was elected FRCS by the Royal College of Surgeons of Glasgow and FACS by the American College of Surgeons, both from 2019.

His editorial and committee work is the most substantial part of his record and is unusually international. He sits on the international advisory board of the Journal of the American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons, has been Deputy Editor of the European Journal of Orthopaedic Surgery and Traumatology since June 2018, and Associate Editor of the trauma section of the Indian Journal of Orthopaedics since 2019. He is a member of the AO Trauma Technical Commission for Asia Pacific, Chairman of the APOA Young Surgeons Committee, and an executive committee member of the Indian chapter of SICOT.

He reviews for the Journal of Arthroplasty, BMC Musculoskeletal Disorders, World Journal of Orthopaedics, BMJ Case Reports and others, and holds the Times Excellence in Orthopaedics Award for 2021 and the Young Ambassador Award of the Asia Pacific Orthopaedic Association.

dr-anoop-dhamangaonkar.bio:
Dr. Anoop Dhamangaonkar is a Consultant Joint Replacement and Orthopaedic Surgeon at Gleneagles Hospital in Parel, Mumbai, with more than 12 years of experience. His profile records orthopedics together with spine surgery.

His list is concentrated on the hip and knee. He performs total knee and total hip replacement, partial knee replacement, hip resurfacing, and revision knee and hip replacement, alongside fracture fixation and non-union repair.

His training was taken almost entirely in Mumbai. He read MBBS at Seth GS Medical College and KEM Hospital, then took four postgraduate qualifications at LTMMC and GH, Sion Hospital: the MS in orthopaedics, the DNB, the D. Ortho and the FCPS. He also holds the MNAMS, and received a Vice-Chancellor's Certificate of Merit for placing fifth in the Maharashtra University of Health Sciences examinations.

His three joint replacement fellowships were each taken in a different country: Liverpool, Hamburg and Seoul. Those three placements are what carried an otherwise entirely Mumbai training into international arthroplasty practice.

His academic record is substantial for the length of his career. He edited the arthroplasty section of the Indian Journal of Orthopaedics between 2019 and 2022, has published over 35 research papers in high-impact international peer-reviewed journals, and teaches as faculty at national and international orthopaedic and joint replacement courses and conferences. He continues to be associated with Sion Hospital, where he trained, alongside his practice in Parel.

dr-venudhara-kum-mohan-reddy.bio:
Dr. Venuthurla Ram Mohan Reddy is a Senior Consultant Orthopaedic Surgeon at Yashoda Hospital, Hitech City, Hyderabad, with more than 31 years of experience.

His list covers total knee and total hip replacement, revision knee and hip replacement and shoulder replacement, together with ACL and PCL reconstruction, rotator cuff repair, arthroscopic surgery, Achilles repair, fracture fixation and non-union repair. He also treats frozen shoulder.

His qualifications were taken over fourteen years and across both countries he has worked in. He read MBBS at Osmania Medical College in June 1992, took his MS in orthopaedics at Kasturba Institute of Medical Sciences between 1995 and 1997, and the DNB at PGIMER in Chandigarh in June 1999. In the UK he took an MSc in orthopaedic engineering at Cardiff University in March 2003, then the intercollegiate FRCS in orthopaedics in March 2005 and a further FRCS in 2006, both from the Royal College of Surgeons of Edinburgh.

His clinical fellowships were all taken in the UK and each in a different subspecialty: orthopaedic oncology at the Freeman Hospital in Newcastle, prosthetic orthopaedics and arthroplasty also in Newcastle, and hip arthroplasty with spine surgery at Leicester General Hospital.

He worked at Doncaster District Hospital and the University Hospitals of Leicester before returning to Hyderabad, where he has been at Continental Hospitals and Rainbow Hospitals. He completed the Royal College of Surgeons of Edinburgh trainers' course in October 2008 and has served as an examiner for student assessments.

dr-devendra-yadav.bio:
Dr. Devendra Yadav is Unit Head of Orthopaedics, Unit VI, at Artemis Hospitals in Gurugram, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 15 years of experience. His profile records orthopedics together with paediatric orthopedics.

His list is weighted towards trauma and reconstruction rather than towards elective arthroplasty alone. He performs fracture fixation and non-union repair, limb lengthening surgery and the correction of limb length discrepancy, alongside total knee and total hip replacement and revision knee and hip replacement.

Both of his degrees were taken at Pt. J.N.M Medical College in Raipur, Chhattisgarh: the MBBS and the M.S. in orthopaedics. He has also completed the Advanced Trauma Life Support course, which his record lists both as training and as an achievement.

The distinguishing fact in his profile is where he spent the middle of his career. He served with the Ministry of Health in Saudi Arabia between 2000 and 2010, giving him more than ten years of international experience, and has also worked at SAIL Hospital. His record notes recognised expertise in complex orthopaedic trauma and paediatric orthopaedic cases, the two areas his list and his second specialization both point to.

He is a life member of the Indian Orthopaedic Association and a member of the Bombay Orthopaedic Society, the Delhi Orthopaedic Association, the Gurgaon Orthopaedic Society and World Orthopaedic Concern. He has published research on the use of external fixators in the treatment of distal radial fractures.

dr-s-k-s-marya.bio:
Dr. S.K.S. Marya is Group Chairman and Chief Surgeon for Orthopaedics, Joints and Robotic Surgery at Max Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 45 years of experience.

His list is built around joint replacement and its failures. He performs total knee and total hip replacement, revision knee and hip replacement, robotic knee replacement and shoulder replacement, and treats failed joint replacement as a category in its own right. Alongside that he performs arthroscopic knee and shoulder surgery, ACL reconstruction, ligament repair and fracture fixation.

His qualifications were taken over three decades. He read MBBS at Rohtak in 1981, took his MS in orthopaedics at PGI Chandigarh in 1984 and the DNB through the National Board in 1985, then the MCh in orthopaedics at the University of Liverpool in 1991. He was elected FRCS in England in 2012 and received a DSc honoris causa from Amity University in Noida in 2019.

His recognition spans state, professional and academic bodies. He received the Bharat Jyoti Award in 2003, the DMA Distinguish Services Award on Doctors Day in 2005, the Best Publication Award of the Delhi Orthopaedic Association in 2008, an Award of Merit from the Government of Punjab in 2010, the Haryana Vigyan Ratna Award in 2012 and the B.N. Sinha Meritorious Award of the Indian Orthopaedic Association in 2018. The Bombay Orthopaedic Society gave his book Surface Replacement of Hip its book award for 2007 to 2008.

dr-r-a-purnachandra-tejaswi.bio:
Dr. R. A. Purnachandra Tejaswi is Director and Head of the Department of Sports Orthopaedics, Arthroscopy and Shoulder Service at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, Hyderabad, with more than 15 years of experience across orthopedics and reconstructive arthroscopy.

His list reflects that dual title. Sports and shoulder work covers ACL and PCL reconstruction, meniscus repair, rotator cuff repair, arthroscopic surgery, shoulder instability and frozen shoulder. Arthroplasty covers total knee and total hip replacement, partial knee replacement, hip resurfacing, shoulder replacement and revision hip replacement. He also performs limb lengthening surgery, fracture fixation and joint injection.

He read MBBS at Government Medical College in Mysore and took his MS in orthopaedics and the DNB, with his orthopaedic surgery residency at Manipal University.

His four fellowships were taken in four countries and each maps onto part of his list: hip surgery at Dresden, shoulder surgery at Concordia Hospital in Rome, hip and knee reconstructive surgery at the ATOS Clinic in Heidelberg, and sports medicine with reconstructive arthroscopy and joint preservation at Dalhousie University in Halifax. He also holds a diploma in sports medicine from the International Olympic Committee.

He was elected a Fellow of the Arthroscopic Association of Canada in June 2019 and won its best fellow research paper award in the same month. He belongs to the Indian Arthroscopic Society, the Canada Orthopaedic Society, ISAKOS, ESSKA and others, and has presented at ISAKOS and at the Canadian and Indian orthopaedic association conferences.

dr-anuj-gupta.bio:
Dr. Anuj Gupta is a Consultant at Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 14 years of experience across orthopedics and paediatric orthopedics.

His list is among the widest in this specialty. Arthroplasty covers total knee and total hip replacement, partial knee replacement, hip resurfacing and revision knee and hip replacement, with advanced hip and knee osteoarthritis managed alongside. Sports and arthroscopic work covers ACL and PCL reconstruction, meniscus repair, rotator cuff repair and shoulder instability. Hand and elbow work covers carpal tunnel release, trigger finger, tennis elbow and golfer's elbow, and he also treats frozen shoulder and plantar fasciitis and performs limb lengthening, fracture fixation, non-union repair and tendon repair.

His training is documented year by year. He read MBBS at Gandhi Medical College in Bhopal in 2012 and took his MS in orthopaedics there in 2016, the DNB in 2018, and a joint replacement fellowship at Max Healthcare in 2021. His shorter courses run from the Ponseti method of clubfoot management in 2015 through AO Foundation basic and advanced trauma courses in 2022 to a complex hip and knee advanced course in Chennai in 2025.

He won a silver medal and second rank in MBBS. His research is on ACL reconstruction using hamstring tendons, including a paper on the validity of the single-leg hop test against the Lysholm score, and presentations at CEZCON in Ujjain and MPIOACON in Gwalior.

dr-thiagarajan-pandian.bio:
Dr. Thiagarajan Pandian is a Senior Consultant at Gleneagles Healthcity in Perumbakkam, Chennai, with more than 13 years of experience. His profile records orthopedics together with spine surgery.

His list covers total knee and total hip replacement, robotic knee replacement and shoulder replacement, together with ACL reconstruction, meniscus repair, rotator cuff repair and arthroscopic surgery, and on the trauma side fracture fixation, non-union repair and limb lengthening surgery.

He holds an MBBS and an MS in orthopaedics. His fellowship in arthroscopy and arthroplasty was taken at Safdarjang Hospital in New Delhi with additional training in Pune. His thesis, submitted to TNMGR University, was a short term clinical and radiological evaluation of fully hydroxyapatite coated uncemented stems in hip arthroplasty, which places his early academic work in the same field as the arthroplasty half of his present list.

His continuing education is recorded in detail and covers all three areas he practises in. He has completed the Synthesis basic and trauma course and cadaver workshops in spine, arthroplasty and arthroscopy at the MS Ramaiah Advanced Learning Centre, a knee arthroscopy workshop at SRMC in 2019, the Ranawat Orthopaedic Conference in 2020 and a spine workshop at Ganga Hospital in 2022.

His posts have been across the Chennai teaching hospitals: Sree Balaji Medical College Hospital and Research Institute, Sri Ramachandra Medical College and Research Institute, Chettinad Medical College and Research Institute, and Madha Medical College.

dr-vikas-gupta.bio:
Dr. Vikas Gupta is Principal Director of the Max Institute of Musculoskeletal Sciences and Orthopaedics at Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 31 years of experience. His profile records orthopedics together with hand reconstruction.

The hand and upper limb are the centre of his practice. He performs carpal tunnel release, treats Dupuytren's contracture and trigger finger, and carries out hand reconstruction and tendon repair. Alongside that he performs total knee and total hip replacement, partial knee replacement, ACL and PCL reconstruction, meniscus repair, rotator cuff repair, arthroscopic surgery, fracture fixation and joint injection, and treats plantar fasciitis.

Both of his degrees were taken at AIIMS in New Delhi. His subspecialty training was a hand surgery fellowship at the Mayo Clinic in Rochester, together with an AO fellowship at Freiberg in Germany.

His record carries two firsts and a volume figure. He was the first surgeon in India to perform a ceramic on ceramic wrist replacement, and has performed over 6,000 complex hand, upper extremity and wrist surgeries. He won a best paper award for work on wrist arthroscopy at the North Zone Indian Orthopedic Association meeting in Srinagar in 2004, and was nominated in Marquis Who's Who in Asia in 2007 for his work in hand and upper extremity surgery.

Before Max Healthcare he was at AIIMS, at the Fortis Group of Hospitals in the NCR and at Medanta in Gurgaon.

dr-sunil-dachepalli.bio:
Dr. Sunil Dachepalli is Clinical Director and Senior Consultant at Yashoda Hospitals, Somajiguda, Hyderabad, with more than 28 years of experience in orthopedics.

His list covers total knee and total hip replacement, partial and robotic knee replacement, shoulder replacement, and revision knee and hip replacement, together with ACL reconstruction, meniscus repair, rotator cuff repair, arthroscopic surgery, tendon repair, fracture fixation and non-union repair. He also treats frozen shoulder.

His qualifications explain the robotic entry on that list directly. Alongside an MBBS, an MS in orthopaedics and the MRCS of Edinburgh, he holds an MSc in orthopaedic engineering with a specialization in robotics and computer navigation, so the technology side of his practice is formally credentialled rather than acquired through a course. He is also a certified ATLS instructor.

His record carries two firsts. His profile states that he performed the world's first successful joint replacement of its kind at Wrightington Hospital in the UK, and that he was the first surgeon in Telangana and AP to perform a successful total elbow replacement.

His other recognition comes from meetings and quizzes during his UK years: a best presentation award at the South East Thames Circuit Meeting in August 2010, the Christmas Orthopaedic Quiz at Rochdale Infirmary in 2007, and runner-up in a national orthopaedic quiz in 2000.

He belongs to the Indian Medical Association, the Indian Orthopaedic Association and the British Medical Association.

dr-sumeet-rastogi.bio:
Dr. Sumeet Rastogi is Principal Consultant in Orthopaedics and Joint Replacement at Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 26 years of experience.

His list is the broadest kind of general orthopaedic practice. Arthroplasty covers total knee and total hip replacement, partial knee replacement, hip resurfacing, shoulder replacement, ankle replacement and revision knee and hip replacement. Sports and arthroscopic work covers ACL and PCL reconstruction, meniscus repair, rotator cuff repair and shoulder instability. He performs carpal tunnel release and bunion surgery for hallux valgus, and treats trigger finger, tennis elbow, golfer's elbow and plantar fasciitis. He also performs limb lengthening, fracture fixation, non-union repair, tendon repair and joint injection.

He read MBBS at JLN Medical College in 1995 and took the DNB in orthopaedic surgery at Sir Ganga Ram Hospital in New Delhi in 1999. His later training was taken abroad: advanced Zimmer trauma at Chulalongkorn University in Bangkok in 2009, an AO basic course in 2012, and a joint replacement fellowship at the Istituto Clinico S Anna Hospital in Brescia in 2015.

He is a DNB certified teacher in orthopaedics and a certified thesis guide for the National Board of Examinations, and has conducted international outpatient clinics in Africa, Iraq and Afghanistan. He has more than 25 publications, is associate editor of a Thieme India book on complex primary knee replacement, and has written chapters on short stem design and on instability following knee replacement.

dr-anurag-aggarwal.bio:
Dr. Anurag Aggarwal is Program Clinical Director for Orthopaedics and Joint Replacement at Marengo Asia Hospitals in Faridabad, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 20 years of experience in orthopedics.

His list is built around the replaced joint. He performs total knee and total hip replacement, partial knee replacement, robotic knee replacement, shoulder replacement, and revision knee and hip replacement, and manages advanced hip and knee osteoarthritis. Alongside that he performs ACL reconstruction, meniscus repair, rotator cuff repair and fracture fixation, and treats tennis elbow, frozen shoulder and trigger finger.

Both of his degrees were taken at the Institute of Medical Sciences, BHU, in Varanasi: the MBBS and the MS in orthopaedics. His later qualifications were taken abroad. He holds a Diploma in Sports Medicine from the University of South Wales in the UK, and was elected a Fellow of the American College of Surgeons in the USA, a Fellow of the International College of Surgeons and a Fellow of the International Medical Sciences Academy.

His technical training is traceable to particular procedures on that list. He completed a fellowship in joint replacement and arthroscopy with Stryker, training in minimally invasive total hip replacement at Chonnam University in South Korea, and training in computer navigation knee replacement at TTSH Hospital in Singapore, so the navigation and minimally invasive parts of his practice are each separately credentialled.

Before Marengo Asia Hospitals he worked at Fortis Escorts Hospital in Faridabad, Apollo Hospital in New Delhi, Sterling Multispecialty Hospital in Baroda and Metro Hospital in Faridabad, so his career has stayed largely in Faridabad and the wider NCR.

dr-sai-thirumal-rao-veerla.bio:
Dr. Sai Thirumal Rao Veerla is a Senior Consultant Orthopaedic and Arthroscopy Surgeon at Yashoda Hospitals, Hitec City, Hyderabad, with more than 12 years of experience in orthopedics.

His title describes the two halves of his list. The arthroscopic and sports half covers ACL and PCL reconstruction, meniscus repair, rotator cuff repair, arthroscopic surgery, Achilles repair for tendon rupture, joint injection and frozen shoulder. The replacement half covers total knee replacement, robotic knee replacement and total hip replacement. He also performs fracture fixation.

His qualifications follow the same division. After an MBBS and an MS in orthopaedics he took a fellowship in arthroscopy and sports medicine at Cardiff in the UK and a fellowship in arthroplasty in Germany, and holds a Diploma in Sports Medicine from the International Olympic Committee. Between them those three add the sports, replacement and arthroscopic strands of his present practice.

He belongs to five orthopaedic bodies: the Telangana Orthopaedic Surgeons Association, the Indian Arthroscopy Society, the Indian Orthopaedic Association, the International Society for Knowledge for Surgeons on Arthroscopy and Arthroplasty, and the Twin Cities Orthopaedic Association.

His research sits directly on procedures he performs. He has published an evaluation of early results of total knee arthroplasty using a rotating platform high flexion knee, a study of the surgical management of closed tendoachillies ruptures and its results, and work on the management of distal tibial pilon fracture with Mippo. The first of those matches the arthroplasty part of his list and the second the Achilles repair, so his published work and his operating range describe the same practice.

dr-ritabh-kumar.bio:
Dr. Ritabh Kumar is Director of Orthopedics and Chief of Trauma Services at the Indian Spinal Injuries Centre in the Delhi NCR, with more than 33 years of experience. His profile records orthopedics together with pediatric orthopedics.

His list is a trauma list rather than a replacement one. He performs fracture fixation, non-union repair and tendon repair, and treats osteomyelitis and limb length discrepancy. His arthroscopic work covers ACL reconstruction, meniscus repair and rotator cuff repair.

Both of his Indian degrees were taken at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences: the MBBS and the MS in orthopaedics. He then took the MCh in orthopaedics in the United Kingdom and holds the MNAMS, and completed international fellowships in orthopaedic trauma in Italy and Australia. Those two placements are the subspecialty foundation of the trauma service he now heads.

His recognition runs from his student years through to his present teaching. He won the Prof. Ramalingaswami Prize for best intern at the Comprehensive Rural Health Services Project at AIIMS in 1993, was named Best Worker at the Indian Spinal Injuries Centre in 2001, and received the Professorial Award for Academic Excellence from the University of Dundee in 2003. He has been national faculty for AO Trauma courses from 2012 onwards and sits on the executive board of Maharaja Agrasen Medical College in Agroha.

Before the Indian Spinal Injuries Centre at Vasant Kunj he worked at Medanta The Medicity in Gurgaon and at Max Hospitals, so his career has been spent in the Delhi NCR since his AIIMS training.

dr-jayaraman-jagadeesan.bio:
Dr. Jayaraman Jagadeesan is a Senior Consultant at MGM Healthcare in Chennai, with more than 26 years of experience. His profile records orthopedics together with pediatric orthopedics.

Hip and knee replacement is the centre of his list. He performs total knee replacement, partial knee replacement, revision knee replacement, total hip replacement, hip resurfacing and revision hip replacement, and manages advanced hip and knee osteoarthritis. Shoulder replacement and shoulder instability sit alongside, and his arthroscopic and soft tissue work covers ACL reconstruction for ACL tear, meniscus repair, arthroscopic surgery, tendon repair, carpal tunnel release and fracture fixation.

His qualifications were taken over almost twenty years and in two countries. He read MBBS at Stanley Medical College in 1995 and took a postgraduate diploma in orthopaedics there in 1999. He was elected MRCS by the Royal College of Surgeons Glasgow in 2005 and FRCS by the same college in 2013, with an arthroscopy fellowship from the Indian Arthroscopy Society in 2011 between the two. He also holds an MCh certification from the American University of Seychelles, which his record lists as an achievement as well as a qualification.

He is registered with the Tamilnadu Medical Council and the General Medical Council in the UK, and belongs to the Royal College of Surgeons Glasgow, the Indian Society of Orthopaedic Surgeons and the Indian Arthroscopy Society. Holding both registrations alongside two Glasgow college qualifications places his career across the two systems, and the 2011 arthroscopy fellowship explains the soft tissue half of a list otherwise dominated by joint replacement.

dr-hariharan-mohan.bio:
Dr. Hariharan Mohan is a Consultant Orthopaedic Surgeon at MGM Healthcare in Chennai, with more than 15 years of experience in orthopedics.

His list covers total knee and total hip replacement, partial knee replacement, revision knee and hip replacement and shoulder replacement, together with ACL reconstruction for ACL tear, PCL reconstruction for PCL tear, meniscus repair, rotator cuff repair, arthroscopic surgery and shoulder instability. On the trauma side he performs fracture fixation and non-union repair, and he also treats tennis elbow and golfer's elbow and gives joint injections.

His training is documented year by year and moves from Chennai to Mumbai to the UK. He read MBBS at Madras Medical College in 2013, took his MS in orthopaedics at Seth GS Medical College and KEM Hospital in Mumbai in 2017 and the DNB in orthopaedics through the National Board of Examinations in New Delhi in 2018. He was elected MRCS by the Royal College of Surgeons of Edinburgh in 2019 and took the FRCS in trauma and orthopaedics from the same college in 2023.

Four of his posts have been NHS fellowships, each at a different hospital: Wrightington Hospital in Wigan, Homerton University Hospital in London, Nottingham University Hospital and the Medway NHS Foundation Trust in Kent. He has also worked at Seth GS Medical College and KEM Hospital, where he trained.

He won the Col. Thayumanaswamy Medal in Orthopaedics in 2012 and the Pandurangi Award for the best outgoing orthopaedic resident at Seth GS Medical College and KEM Hospital in 2017.

dr-aditya-jain.bio:
Dr. Aditya Jain is a Senior Consultant Orthopaedic Surgeon at Fortis Escorts Heart Institute in the Delhi NCR, with more than 12 years of experience. His profile records orthopaedics together with sports medicine.

That second specialization shapes his list. His sports and arthroscopic work covers ACL reconstruction, meniscus repair, rotator cuff repair and arthroscopic surgery. His replacement work covers total knee replacement, partial knee replacement, revision knee replacement, total hip replacement and shoulder replacement, and on the trauma side he performs fracture fixation and non-union repair.

He read MBBS at Indira Gandhi Government Medical College in Nagpur, where he received the Silver Jubilee Best Student Award, and took his MS in orthopaedics at Pt. B.D. Sharma PGIMS in Rohtak. He also holds the DNB in orthopaedics, the MNAMS and the MIMSA.

His two fellowships map onto the two halves of his practice and were taken in three countries. His AO Trauma fellowship was split between Westchester Medical Center and the Hospital for Special Surgery in New York, and his shoulder and arthroscopy fellowship was taken in Aberdeen in Scotland and in Switzerland. He is now AO Trauma faculty for AO Trauma courses, so the trauma fellowship has since become a teaching role.

Alongside his hospital post he is the founder of StepUp Joints, an orthopaedic, physiotherapy and lifestyle care centre, which places rehabilitation next to surgery within his own practice. His professional memberships are with IAS, IOA, DOA, SICOT, AO Trauma and ISKSAA.

dr-sanjay-pai.bio:
Dr. Sanjay Pai is a Senior Consultant at Apollo Hospitals, Bannerghatta Road, Bengaluru, with more than 39 years of experience in orthopedics.

Joint replacement is the centre of his practice. He performs total knee replacement and total hip replacement and the revision of both, and his record describes him as a leading authority in the country for joint replacement surgery with more than 1,000 such operations performed. Alongside the replaced joint he performs ACL reconstruction, meniscus repair, rotator cuff repair, arthroscopic surgery, tendon repair, fracture fixation and carpal tunnel release, and treats carpal tunnel syndrome.

He holds four orthopaedic qualifications: the MBBS, the MS in orthopedics, the MCh in orthopedics and the DNB in orthopedics, so his postgraduate training was taken through three separate examination routes rather than one.

Computer navigation is the technical thread through his record. He is described as a pioneer of 3rd generation computer-navigated joint replacements in South India and as the only surgeon performing computer-navigated surgeries at his facility, which places the navigated knee and hip at the centre of what he offers rather than at its edge.

His teaching and speaking sit alongside the operating. He is faculty for the joint replacement fellowship at Apollo Hospitals, Bangalore, is a regular speaker at international conferences, and demonstrates difficult cases across the country. Between a career of over three decades, a documented volume of joint replacement surgeries and a fellowship teaching role, his record is that of a surgeon whose operating and training responsibilities both sit in arthroplasty.

dr-srinivas-kasha.bio:
Dr. Srinivas Kasha is Senior Consultant and Head of Orthopaedic Trauma at KIMS Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 32 years of experience in orthopedics.

His list carries both halves of that title. Trauma covers fracture fixation, non-union repair, tendon repair and Achilles repair for tendon rupture. Arthroplasty covers total knee and total hip replacement, partial and robotic knee replacement, hip resurfacing and revision knee and hip replacement. His arthroscopic work covers ACL reconstruction for ACL tear, PCL reconstruction for PCL tear and joint injection.

His training was taken in India and in the United States. He read MBBS at Kakatiya Medical College in Warangal after his intermediate at Gnanadeep Junior College in Kamareddy, took his MS in orthopaedics at Osmania Medical College in Hyderabad, then a fellowship in arthroplasty at the Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences in Secunderabad and an AO Trauma fellowship at the University of Pennsylvania in Philadelphia.

His record is as much about teaching as about operating. He is national faculty and one of the initiators of the Association of Pelvi Acetabular Surgeons in India, has trained 6 trauma fellows and 8 joint replacement fellows, and has guided 6 DNB thesis students. He has performed more than 10,000 orthopaedic surgeries.

He has published 5 peer-reviewed papers in national and international journals including JOASIS, JMSR and the International Journal of Orthopaedic Sciences, and has authored chapters in OSSAP monographs on open fracture management and geriatric orthopaedics. Both chapter subjects sit inside the trauma service he heads. Alongside KIMS he has been associated with ESI Medical College.

dr-amite-pankaj-aggarwal.bio:
Dr. Amite Pankaj Aggarwal is Principal Director and Head of the Department of Orthopaedics at Fortis Hospital, Shalimar Bagh, in the Delhi NCR, with more than 27 years of experience. His profile records orthopaedics together with sports medicine.

His replacement list covers total knee replacement, total hip replacement, shoulder replacement, robotic knee replacement and the revision of both knee and hip. His sports and arthroscopic list covers ACL reconstruction, arthroscopic knee surgery, arthroscopic shoulder surgery, meniscus repair, rotator cuff repair and ligament repair, so both specializations on his profile are represented by a full operating range rather than by a single procedure.

Both of his first degrees were taken at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences in New Delhi: the MBBS and the MS in orthopaedics. He also holds the DNB in orthopaedics, the MRCS of Edinburgh and the MNAMS.

His awards are largely fellowship awards, and they came from three different bodies over four years. He received the IOA-Johnson and Johnson Fellowship Award in 2008, the IOS-UK Fellowship Award in 2010 and the IOA-AOA Fellowship Award in 2011. Earlier he had won Ranawat's K T Dholakia Award for the best work in the field of joint replacement in 2007 and an Australian Pain Society Award in 2004, and his record notes multiple further national and international fellowships and awards.

That sequence, which begins with a pain society award, moves through a joint replacement prize and then into three consecutive fellowship awards, tracks the same two areas his present list is divided between.

dr-praveen-kumar-rao.bio:
Dr. Praveen Kumar Rao is a Senior Consultant Orthopedic and Joint Replacement Surgeon at Yashoda Hospitals, Secunderabad, in Hyderabad, with more than 26 years of experience in orthopedics.

His list is built around the replaced joint. He performs total knee replacement, partial knee replacement, total hip replacement and shoulder replacement, together with revision knee replacement and revision hip replacement. Alongside that he performs ACL reconstruction, rotator cuff repair, fracture fixation and non-union repair, so failed and revised replacements and fracture work make up the remainder of a practice otherwise centred on primary arthroplasty.

His qualifications describe a career spent almost entirely inside joint replacement and trauma. He holds an MS in orthopedics and is a Fellow in joint replacement surgery and a Fellow in trauma surgery. His clinical fellowship in joint replacement and trauma surgery was taken at the National University in Singapore, and he holds a DePuy and J&J fellowship in total joint arthroplasty. Those four post-MS qualifications between them cover the same two areas, so each half of his present list rests on a separate fellowship.

He belongs to six professional bodies, national and international. In India he is a member of the Indian Orthopaedic Association, the Indian Arthroscopy Association, the Telangana Orthopaedic Surgeons Association and the Trauma Society of India. Outside India he belongs to the American Academy of Ortho Surgery and to World Orthopaedic Surgeon. The trauma society and the arthroscopy association on that list correspond to the two parts of his operating range that are not primary joint replacement.

dr-srinivasa-reddy-medagam.bio:
Dr. Srinivasa Reddy Medagam is a Senior Consultant at Yashoda Hospitals, Somajiguda, in Hyderabad, with more than 12 years of experience in orthopedics.

The shoulder is the most developed part of his list. He performs shoulder replacement and rotator cuff repair and treats frozen shoulder. Alongside that he performs total knee replacement, revision knee replacement, total hip replacement, ACL reconstruction, arthroscopic surgery, fracture fixation, non-union repair, tendon repair and joint injection.

His training is documented year by year. He read MBBS at Katuri Medical College in Guntur between 2008 and 2014 and took the DNB in orthopaedics at Apollo Hospitals in Chennai between 2014 and 2017. He then took a fellowship in arthroscopy and sports medicine at Yashoda Hospitals in 2019 and a fellowship in primary care rheumatology at Nanavati Hospital in Mumbai in 2020, the two qualifications behind the FIAS and FIPCR after his name.

Four further placements were taken abroad in 2025 alone: knee cartilage-preserving procedures in Singapore, a cadaver flip course in Dubai, a fellowship in advanced shoulder arthroscopy and tendon transfers in South Korea, and a fellowship in advanced shoulder arthroplasty in Italy. The last two explain why shoulder replacement and rotator cuff repair sit at the front of his list, and the rheumatology fellowship explains the joint injection work beside them.

He is a member of the Indian Academy of Orthopedic Surgeons, the International Society for Knowledge for Surgeons on Arthroscopy and Arthroplasty, and the Telangana Arthroscopy Society.

dr-gopala-krishnan.bio:
Dr. Gopala Krishnan is a Senior Consultant at Apollo Hospital in Chennai, with more than 36 years of experience. His profile records orthopedics alongside sports medicine and sports injury evaluation and management.

Those three specializations describe a practice weighted towards the injured rather than the worn joint. He performs ACL reconstruction, rotator cuff repair, meniscus injury repair and arthroscopic surgery, together with tendon repair, fracture fixation and carpal tunnel release, and treats carpal tunnel syndrome. Total knee replacement is the one replacement procedure on his list, which makes his range unusual for a surgeon of his seniority in that it is built around soft tissue and arthroscopic work rather than around arthroplasty.

His qualifications follow the same line. He holds an MBBS, an MS in orthopaedics, the DNB in orthopaedics and a fellowship in sports medicine, the last of which is the formal basis for the two sports specializations on his profile.

His professional standing is recorded mainly through long-term memberships. He is a life member and a life fellow of the Indian Orthopaedic Association, and a life member of the International Society of Arthroscopy, Knee Surgery and Orthopaedic Sports Medicine. He also belongs to the Tamil Nadu Orthopaedic Association and the Madras Orthopaedic Society, and his record notes membership of various further national and international orthopedic and sports medicine associations.

Holding a life membership and a life fellowship of the Indian Orthopaedic Association together with ISAKOS membership places his affiliations in the same arthroscopy and sports medicine field that his operating list is built on.
